title: Senior Finance Executive
description:
At ALS, we encourage you to dream big.
  
  
When you join us, you’ll be part of a global team harnessing the power of scientific testing and data-driven insights to build a healthier future.
  
  
Responsible for managing end-to-end Accounts Payable operations, ensuring accurate invoice processing, timely vendor payments, compliance with statutory requirements, and effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders. The role involves driving process efficiency, maintaining strong controls, and supporting month-end closure activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Invoice & Payment Processing**

* verify and post GRN entries in ERP systems.
* Review and process PO and non-PO invoices ensuring complete documentation, approvals, and policy compliance.
* Verify, account, and process employee expense claims accurately.
* Execute vendor payments as per scheduled payment cycles and share payment advice with vendors.
* Record payment entries and clear open invoices in ERP.
* Create, maintain, and update Vendor Master data across branches in ERP.
* Process employee and vendor advances in line with company policies.
* Perform vendor reconciliations, match ledger balances, and resolve discrepancies.
* Manage vendor queries through timely acknowledgment, coordination, and resolution.
* Validate GRNs against Purchase Orders and resolve mismatches in coordination with Procurement.
* Ensure accurate GL coding and correct tax treatment (GST, TDS) for all transactions.

**Banking & Treasury Coordination**

* Prepare and review bank reconciliation statement.
* Coordinate with banks for payment processing and banking operations.
* Support cash flow planning, payment prioritization, and forecasting.

**Month-End Closure & Reporting**

* Prepare provisions, prepaid entries, and supporting schedules.
* Generate monthly GL expense reports and perform AP ageing and variance analysis.

**Compliance & Audit**

* Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for all AP transactions.
* Provide audit support through schedules and reconciliations.
* Coordinate with statutory, internal, and tax auditors to ensure compliance.

**Process Improvement & Systems**

* Identify process gaps and implement automation to improve efficiency.

**Team & Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Purchase, Operations, HR, Legal, and Finance teams.
* Act as the single point of contact for AP-related escalations.

**Working at ALS**
The ALS team is a diverse and dedicated community united by our passion to make a difference in the world.
  
  
Our values are important to us, and shape how we work, how we treat each other and how we recognise excellence.
  
  
At ALS, you’ll be supported to develop new skills and reach your full potential. We invest in our people with programs and opportunities that help you build a diverse career with us.
  
  
We want everyone to have a safe, flexible and rewarding career that makes a positive impact on our people, the planet and our communities.
  
  
**Everyone Matters**
ALS is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where the strengths and perspectives of each employee are both recognised and valued.
  
  
ALS also welcomes applications from people with all levels of ability. Reasonable adjustments to support candidates throughout the recruitment process are available upon request.
  
  
**Eligibility**
To be eligible to work at ALS you must be a Citizen or Permanent Resident of the country you are applying for, or either hold or be able to obtain, a valid working visa.
  
  
**How To Apply**
Please apply on-line and provide a resume & cover letter that best demonstrate your motivation and ability to meet the requirements of this role.

title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description**
RAAMZ LABEL is a luxury menswear brand based in Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, with over a decade of experience in modern men’s fashion. The brand specializes in premium Western wear, bespoke suits, designer ethnic wear, Jodhpuri outfits, sherwanis, and custom wedding and occasion wear. RAAMZ focuses on creating clothing that reflects each individual’s personality, preferences, and comfort rather than just the event. Every design is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, refined craftsmanship, and a commitment to quality. The brand’s philosophy centers on personalized style, combining creativity and craftsmanship to serve customers for life’s important occasions.
  
**Role Description**
The Accountant at RAAMZ LABEL will manage day-to-day financial operations, including bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, and general ledger entries. This full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad will involve preparing financial statements, assisting with budgeting and cost analysis, and monitoring cash flow to support business decisions. The role includes ensuring compliance with relevant accounting standards, tax regulations, and statutory requirements, as well as coordinating with external auditors and consultants when needed. The Accountant will also support inventory valuation, track expenses related to production and retail operations, and provide timely financial reports to management.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong core accounting skills, including bookkeeping, general ledger management, and financial statement preparation.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in tax compliance, statutory filings, and familiarity with local regulatory requirements.
* Candidates should possess experience with accounting software, spreadsheets, and basic ERP or inventory management systems.
* Candidates should possess skills in budgeting, financial analysis, cost tracking, and cash flow management.
* Candidates should possess attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and the ability to reconcile accounts and resolve discrepancies.
* Candidates should possess strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple financial activities in a retail or fashion business environment.
* Candidates should possess effective written and verbal communication skills to collaborate with management, vendors, and auditors.
* Relevant education such as a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CA Inter, CMA, or equivalent) are an advantage.
* Prior experience in retail, fashion, or manufacturing sectors is beneficial, along with a willingness to work on-site in Hyderabad.

title: Microsoft Finance & Supply Chain Supervisor
description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
  
  
RSM US Integrated Services India Private Limited supports RSM U.S. risk consulting, transaction advisory, technical accounting, financial consulting, technology and management consulting, tax and assurance engagement teams by providing access to highly skilled professionals for repeatable business processes over an extended business day. USI is a member of RSM International, the sixth largest global network of independent accounting, tax and consulting firms.
  
  
The Role
  
  
RSM’s Dynamics 365 Enterprise practice (D365), which supports Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain (F&SC), is a group of highly specialized, multi-disciplined individuals with experience in ERP implementations, industry, technology consulting, and project management. We desire a confident individual who can think strategically, lead a workstream, and review the work of others. This individual should be versed in ERP business process mapping and deep D365 F&SC configuration, while being task oriented and capable of meeting the tight deadlines that often come with implementation-related work. We are seeking an individual looking for career growth in a fast-paced environment, with accelerated leadership opportunities, and a rewarding work-life balance. Ideally, we are looking for candidates with 8+ years of hands-on functional experience implementing D365 F&SC, including experience leading a module or workstream.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the configuration and setup of D365 F&SC for assigned modules or workstreams.
* Review the configuration, unit-test results, and documentation produced by associate and senior associate resources for quality and completeness.
* Own functional design and business process mapping for assigned workstreams; conduct fit-gap analysis and recommend solutions.
* Provide effort estimates and support work planning for assigned scope.
* Serve as the functional escalation point for the workstream, coordinating with technical developers and US counterparts.
* Oversee data conversion activities, including transformation and loading into D365 via the Data Management Framework (DMF).
* Manage the workload and deliverables of a small team across one or more concurrent projects, and monitor team utilization.
* Coach, mentor, and provide performance feedback to junior resources (formal talent development).
* Oversee client delivery and solution quality on assigned projects.

**Required Qualifications**

* 9+ years of functional, hands-on experience implementing D365 F&SC (or Dynamics AX), including experience leading a module or workstream.
* Demonstrated deep configuration expertise across multiple F&SC modules, such as:
* General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Budgeting, Cash & Bank Management, Inventory Management, Procurement & Sourcing, Sales & Marketing, Warehouse Management, and Production Control.
* Experience reviewing the work of other consultants and guiding delivery quality.
* Fluent in English, with strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Knowledge of key end-to-end business processes including, but not limited to:
  
  

* Order to Cash
* Procure to Pay
* Record to Report
* Receive to Ship (warehouse management)
* Plan to Produce (manufacturing)

**Preferred Qualifications & Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: MB-300 plus MB-310 (Finance) and/or MB-330 (Supply Chain Management); multiple certifications preferred.
* Experience with full-lifecycle D365 implementations using Microsoft Success by Design or comparable methodology.
* Power Platform and Dataverse familiarity.
* Azure DevOps and Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) familiarity.
* Industry experience preferred.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Advanced D365 F&SC configuration and solution design across multiple modules.
* Data Management Framework (DMF) and data-migration oversight.
* Understanding of customization concepts, with the ability to interact with technical team.

title: Sr. Financial Analyst -MNC -CTC upto 20 LPA
description:
The Senior Financial Analyst is a hands-on senior finance professional responsible for accurate accounting, month-end reporting, forecasting, budgeting, monthly estimates, financial analysis and commercial insights across. The role owns defined finance processes and delivers clear analysis and recommendations to support business performance and decision-making.

Job Requirements:-

**Financial Reporting, Month-End & Control**

**•**
Own and actively prepare month-end close activities, including journals, accruals, prepayments, reconciliations, monthly estimates, management reporting and review-ready working papers.

• Review financial outputs and supporting analysis for accuracy, completeness and compliance, resolving issues and escalating material risks where required.

• Analyse financial and operational performance, explain variances to budget, forecast and prior periods, and identify trends, risks and opportunities.

• Maintain the integrity of financial information through effective controls, reconciliations, policy compliance and timely resolution of accounting issues.

**Leadership, Coaching & Continuous Improvement**

• Lead defined finance processes and coordinate delivery across relevant reporting and planning cycles, while remaining personally accountable for key outputs.

• Provide technical guidance, coaching, knowledge sharing and review support to Financial Analysts and other finance colleagues.

• Identify and implement improvements to reporting, systems, data quality, controls and process efficiency through standardisation and automation.

**Financial Analysis & Business Partnering**

• Partner with Finance, Operations and Commercial stakeholders to support operational and commercial decision-making and improve business performance.

• Prepare financial and operational analysis, business cases, profitability reviews and investment evaluations within the assigned scope.

• Translate complex financial and operational information into clear insights, options and practical recommendations.

**Planning, Forecasting & Performance Management**

• Actively prepare budgets, forecasts, monthly estimates and longer-term plans for the assigned portfolio.

• Develop and maintain financial models, assumptions and scenarios to support planning, performance management and decision-making.

• Monitor performance against plans and work with stakeholders to understand drivers, challenge assumptions and identify corrective actions.

• Provide clear reporting and commentary on performance, outlook, risks and opportunities.

**Key Requirements**
:

Tertiary qualification in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related discipline.

CA/CPA/MBA qualification, or progress towards completion.

5+ years’ experience in financial analysis, management accounting, commercial finance or a related role.

Demonstrated hands-on experience in month-end reporting, budgeting, forecasting, monthly estimates, financial modelling and performance analysis

Advanced Excel and financial systems capability.

Experience in manufacturing or operationally complex environments.

Experience with SAP, Hyperion, Power BI or equivalent planning and reporting platforms.

month-end close #Variance Analysis #FPN&A #Cash flow management #Plant Accounting #Costing

description:

**Position Summary**
As a Specialist Assistant Manager - Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Government and Public Services Enterprise Solutions (GPS ES) on the Government and Public Services (GPS) Finance Planning and Analysis team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Manage end-to-end financial reporting, recurring deliverables, and complex special projects, providing perspectives to leadership on GPS operating portfolios, assets, and hybrid finance.
* Collaborate with Finance, Business Systems, Information Technology (IT), Contracts, and enterprise solutions teams to deliver data analytics and financial reporting support.
* Develop strategic reports, predictive analytics, and actionable insights that support business decisions and finance-service adoption.
* Lead the collection, validation, analysis, and interpretation of financial and operational data to support repeatable, scalable, and efficient processes.
* Coach and mentor team members; manage performance through regular check-ins and timely feedback; implement training and quality checks; and align team strengths to business needs.

**The team**
The Government and Public Services (GPS) Finance Planning and Analysis group oversees the GPS practice’s business planning and budgeting process. The GPS FP&A team collaborates with business and sector leaders to create both short- and long-term business plans and budgets that align with GPS practice and national goals. * 2–3 years of experience managing a team.
* Experience applying Microsoft Power BI, data analytics methods, and artificial intelligence (AI) tools.
* Experience managing end-to-end reporting, forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and recurring financial deliverables.

title: Associate - Asset Backed Finance - Portfolio Management Group
description:
**About Us**
Oxane Partners is a technology-driven solutions provider to the private credit markets. Our solutions transform the way investment firms and banks analyze and manage their investments. We unify our technology with deep domain expertise to provide compelling and relevant solutions across all asset classes. Our collaborative engagement approach helps our clients evaluate more opportunities faster and better manage their existing investments while still maintaining the rigor of their investment process. title: Assistant Manager General Ledger
description:
**Context & Purpose:**
JLL Business Services (JBS) operates in a matrixed global environment supporting multiple clusters across AMER, APAC & EMEA regions. Employees are expected to combine operational excellence during close cycles with strong analytical capabilities, stakeholder partnership, process governance, automation adoption and continuous improvement. The organization values ownership, transparency, collaboration, controllership mindset, problem solving and leadership at all levels.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**
The focus of the role will be upon -
  
  
Completes assigned close tasks to the close calendar and checklist; confirms task completion in the tracker; flags risks to deadlines to the reviewer before the due date; supports cut-off and accrual data collection.
  
  
Fully accountable to the GL month end close (MEC) including Balance Sheet reconciliation preparation
  
  
Act as a strategic bridge between Business and executive leadership. Align departmental priorities with company-wide growth targets, analyze performance data, and advise leaders on operational improvements.
  
  
**What the job involves:**
P2 is the core ownership level of the R2R role framework, sitting between the P1 &P3 roles, with independent ownership of close activities and balance sheet accounts. This document defines the P2
**Assistant Manager**
General Ledger role within the R2R function, which delivers Month-End Close (MEC), Reconciliations, Financial Reporting, Governance and Continuous Improvement for global accounting operations. The role goes beyond execution: it investigates root causes, resolves issues without close supervision, performs meaningful variance and trend analysis, and partners regularly with entity controllers and business partners. P2s review the work of P1 analysts, support their onboarding, and begin to contribute to process improvement and automation. Success is measured by on-time, accurate delivery of owned deliverables, reconciliation health and the quality of insight provided to stakeholders
  
  
Detailed job responsibilities are mentioned in below table:
  
  
***Key Responsibilities:***
**Area**
**Responsibilities At This Level**
**Month-End Close (MEC)**
Independently plans and executes owned close activities (accruals, provisions, intercompany, cut-off and allocations) to the calendar; tracks dependencies; escalates risks early with proposed solutions; contributes to post-close lessons learned.
  
  
**Journal Entry Management**
Prepares standard and moderately complex journals (accruals, reclassifications, provisions, FX revaluation) with full support; reviews journals prepared by P1s; ensures compliance with policy and approval thresholds.
  
  
**Balance Sheet Reconciliations**
Owns reconciliations for assigned accounts, including medium and high-risk accounts; ensures timely preparation, certification and evidence in Account Reconciliation Cloud Services (ARCS); investigates and resolves reconciling items; reviews P1 reconciliations.
  
  
**Open Item Management**
Manages aging and clearance of open items across owned accounts; drives action with owners in the business and finance; escalates items beyond threshold with root cause and a clearance plan; reports the aging trend.
  
  
**Financial Reporting**
Prepares and reviews management and statutory reporting inputs, schedules and disclosures; ensures reporting accuracy and consistency with the ledger; supports consolidation and group reporting submissions.
  
  
**Variance Analysis**
Performs month-on-month, actual-versus-budget and forecast variance analysis; identifies drivers and root causes; writes concise commentary for controllers and business partners; recommends corrective actions.
  
  
**Governance & Controls**
Operates and evidence key controls for owned processes; performs self-assessments; identifies control gaps and proposes remediation; ensures adherence to policy, SOX or equivalent requirements and segregation of duties.
  
  
**Audit Support**
Prepares audit documentation for owned accounts; responds to internal and external auditors directly on routine queries; supports remediation of findings.
  
  
**Stakeholder Management**
Acts as the day-to-day contact for entity controllers and business partners on owned areas; sets expectations on timelines and data needs; manages escalations on a first-line basis.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement**
Identifies recurring errors, bottlenecks and manual effort in owned processes; implements local improvements; updates procedures and desk instructions; participates in Lean or Six Sigma activities.
  
  
**Digital & Automation Adoption**
Maximises Account Reconciliation Cloud Services (ARCS) auto-matching and workflow features; builds and uses Excel and Power BI tools to improve analysis; documents requirements for automation candidates and supports testing and user acceptance.
  
  

***Required Technical Skills:***
**Skill**
**Expected capability**
**General Accounting**
Strong command of the accounting cycle including accruals, provisions, fixed assets, intercompany, FX and cut-off; applies sound judgement on standard transactions.
  
  
**IFRS / US GAAP**
Working knowledge of the standards that affect owned accounts (revenue, leases, provisions, financial instruments, FX); applies policy correctly and recognises when to seek technical guidance.
  
  
**MEC Management**
Plans and manages own close deliverables, dependencies and cut-off; anticipates delays and recovers the schedule.
  
  
**Balance Sheet Reconciliations**
Applies reconciliation policy, risk ratings and aging thresholds; resolves complex reconciling items; reviews reconciliations prepared by others.
  
  
**Financial Reporting**
Prepares management and statutory reporting schedules; understands the link between the ledger, consolidation and published reporting.
  
  
**Variance Analysis**
Decomposes variances into price, volume, timing and one-off drivers; challenges explanations; writes clear commentary.
  
  
**Journal Review**
Reviews journals for accuracy, support, period, account coding and policy compliance; identifies unusual patterns.
  
  
**Internal Controls**
Understands control design and operating effectiveness; executes and evidences key controls; identifies and reports gaps.
  
  
**Account Reconciliation Cloud Services (ARCS)**
Proficient in reconciliations, transaction matching, journal and task management modules; configures simple rules and formats with guidance.
  
  
**SAP / Oracle / ERP Systems**
Proficient in transactions, reporting and master data for owned processes; extracts and reconciles data independently.
  
  
**Excel (Advanced)**
Builds structured analyses using XLOOKUP or INDEX-MATCH, pivot tables, Power Query and conditional logic; creates reusable, auditable workbooks.
  
  
**Power BI**
Builds simple reports and uses existing dashboards to monitor KPIs and aging; foundational understanding of data models.
  
  
***Behavioural Competency:***
**Competency**
**Observable expectation**
**Learning Agility**
Quickly masters new entities, systems and policy changes; seeks feedback and stretches into P3-level topics.
  
  
**Adaptability**
Flexes across priorities, close pressures and changing requirements without a drop in quality.
  
  
**Collaboration**
Works effectively across R2R, AP, AR, Treasury, Tax and the business; shares knowledge proactively.
  
  
**Customer Orientation**
Anticipates stakeholder needs, communicates proactively on status and meets service commitments.
  
  
**Accountability**
Owns outcomes for assigned accounts and deadlines; takes responsibility for quality and corrects issues without prompting.
  
  
**Decision Making**
Makes sound decisions within policy and delegated authority; weighs risk and escalates matters beyond own remit.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement Mindset**
Actively looks for waste and rework, tests ideas and shares improvements with the team.
  
  
***Communication Skills:***
**Competency**
**Observable expectation**
**Executive communication**
Provides concise written updates to controllers and team leadership; highlights the issue, the impact and the ask.
  
  
**Presentation Skills**
Presents analysis and status in team and stakeholder meetings in a structured manner.
  
  
**Storytelling with financial data**
Explains what the numbers say, why they moved and what to do next in plain language.
  
  
**Ability to challenge constructively**
Questions unusual transactions, missing support or unreasonable deadlines respectfully and with evidence.
  
  
**Global stakeholder engagement**
Works effectively with controllers and partners in multiple regions (SEA, ANZ, WA, MENA); adapts style to cultural and time zone differences.
  
  
***To apply you need:***
**Item**
**Requirement**
**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance or Commerce; Master's degree or MBA is an advantage.
  
  
**Certifications**
Part-qualified or newly qualified CA, CPA, ACCA or CMA preferred; Account Reconciliation Cloud Services (ARCS) certification, Power BI (PL-300) or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt are an advantage.
  
  
**Years Of Experience**
7 years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 2 years in R2R, GL or financial reporting within a shared services or multinational environment.
  
  
**Systems exposure**
Hands-on experience with SAP or Oracle, Account Reconciliation Cloud Services (ARCS) and advanced Excel; Power BI exposure preferred.
  
  
**Process exposure**
Has completed multiple full close cycles and owned reconciliations through audit.

title: Digital Technology Delivery and Performance Lead
description:
About the Job

At Opella, we have one shared mission – we work passionately, every day, to ‘serve healthier, fuller lives’ now and for the generations to come.

In order to do so, we strive to act as a force for good by integrating sustainability along our business and employees’ mission and operate responsibly from both a social and environmental point of view.

Everything we do is centered around people’s interests – our consumers, our customers, healthcare professionals, and our employees – across the world.

We are building loved brands that serve 1bn consumers worldwide, through our key platforms: Allergy, Physical & Mental Wellness, Pain, Digestive Wellness and Cough, Cold & Flu.

We aspire to become the best Fast Moving Consumer Health (FMCH) company in & for the world and we aim to build a work environment where people can thrive, grow, enjoy and be at their best.

**Our team**
designs, delivers, and governs Digital Technology services and capabilities for Opella worldwide.

We deliver our solutions in a highly competitive market answering FMCH needs and sometimes supporting regulated environments (GxP, SoX and other regional or local regulations).

Our team operates in an international context, serving all markets in most of the countries around the world.

Digital Technology & Architecture organization encompasses following capabilities: Integration, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud engineering, Platform Engineering (e.g. DevOps & related framework), FinOps, Platforms (ServiceNow, Observability, Chatbots, SAP, Salesforce, RPA, …), Digital Workplace and Cloud Infrastructure.

**Delivery & Performance**
provides the management system that connects strategy, portfolio execution, financial performance, governance, and operational improvement across Technology & Architecture. The team works across domains to create transparency, strengthen accountability, and enable faster, better-informed decisions.

Are you passionate about turning strategy into brilliant execution, improving financial visibility, and simplifying how technology is governed and delivered? Join us as Delivery & Performance Lead within the Technology & Architecture organization and help strengthen portfolio execution, operational performance, and leadership decision-making across Opella.

Delivery & Performance Lead

Job Summary

The Delivery & Performance Lead drives disciplined execution, financial performance, governance, and operational excellence across Opella’s Technology & Architecture organization. The role provides an integrated view of delivery progress, portfolio health, budgets, risks, dependencies, and outcomes, enabling leaders to make timely, evidence-based decisions.

Working across technology domains and in close partnership with Finance, Procurement, project managers, and business stakeholders, the role strengthens ways of working, improves transparency and accountability, and supports simplification of the technology portfolio and landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Delivery & Performance

* Drive execution discipline and delivery performance across the Technology & Architecture portfolio.
* Maintain clear visibility of progress, milestones, outcomes, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Challenge delivery plans constructively, facilitate issue resolution, and support recovery actions where performance is off track.
* Promote outcome-based planning and consistent portfolio delivery practices.

Financial & Budget Management

* Oversee budget tracking, forecasting, purchase order management, and financial performance across Business as Usual and Separation Costs.
* Reconcile actuals, commitments, forecasts, and variances in partnership with Finance, Procurement, and budget owners.
* Improve financial transparency, cost control, and decision-making through reliable data and timely insight.
* Identify financial risks and opportunities and coordinate corrective actions with accountable owners.

Governance & Ways of Working

* Strengthen delivery governance, standards, reporting rhythms, decision forums, and operating models.
* Clarify accountabilities, decision rights, escalation paths, and performance expectations.
* Standardize practical ways of working that improve consistency, speed, and execution efficiency without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Drive continuous improvement based on delivery data, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned.

Portfolio & Digital Landscape Simplification

* Create an integrated view of initiatives, demand, capacity, investment, and strategic alignment.
* Support portfolio prioritization and sequencing, balancing business value, cost, risk, dependencies, and delivery capacity.
* Contribute to technology landscape simplification by identifying overlaps, rationalization opportunities, and complexity reduction actions.
* Ensure initiatives remain aligned with Technology & Architecture priorities and Opella’s strategic objectives.

Performance Reporting & Executive Insights

* Define and maintain meaningful KPIs covering delivery, financial health, risk, capacity, quality, and outcomes.
* Develop dashboards and management reporting that provide a trusted, concise view of portfolio performance.
* Translate delivery and financial data into actionable insights, options, and recommendations for leadership.
* Improve data quality and reporting automation to reduce manual effort and accelerate decision-making.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Digital Enablement

* Partner with Technology & Architecture leaders, project and portfolio managers, Finance, Procurement, and business stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment across functions, surface trade-offs, and ensure actions and decisions are followed through.
* Act as a trusted partner to leadership, combining constructive challenge with pragmatic execution support.
* Where relevant, use AI-powered tools and digital solutions to improve productivity, streamline reporting, and simplify ways of working.
* Facilitate animation of team routines and coach our Teams to work in Agile ways of working and according to the Project Management methodology defined by our Digital group.

Core Skills & Expertise

* Technology delivery and performance management.
* Project and portfolio management.
* Budget management, forecasting, purchase order management, and cost control.
* Technology governance, operating models, and decision frameworks.
* KPI development, analytics, and executive reporting.
* Stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership.
* Process optimization and continuous improvement.
* Digital transformation and AI enablement.

Required Qualifications

* Significant experience in technology delivery, portfolio performance, PMO, finance, operations, or a comparable role in a complex international organization.
* Proven ability to manage budgets and forecasts, interpret financial data, and drive cost accountability.
* Strong understanding of project and portfolio governance, delivery methodologies, and technology operating models.
* Excellent analytical, communication, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to influence without direct authority, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in ambiguity.
* Pragmatic, structured, detail-oriented, and able to connect strategic priorities with operational execution.
* Fluent English required; additional languages are an advantage.

Tools & Digital Capabilities

* **Project & Portfolio Management**
  : Jira.
* **Collaboration & Knowledge Management:**
  Confluence, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint.
* **Reporting & Analytics:**
  Power BI, Microsoft Excel.
* **AI & Productivity:**
  Microsoft Copilot and generative AI tools like Vibe Coding.
* **Financial & Procurement Processes:**
  budget tracking, forecasting, and SAP.

Success Indicators

* Leadership has a reliable, timely, and actionable view of delivery and financial performance.
* Portfolio milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and accountabilities are transparent and actively managed.
* Budget forecasts are accurate, variances are understood, and financial actions are completed on time.
* Governance and reporting are simpler, more consistent, and focused on decisions and outcomes.
* Prioritization and landscape simplification decisions are supported by clear data and strategic alignment.

Stakeholders recognize the function as a trusted partner that improves execution, accountability, and operational efficiency.

title: EYP-Working Capital-Assistant Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Parthenon – S&E - WCAS (Assistant Manager)**
**Working Capital Advisory Services (WCAS)**
WCAS is a cornerstone of EY's Transformation offerings to clients, working in tandem with other EY practices to drive top line and bottom-line growth with measurable cash benefits.
  
  
Our team is committed to improving the cash-impacting processes of EY clients globally. We aim to help clients enhance their liquidity, resulting in increased Free Cash Flow (FCF) from operations. Our approach includes in-depth analysis and benchmarking, data-driven diagnostics of Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Forecast-to-Fulfil processes using EY's market leading methodologies and tools, and interventions focused on liquidity, such as Cash Flow Forecasting support.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We seek Assistant Managers with expertise in Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), inventory optimization, and/ or supply chain management. Ideal candidates will have 4-7 years of experience in operational improvements with a strategic, transformation-oriented mindset, demonstrated by:
  
  

* Analyzing market/industry trends.
* Ideating from the client's perspective and strategizing with a 'big picture' approach.
* Aligning with client objectives for value, differentiation, ease of implementation, and long-term enablement.
* Experience in key sectors (e.g., Life Sciences and Healthcare, Advanced Manufacturing/ Industrials, Technology, Consumer Products or Retail).
* An end-to-end and transformational approach during pursuits, proposals, and engagements.

As a contributor to our performance improvement, and strategic growth initiatives, you will use your advanced skills in operational and financial data modelling to provide strategic insights to clients and internal stakeholders
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support in executing WCAS engagements either individually or as part of a team to support key conclusions in developing and executing Working Capital optimization opportunities, support strategy and process optimization programs and Cash positioning
* Analyze historical transactional and financial data and market trends to create accurate and reliable opportunity and benefits measures
* Working closely with client teams and GDS leads to tailor models to specific client needs.
* Present deliverables and solutions to clients, clearly communicating assumptions, methodologies, and implications for their business.
* Contribute to the development of proposals and participate in client presentations for new business opportunities.
* Engage in continuous learning and development to stay abreast of best practices in Working Capital and Cash management
* Maintain the highest standards of quality and compliance with EY's ethical guidelines and professional standards.
* Mentor and guide junior analysts in developing their analytical skills and understanding of methodologies
* Data analysis with extensive use Power BI / Alteryx / PowerPoint and advanced MS Excel
* Working knowledge of AI assistants such as copilot for developing automation agents for business development and other use cases

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Inventory Management Expertise: Experience in inventory turnover analysis, just-in-time inventory practices, and demand forecasting to reduce holding and shortage costs
* Credit and Receivables Management: Knowledge of credit policies, credit analysis, and accounts receivable management through Quote-to-Cash process analysis and designing strategies to minimize days sales outstanding (DSO).
* Payables and Disbursements Management: Expertise in managing accounts payable and optimising the Procure-to-Pay cycle. Experience in implementing efficient payment processes to maximise days payables outstanding (DPO).
* Supply chain management: Functional knowledge and experience within Plan, make, source, deliver pillars of supply chain management is a plus
* Data Analytics: Experience in working with large volumes of transactional data to develop segmentation and opportunity models (Must have- Power BI, Alteryx/SQL, MS Office applications; Good to have - Python/R, VBA, Snowflake/Databricks)
* Experience of working with stakeholders in global landscape
* Excellent problem solving and interpersonal skills
* Willingness to Travel: Openness to international travel for business purposes.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Post Graduate degree in business, accounting, finance, engineering, computer science or related field from a premier institute with 4-7 years of applicable industry / analytics and/or consulting experience
* Track record of delivering performance improvement projects related to supply chain/inventory optimization, sourcing/procurement or sales/accounts receivable that deliver tangible results (cost take out, revenue growth, increased cash flow, etc.).

**What You Can Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EYP practices globally with running businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
EY is committed to being inclusive in all dimensions of diversity to ensure every employee is able to be and bring their authentic self to work, every day.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Business Development Manager – Education Finance & Digital Lending
description:
**Full-time · Field-based · 5+ years' experience**

**Locations**
: Hyderabad, Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, Bhubaneswar, Raipur, Mysore, and Chennai

**Joining**
: Immediate joiners preferred, if this remains a genuine preference.

**About Dhaniti™**

Dhaniti™ Fintech Solutions Private Limited is building a payments-first, credit-enabled digital financial ecosystem to expand access to formal financial services in India.

Our flagship platform, DhanitiPay™, combines UPI-led digital payments with responsible credit enablement. We are also developing technology-led lending and education-finance capabilities with partner institutions, alongside GlocalPe™, our B2B cross-border payments platform.

Trust, transparency, responsible financial access and compliance guide how we build our business.

**About the Role**

We are looking for target-driven Business Development Managers who can build markets, acquire customers and partners, and generate measurable business across lending, education finance and payments.

This is a full-spectrum, field-based sales role. You will present Dhaniti's relevant financial solutions to educational institutions and other eligible customers, understand their requirements, and develop business across the applicable product offerings. These may include student fee finance, fee receivables finance, and DhanitiPay™. You will be expected to generate business through direct sales, institutional partnerships, B2B2C arrangements, and channel partners.

This is not a lead-follow-up or relationship-maintenance role. You will generate your own pipeline, win new business at the top-management level, and convert relationships into measurable results.

**What You Will Do**

**Build and win your market**

* **Develop your territory:**
  map schools, colleges, universities, coaching centres, merchants, DSAs and other business sources.
* **Acquire new business:**
  prospect independently, secure meetings with decision-makers, present solutions, negotiate and close.
* **Build institutional partnerships:**
  develop B2B and B2B2C opportunities with educational institutions and other relevant partners.

**Sell the full portfolio**

* **Student fee finance:**
  drive student fee finance and other education-finance and lending business through institutional, channel-led and direct acquisition.
* **Fee receivables finance:**
  identify institutions and businesses with fee-receivables financing needs and convert them into business.
* **DhanitiPay™:**
  promote DhanitiPay™ and related digital financial products among eligible customers, institutions, merchants and partner networks.

**Grow through partners and channels**

* **Build channel networks:**
  identify, onboard and develop DSAs and channel partners for sustainable sourcing.
* **Activate partnerships:**
  make sure onboarded partners generate business, track their productivity and address inactivity.
* **Manage relationships:**
  keep institutions, customers and channel partners engaged so they generate repeat business and referrals.

**Deliver results, the right way**

·      
**Achieve targets:**
Own assigned targets for new customer and partner acquisition, business generation, disbursements, and portfolio growth.

·      
**Build sustainable business:**
Focus on productive partnerships and actual business generated—not just meetings conducted, leads generated, or partner onboarding completed.

·      
**Coordinate internally:**
Work with Credit, Operations, Product, and Compliance teams to facilitate onboarding and business activation.

·      
**Sell responsibly:**
Follow applicable sourcing, documentation, KYC, and compliance requirements. Compliance must never be compromised to achieve sales targets.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 5+ years in sales or business development, preferably in lending, BFSI, fintech, education finance or financial services
* A demonstrated track record of achieving sales or business targets
* Proven experience in new customer acquisition, not just servicing an existing portfolio
* Hands-on experience in B2B, B2B2C, institutional, channel-led or relevant B2C sales
* Experience prospecting, pitching, negotiating and closing deals with senior decision-makers
* A good understanding of lending or financial-services business and customer acquisition processes
* Strong local market knowledge and a relevant network in the assigned territory
* Fluency in English, Hindi and the relevant local language, with the ability to communicate confidently with institutional decision-makers and senior management
* Strong communication, negotiation and follow-up skills
* Willingness to travel extensively within the territory, and the ability to work independently and own targets

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in student loans, education finance, education loans or fee receivables finance
* Existing relationships with schools, colleges, universities, coaching centres, professional education institutions or study-abroad networks
* Experience with banks, NBFCs, fintech companies or digital lending platforms
* An established DSA, merchant, institutional or channel-partner network
* Experience with digital lending, customer onboarding, digital KYC, CRM tools or sales pipeline management
* Experience selling payments, UPI, credit or other digital financial products

**What Success Looks Like**

* Consistently achieving assigned sales and business targets
* Building a qualified pipeline of new customers, institutions and channel partners
* Converting partnerships into active, productive business sources
* Growing lending applications, disbursements, business volumes and portfolio contribution
* Expanding DhanitiPay™ adoption across customer and partner networks
* Generating repeat business and referrals while maintaining compliant sourcing practices

**Why Join Dhaniti™?**

* **Build, don’t just manage:**
  develop your own territory and establish new business relationships from the ground up.

  see the direct impact of your prospecting, sales execution and partnerships on business growth.

  offer institutions a choice of finance and payment solutions rather than a single product.

   for selected candidates

Submit an updated resume highlighting:

* Your sales and business development experience, and the products you have handled

Dhaniti™ does not charge candidates any fee at any stage of the recruitment process.

Field Sales | Business Development | Education Finance | Student Fee Finance | Fee Receivables Finance | DhanitiPay™ | B2B Sales | B2B2C Sales | Customer Acquisition | Institutional Partnerships | DSA & Channel Development | Digital Lending | Fintech

title: Finance Executive – Internal Audit & Financial Controls
description:
**Experience**

0 – 2 Years

**Qualification**

B. Com / MBA (Finance) / CA / CA Inter / CMA Inter

Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls, and audit procedures.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP/Accounting systems such as Zoho Books, Tally, SAP, Oracle,

QuickBooks, or equivalent.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Finance Executive to support the Finance function with a primary focus on transaction verification, internal controls, financial compliance, and audit readiness. The rolerequires a strong understanding of accounting processes and an investigative mindset to review financial transactions at a granular level, identify exceptions, and ensure adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.

The incumbent will play a key role in strengthening the organization's control environment by performing detailed reviews of accounting transactions, supporting statutory and internal audits, monitoring compliance, and contributing to process improvement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

Internal Audit & Financial Controls

 Perform detailed verification of accounting transactions, journal entries, invoices, receipts, payment

vouchers, expense claims, and supporting documentation.

 Evaluate transactions for completeness, accuracy, validity, and compliance with internal policies and

approval matrices.

 Identify control gaps, process deviations, duplicate transactions, unusual entries, and potential financial

risks.

 Prepare audit observations, exception reports, root cause analyses, and corrective action

recommendations.

 Maintain audit working papers and supporting documentation for management review and external audits.

 Support the implementation and continuous improvement of internal control frameworks.

**Accounts Payable & Vendor Management**

 Verify vendor invoices against contracts, purchase orders, approvals, and supporting documents.

 Review vendor reconciliations and identify discrepancies for resolution.

 Assist in preparing payment schedules and ensuring timely vendor settlements.

**Accounts Receivable & Revenue Assurance**

 Review customer invoices and supporting documentation for accuracy.

 Assist in customer account reconciliations and revenue validation exercises.

 Support revenue recognition and billing control processes.

**Financial Reporting & Compliance**

 Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities.

 Prepare schedules and supporting documents for management reporting.

 Support statutory compliance activities relating to GST, TDS, Income Tax, and other applicable regulations.

**Process Improvement & Risk Management**

 Participate in finance process reviews and control assessments.

 Support risk identification and mitigation initiatives within finance operations.

 Assist in developing and updating finance policies, procedures, and control documentation.

**Required Competencies Technical Competencies**

 Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting.

 Understanding of internal audit methodologies and internal financial controls.

 Knowledge of GST, TDS, statutory compliance, and audit documentation.

 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, Lookup Functions and Reconciliations.

 Experience working with ERP and accounting systems.

Behavioural Competencies

 High attention to detail and accuracy.

 Professional scepticism and risk-oriented mindset.

 Strong organizational and documentation skills.

 Ability to handle confidential information with integrity.

 EƯective communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

 Accuracy and quality of transaction verification.

 Timely completion of reconciliations and audit reviews.

 Compliance with internal policies and statutory requirements.

 Audit readiness and quality of supporting documentation.

 Closure rate of audit observations and corrective actions.

 Contribution towards process improvements and control enhancements.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is an early-career finance professional with a strong foundation in accounting and a keen interest in Internal Audit, Financial Controls, Compliance, and Risk Management. The individual should possess the ability to review transactions critically, identify anomalies, challenge inconsistencies, and contribute to building a robust financial control environment.

This role oƯers an excellent opportunity to develop expertise in Internal Audit, Financial Governance, Compliance Management, and Financial Operations within a fast-paced and growing organization.

title: Sr. Analyst FP&A, SKYWAVE
description:
**Join Us as FP&A Manager, SKYWAVE!**
Are you a hands-on finance professional who thrives on turning complex data into actionable business insights? We are seeking an analytical and detail-oriented FP&A Manager to play a key role in driving financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and business decision support across a global organization for SKYWAVE, an ORBCOMM company.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for a finance leader with a strong accounting and analytical foundation, ideally gained through a Big 4 accounting firm and global business exposure.
  
  
**Why You'll Love Working Here**
As an FP&A Manager, you will be a critical partner to finance and business leaders, supporting strategic planning, forecasting, reporting, and commercial decision-making.
  
  
Based in Hyderabad in a hybrid work environment, you will collaborate closely with managers and stakeholders located in the United States and Canada, gaining exposure to global operations and cross-functional business initiatives.
  
  
This role offers a highly visible opportunity to influence business performance through rigorous analysis, financial modeling, and insightful recommendations.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting**

* Support the annual budgeting process, including development of assumptions, detailed financial models, and budget consolidations.
* Support periodic and rolling forecast processes by updating models, analyzing trends, and validating assumptions.
* Maintain and enhance revenue, backlog, and headcount forecasting models.
* Develop and track business unit capital expenditure ( CapEx ) and operating expenditure ( OpEx ) performance.

**Financial Reporting & Performance Analysis**

* Support monthly financial reporting processes, including Flash reporting and Growth Day materials.
* Maintain key financial and operational metrics used for performance analysis, forecasting, and budgeting.
* Perform variance analysis, including actual versus budget and forecast bridge analyses with clear driver-based commentary.
* Provide insights and recommendations to support business performance and decision-making.

**Business Partnering & Commercial Finance Support**

* Prepare initial deal models and supporting CRB presentation materials.
* Partner with Sales teams to validate deal assumptions and assess financial impacts.
* Conduct account-level pricing, profitability, and revenue impact analyses.
* Support budget control activities, including purchase requisitions (PRs), purchase orders (POs), invoicing, and related processes.

**Data Management, Modeling & Operational Support**

* Perform ad hoc financial analyses, reporting, and scenario modeling as required.
* Support month-end close activities and planning/BI data integrity initiatives.
* Work with large datasets and reporting tools to ensure accuracy, consistency, and actionable insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, financial models, and analytical capabilities.

**Who You Are**
You are a highly analytical finance professional who enjoys solving business problems through data, financial modeling, and collaboration. You are comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and partnering with stakeholders across multiple geographies and functions.
  
  
**If You Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance , Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
* CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.
* Experience within a Big 4 accounting firm strongly preferred.
* Progressive experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Corporate Finance, or Commercial Finance.
* Experience supporting global organizations and collaborating with international stakeholders.
* Strong financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and business analysis skills.
* Experience performing variance analysis and translating financial results into business insights.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling techniques.
* Experience working with ERP systems, planning tools, business intelligence platforms, and large datasets.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence business partners.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* Experience in a private equity-backed company preferred.
* Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
* Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

Then we want to meet you!
  
  
**The Benefits Of Working Here**
A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.
  
  
**How We Hire**
ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture.
  
  
**About Us**
At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at  www.orbcomm.com !
  
  
**Ready to Join Us?**
We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you.
  
  
We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
  
  
At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

title: Financial Control Manager
description:
**About The Role**
Responsible for managing assigned legal entities, ensuring accurate and timely financial closure, maintaining strong internal controls, supporting management reporting and statutory audits, and driving process efficiencies through ERP systems and automation.

The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of accounting principles, the ability to independently manage finance operations, and a continuous improvement mindset.

**What You'll be Responsible for?**

**1.Financial Accounting & Entity Controllership**

* Manage day-to-day general ledger accounting and ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial records.
* Review and oversee journal entries, accruals, provisions, prepaid expenses, amortisation and other month-end adjustments.
* Prepare and review balance sheet schedules, account reconciliations and supporting documentation.
* Ensure appropriate accounting treatment in accordance with applicable Ind AS and company accounting policies.
* Monitor ledger balances, identify unusual movements and resolve accounting discrepancies.

**2.Month-End, Quarter-End & Year-End Closing**

* Drive timely closure of assigned legal entities in accordance with the financial closing calendar.
* Prepare and review trial balances, reconciliations, closing schedules and financial reporting deliverables.
* Ensure completeness of revenue, expenses, liabilities, provisions and other material balances.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve open items and ensure reporting deadlines are met.

**3. Financial Reporting & Compliance**

* Prepare financial statements, management reporting schedules and other financial information required for internal and external reporting.
* Support quarterly and annual financial reporting requirements under applicable Ind AS.
* Ensure consistency between general ledger balances, financial statements and supporting schedules.
* Maintain adequate documentation for accounting judgments, estimates and significant transactions.

**4. Intercompany Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Manage intercompany receivables, payables and general ledger balances across legal entities.
* Perform periodic intercompany reconciliations and investigate differences between counterparties.
* Coordinate with entity finance teams to resolve mismatches, timing differences and incorrect postings.
* Ensure timely confirmation and settlement of intercompany balances, wherever applicable.

**5. Budgeting, MIS & Expense Analysis**

* Support annual budgeting, periodic forecasting and expense planning processes.
* Analyse expenses by legal entity, general ledger account, vendor and expense category.
* Prepare management information reports and provide actionable insights to finance leadership.
* Monitor provisions, prepaid expenses and recurring expenditure to support accurate financial reporting.

**6. Audit, Internal Controls & Governance**

* Coordinate with statutory auditors and internal auditors for assigned entities and processes.
* Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents and responses to audit queries.
* Ensure adherence to internal financial controls, accounting policies and delegated approval procedures.
* Identify control gaps and implement corrective actions to strengthen the financial reporting process.

**7. ERP, Data Management & Finance Automation**

* Work with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) or comparable ERP platforms for accounting, reporting and financial data extraction.
* Analyse financial data extracted from ERP systems and perform validation and reconciliation checks.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting, reconciliation and reporting activities.
* Leverage advanced Excel, Power Query, Power BI, Python or other relevant tools to improve efficiency and accuracy.
* Support ERP enhancements, finance transformation initiatives and standardisation of accounting processes.

**8. Stakeholder Management & Process Ownership**

* Coordinate with accounts payable, procurement, treasury, tax, business teams and other finance stakeholders.
* Independently manage assigned deliverables and ensure timely resolution of outstanding issues.
* Maintain process documentation, trackers and standard operating procedures.
* Drive continuous improvement in reporting accuracy, turnaround time and process controls.

Ideal Candidate Profile

**Ideal Candidate Profile,**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).
* Approximately 3-5 years of relevant post-qualification experience in finance and accounts.
* Strong hands-on experience in general ledger accounting, month-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations and financial reporting.
* Experience in a corporate, technology, SaaS, IT services or multi-entity environment will be preferred.
* Exposure to group reporting, intercompany accounting and management reporting is desirable.

**Technical Skills & Competencies**

**Essential**

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and applicable Ind AS.
* Hands-on experience in financial closing and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to investigate accounting differences.
* Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
* Experience working with ERP systems and large financial datasets.
* Ability to manage multiple deliverables within tight reporting deadlines.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving.
* Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
* Continuous improvement and process automation mindset.
* Ability to identify risks, resolve issues and recommend practical solutions.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Ensure timely and accurate financial closure for assigned entities.
* Maintain complete and well-supported balance sheet reconciliations.
* Ensure reliable financial reporting and compliance with applicable accounting standards.
* Resolve intercompany differences and outstanding accounting issues within agreed timelines.
* Provide meaningful financial analysis to support management decisions.
* Maintain audit readiness and effective financial controls.
* Improve finance productivity through standardization, automation and process optimization.

**Why join us?**

* **Impactful Work:**
  Play a pivotal role in safeguarding Tanla's assets, data, and reputation in the industry.
* **Tremendous Growth Opportunities**
  : Be part of a rapidlygrowing company in the telecom and CPaaS space, with opportunities for professional development.
* **Innovative Environment:**
  Work alongside a world-class team in a challenging and fun environment, where innovation is celebrated.

Tanla is an equal opportunity employer. We championdiversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
**Overview**
JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.
  
  
Our 1,300+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products - ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.
  
  
For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Finops Engineer to support our Cloud FinOps practice. This role will work closely with the FinOps Manager and CloudOps team.
  
  
We’re looking for Someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. This role needs a self-starter who drives cost initiatives to closure with minimal hand-holding - flags issues before they’re asked to, follows up without being chased, and treats savings targets as something they’re personally accountable for.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end validation of cost optimization opportunities (rightsizing, idle resource clean-up, storage optimization) - not just flagging them, but following through to closure.
* Act as the technical liaison with engineering/tech teams when recommendations are challenged or denied, bringing data-backed validation and alternative options rather than escalating every pushback upward.
* Independently prepare and distribute regular cloud cost and usage reports, proactively surfacing anomalies or trends rather than waiting to be asked.
* Drive daily follow-up on open optimization opportunities - ownership means nothing sits stale in a tracker; you chase it until it’s implemented.
* Execute optimizations directly: rightsizing, terminating idle resources, scheduling non-prod resources, applying storage lifecycle policies.
* Maintain FinOps hygiene - tagging governance, anomaly detection, budget adherence — as an ongoing discipline, not a periodic task.
* Keep a clear, self-maintained progress tracker on savings initiatives and proactively update leadership without being chased for status.
* Monitor usage trends across cloud providers (including GCP, if multi-cloud) to catch new/unexpected usage early rather than after it hits the bill.
* Support RI/Savings Plan lifecycle management — tracking expirations, recommending renewals or exchanges, and coordinating sign-off with relevant stakeholders (e.g., DBA, engineering).
* Contribute to monthly/quarterly cost forecasting and variance analysis (actuals vs. budget/forecast).

**Position Requirements**

* 4–6 years in cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred).
* Solid understanding of AWS services (EC2, EBS, S3, RDS, etc.) and their cost drivers.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset - someone who takes an opportunity from identification to closure without needing to be reminded.
* Familiarity with savings instruments such as RIs and Savings Plans.
* Exposure to FinOps principles and frameworks (e.g., FinOps Foundation).
* Hands-on experience with AWS Cost Explorer, CUR, and reporting/monitoring tools (Athena, QuickSight, or equivalent third-party tools).
* Strong communication and follow-up discipline - able to coordinate with tech teams and push initiatives to execution, not just raise them.
* Ability to analyze reports and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Scripting ability (Python or SQL) for automation of reporting/optimization tasks - mandatory, at least one.

**Preferred Skills**

* Proven track record of operating independently with minimal supervision - this role requires someone who proactively drives initiatives forward, not someone who waits for direction.
* Prior experience owning a cost-optimization book of work end-to-end (not just execution of assigned tasks).
* Exposure to multi-cloud environments (GCP, Azure) beyond AWS.
* Familiarity with tracking cost/usage for AI tooling or token-based consumption models – a plus

**What We Offer**
At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life.
  
  
**Our Values - T.E.A.M**
At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.
  
  

* Transparency - Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.
* Entrepreneurial Spirit – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth
* Accountability – Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere
* Metrics-Driven Results – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.
