title: Principal Analyst, Escheatment & Unclaimed Property
description:
**Job Summary**
Own and scale Blackbaud’s U.S. escheatment and unclaimed property program, including overpayments, credits, and dormant customer balances. This role is responsible for building processes, ensuring multi-state compliance, and reducing financial and regulatory risk across the Order-to-Cash lifecycle.
  
  
**Work Location & Schedule**
**Work Location:**
Sky tech, Financial District, Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Work Schedule**

* This role supports customers and stakeholders primarily during U.S. business hours.
* Expected working hours are 11:00 AM to 08:00 PM IST, with occasional flexibility required to support collaboration with U.S.-based teams and business needs.
* Participation in after-hours support rotations and select holiday coverage may be required based on product, region, or business needs.

**Position Summary**
Blackbaud is seeking a Principal Analyst, Unclaimed Property & Escheatment to establish, own, and scale a new U.S. unclaimed property compliance program from our Hyderabad location. This individual contributor will serve as the operational and technical subject matter expert for the end-to-end lifecycle of unclaimed property, including identification, research, due diligence, reporting, remittance, reconciliation, audit support, and ongoing monitoring.
  
  
The Principal Analyst will build the program foundation, create sustainable processes and controls, and partner across Finance, Order-to-Cash, Accounting, Treasury, Payroll, Legal, Tax, and Financial Systems. The role is designed for a hands-on program owner who can independently translate regulatory requirements into practical operations, reduce compliance risk, and develop a scalable model that supports Blackbaud as the business grows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Build and Own the Program
  
  

* Create and operationalize Blackbaud's U.S. unclaimed property and escheatment program from the ground up.
* Establish the program governance model, property-type inventory, state compliance calendar, risk assessment, roles and responsibilities, approval framework, and escalation paths.
* Develop policies, standard operating procedures, process maps, decision documentation, work instructions, and evidence-retention standards.
* Serve as the primary operational owner and internal subject matter expert for holder-side unclaimed property compliance.

Compliance, Due Diligence, and Reporting
  
  

* Own the end-to-end compliance cycle for applicable U.S. states, legal entities, and property types.
* Interpret and maintain state-specific requirements, including dormancy periods, due diligence thresholds, owner outreach, reporting formats, filing deadlines, and remittance requirements.
* Prepare, review, and submit accurate and timely state reports and payments through applicable portals or third-party filing tools.
* Monitor regulatory changes, assess operational impacts, and coordinate required updates to processes and controls.
* Coordinate owner outreach and due diligence efforts to return funds to rightful owners whenever possible.

Research, Reconciliation, and Root-Cause Reduction
  
  

* Identify and investigate potentially escheatable property, including customer credit balances, unapplied cash, unidentified remittances, refunds, vendor payments, payroll items, and other dormant obligations.
* Analyze large datasets from ERP, billing, CRM, banking, payroll, and related systems to determine ownership, jurisdiction, dormancy, and appropriate disposition.
* Reconcile unclaimed property populations and filings to general ledger balances, subledgers, bank activity, and supporting schedules.
* Partner with operational teams to resolve aged balances and address root causes such as duplicate payments, application issues, billing errors, and incomplete owner information before property becomes reportable.

Controls, Audit Readiness, and Risk Management
  
  

* Design, document, and execute preventive and detective controls supporting complete, accurate, and timely compliance.
* Maintain audit-ready support for research conclusions, due diligence, approvals, filings, remittances, reconciliations, and exceptions.
* Lead operational support for internal audits, state examinations, voluntary disclosure efforts, regulatory inquiries, and remediation activities.
* Identify compliance gaps and emerging risks, recommend practical solutions, and communicate issues clearly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Automation, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Develop dashboards, compliance trackers, aging views, key risk indicators, and performance metrics that provide visibility to program health.
* Use Excel and available analytics, automation, and AI capabilities to reduce manual effort, strengthen data quality, and improve repeatability.
* Partner with Financial Systems and process owners on system enhancements, data requirements, testing, and future-state process design.
* Create a scalable operating model that can support additional property types, legal entities, jurisdictions, and future team growth.

Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Build strong working relationships across Order-to-Cash, Accounting, Treasury, Payroll, Tax, Legal, Financial Systems, Internal Audit, and other business teams.
* Provide practical guidance and training to stakeholders on unclaimed property requirements, responsibilities, and prevention opportunities.
* Influence outcomes without direct authority and drive decisions through clear analysis, documented requirements, and effective stakeholder communication.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7 or more years of experience in U.S. unclaimed property, escheatment, regulated financial compliance, accounting operations, controllership, treasury, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated holder-side experience with multistate U.S. unclaimed property compliance, including due diligence, reporting, remittance, and reconciliation.
* Experience independently building, stabilizing, or materially improving a compliance process or program.
* Ability to interpret state requirements and translate them into clear operational processes and controls.
* Strong analytical and investigative skills, including experience working with large and complex datasets.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong documentation, project ownership, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to manage fixed regulatory deadlines, competing priorities, and complex issues with a high degree of independence and accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills and experience partnering with U.S.-based stakeholders.

Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality and actively experiment with emerging capabilities as they evolve.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience owning state audits, voluntary disclosure agreements, regulatory examinations, or penalty-resolution activities.
* Experience in a U.S. public company, SaaS organization, global business services environment, or India GCC / shared services model.
* Knowledge of customer credit balances, unapplied cash, refunds, vendor payments, payroll property, and related accounting flows.
* Experience with Power BI, Alteryx, SQL, workflow tools, or similar reporting and automation capabilities.
* Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Workday, SAP, or comparable ERP, CRM, billing, and financial systems.
* Relevant accounting, finance, audit, compliance, project management, or unclaimed property training or certification.

description:
Your opportunity
  
  
At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
  
  
Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region
  
  
The Schwab Asset Management (SAM) Technology organization is a part of Schwab Technology Services that is responsible for Schwab's investment management, operations, data, and research platforms. Everything that SAM Tech builds serves Schwab’s mission of helping clients reach their financial goals.
  
  
What you have
  
  
**Key Responsbilities**
As a Quantitative Analyst - Investment Research in the SAM Investment Research Technology group, you will play a critical role in delivering cutting-edge research and product development capabilities designed to advance SAM business opportunities and to support the Schwab Center for Financial Research (SCFR) in its mission to provide clients and advisors actionable investment advice. We curate structured and unstructured datasets for both exploratory and product-focused research, and we implement and maintain investment models across multiple asset classes and product categoriess, including equity and fund ratings, thematic investing baskets, multi-asset solutions, factor strategies, and more.
  
  
This role will interact with researchers and other business users to help bring together data, analytics, modeling, and operational capabilities into a common ecosystem for all research teams. You will help establish the foundational capabilities, frameworks, and workflows that enable innovative research products, accelerate time-to-market, and promote greater reuse of data and technology assets across the organization. This is an opportunity to help define the future state of quantitative research technology at Schwab.

▪ Experience partnering with researchers, analysts, product owners, or business stakeholders to gather requirements and implement technology solutions that support data-driven decision-making

* Expertise to create data visualizations that drive effective decision-making

▪ Proven ability to collaborate effectively within Agile and DevOps environments, partnering with Product Owners, Architects, engineers, and governance teams to deliver high-quality solutions that meet enterprise standards for quality, reliability, and supportability
  
  
**Preffered Qualifications**
▪ Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, quantitative finance, or a related technical discipline
  
  
▪ Experience supporting quantitative investment research, model development, backtesting, portfolio analytics, performance attribution, or other investment management workflows
  
  
▪ Demonstrated ability to uncover complex patterns and insights through advanced analysis of large and diverse datasets
  
  
▪ Experience developing data visualization, self-service analytics, and researcher-facing tooling that transforms data into actionable insights and improves decision-making
  
  
▪ Experience evaluating and applying emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, or advanced analytics techniques, to improve platform capabilities and researcher productivity
  
  
▪ Strong verbal and written communication skills, including experience presenting technical concepts, architectural proposals, and analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  
  
▪ Track record of championing innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement through the adoption of new technologies, engineering practices, or operating models

At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. The role focuses on enabling executive decision-making through structured governance, financial analysis, cross-functional program management, and stakeholder alignment across global leadership teams.
  
  
This role partners closely with global leadership, engineering teams, HR, finance, and vendors to ensure operational excellence while supporting the strategic growth of the GCC within the healthcare and oncology ecosystem.

**. Month-End, Quarter-End, and Year-End Close Support**

* Ensure accounting processes comply with SOX requirements, company policies, and internal control standards.

* Build a culture of accountability, transparency, and strong documentation across the GCC controllership team.

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that modernize accounting processes and enhance the GCC’s strategic value.

* Identify opportunities to automate manual accounting processes, reconciliations, reporting schedules, variance analyses, and exception reviews.

* Support the design of future-state accounting processes for the GCC, including standard work, global process ownership, and service-level expectations.
* Lead projects to improve close efficiency, reduce manual entries, improve reconciliation quality, and increase visibility into accounting risks.
* Help define KPIs and operational metrics for accounting and analytics processes.
* Promote adoption of AI-enabled and analytics-driven finance practices, while ensuring appropriate governance, controls, and data quality.

* Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP; IFRS knowledge is a plus.
* Experience supporting month-end close, financial reporting, technical accounting, audit, and internal controls.
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting large data sets and identifying accounting risks or unusual trends.
* Experience working in a global finance environment, shared services center, global capability center, or multinational organization.

* Ability to prepare high-quality accounting memos, management summaries, and audit support.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills across global teams and time zones.
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing teams, developing talent, and leading process improvements.

We are building dual-arm, highly dexterous, contextually intelligent robots for electronics and automotive assembly, e-commerce packaging, food preparation, and other real-world environments.As we move from prototypes to customer pilots and deployments, we need someone who treats operational follow-through as a core part of delivering the product. You will help ensure that no commercial or deployment detail falls through the cracks—from the first sales quote to final payment collection.If you are diligent, highly organized, persistent, and take genuine ownership of getting things completed, this is that role.What You’ll Actually DoYou will sit at the intersection of sales, finance, operations, engineering, procurement, logistics, and customers. Your work will create the operational backbone that helps Perceptyne run pilots, ship systems, invoice customers, and collect revenue reliably.Create, review, track, and maintain accurate sales finance.Follow up professionally and persistently on receivables, outstanding approvals, pending POs, invoice acknowledgements, payment commitments, and overdue collections.Build and maintain correct robot configuration, spare parts, tools, documentation, and accessories are available before shipment.Support domestic and, over time, international shipping and logistics processes, including packing lists, e-way bills, transport coordination, insurance, dispatch tracking, delivery proof, and export documentation where applicable.Maintain accurate CRM, ERP, spreadsheets, trackers, and document repositories so that the latest commercial and operational status is always visible.Identify missing information, inconsistent data, commercial risks, delayed dependencies, and process gaps before they become customer-facing problems.Improve operational processes as the company grows—moving from one-off coordination to repeatable systems, templates, checklists, dashboards, and ownership mechanisms.What We’re Looking ForThis role is for someone who combines attention to detail with a strong bias toward closure. You should be able to build and maintain clean trackers, use formulas, validate data, and make operational status easy to understand.Ability to work with structured systems such as CRM, ERP, accounting software, inventory tools, or project-management tools.Clear written and verbal communication. You can write professional customer emails, summarize status concisely, and escalate risks early.Ability to prioritize multiple time-sensitive workstreams without losing track of details.Comfort working on-site in a fast-moving, cross-functional robotics company in Hyderabad.Nice to HaveThese are useful but not mandatory. Apply if the core of the role fits you.Experience in a B2B technology, industrial automation, robotics, manufacturing, SaaS, hardware, or engineering-services company.Experience handling hardware sales, capital-equipment orders, industrial projects, pilot deployments, or field-service coordination.Familiarity with Indian GST invoicing, e-invoicing, e-way bills, transport documentation, and basic accounts-receivable processes.Experience using Zoho, Tally, Salesforce, HubSpot, Odoo, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar CRM/ERP/accounting systems.Exposure to procurement, inventory management, vendor coordination, warehouse operations, or supply-chain planning.Familiarity with contracts, statements of work, commercial terms, payment milestones, delivery acceptance, or customer onboarding.Experience with export logistics, customs documentation, international shipping, or shipping insurance.A background in engineering or a genuine interest in robotics and industrial technology.How We WorkAt Perceptyne, we like to build things, evangelize great ideas, and stay grounded. title: Senior Technical Revenue Accountant
description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
**Summary:**
Genesys is looking for a passionate Senior Technical Revenue Accountant to join our growing team! The Senior Technical Revenue Accountant will support complex contract reviews, technical accounting assessments, and revenue recognition matters across Genesys’ product and service offerings.
  
  
This is not a typical revenue accounting role. The position requires strong technical accounting skills, critical thinking, and the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities. The Senior Technical Revenue Accountant will perform ad hoc analyses, evaluate complex contract terms and deal structures, and partner closely with Deal Desk, Sales, Legal, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to determine the appropriate revenue accounting treatment. The ideal candidate will play an important role in ensuring accurate revenue recognition while helping the business navigate complex and evolving commercial arrangements. The role requires the ability to translate technical accounting conclusions into practical guidance that supports business objectives while maintaining compliance with Company policy.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
The primary responsibilities for this role include (but are not limited to);
  
  
Technical Revenue:
  
  

* Review complex customer contracts, amendments, and non-standard transactions to determine the appropriate revenue recognition treatment under ASC 606 and Company policy.
* Research technical accounting guidance and prepare clear, well-supported accounting assessments and memoranda for complex or judgmental transactions.
* Evaluate new and evolving products, pricing models, and commercial arrangements to determine revenue recognition implications.
* Exercise independent judgment in analyzing complex or novel transactions, develop well-supported accounting conclusions, and escalate significant or highly judgmental matters as appropriate.
* Support the development, documentation, and consistent application of revenue recognition policies and accounting positions.

Deal Desk, Sales, and Customer Success Management Support:
  
  

* Partner closely with Deal Desk, Sales, Legal, Finance, Order Management, and other cross-functional teams to provide revenue recognition guidance throughout the contracting process.
* Review proposed deal structures, contract terms, and non-standard provisions prior to execution, identify potential accounting implications, and recommend solutions that balance business objectives with revenue recognition requirements.
* Serve as a technical revenue resource to business partners, clearly communicating complex accounting concepts and helping stakeholders understand the revenue implications of proposed arrangements.
* Support timely resolution of complex and urgent deal-related questions in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

Policy, Projects & Compliance
  
  

* Assist with the development and delivery of ASC 606 policies, guidance, tools, and training for Revenue and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Participate in strategic and ad hoc initiatives, including new product launches, new pricing and consumption models, acquisitions, process improvements, and other evolving business needs.
* Prepare and maintain appropriate documentation supporting significant revenue accounting conclusions, internal controls, and external audit requirements.
* Partner with Revenue Operations and other teams on system or process changes where technical revenue accounting requirements or conclusions need to be incorporated into implementation.
* Translate technical accounting conclusions into practical guidance and process documentation to support consistent application of Company policy across the business.
* Support external audit requests and quarterly reviews by preparing documentation and explaining the accounting conclusions underlying complex transactions.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum 3 years of related Revenue Recognition (ASC 606) experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification (or progress toward qualification) preferred.
* Experience in revenue accounting within a software, SaaS, or technology environment preferred.
* Ability to interact effectively with sales and product teams, functional peer groups and subordinates and to gain cooperation from others, especially those in other departments, as well as with outside auditors and outside legal counsel.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of multiple concurrent and diversified tasks, while working with deadlines.
* Confidence and proven record to communicate both orally and written, including the dissemination of technical information.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Highly organized, with great attention to detail.
* Problem solver: The candidate should be a strong, analytical problem solver with a common sense and practical solutions orientation.

**Desirable Skills:**

* Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM), Salesforce, revenue recognition systems (e.g., RevPro), or ERP systems (e.g., Workday) preferred.
* Prior experience with SaaS company.
* Experience with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools.
* Public accounting experience.
* Advanced in Excel.

**Working at Genesys**

* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.
  
  
**What Happens After You Apply**
After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:
  
  

* Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
* A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.
* Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
* We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases
* After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.
  
  
**Stay Connected**
Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.
  
  
Get notified about relevant opportunities.
  
  
**Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.**
**Employee Referral**
If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral.
  
  
**About Genesys:**
Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys Cloud™ is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit www.genesys.ai.

title: Analyst, Corporate card & Expense
company: Advance Auto Parts India (India Innovation Center)
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title :**
Corporate Card and Expense Analyst
  
  
**Location :**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Corporate Card and Expense Analyst for the Corporate Card & Expense Team assists in maintaining the Corporate Expense Card and Corporate Store Purchasing Card programs. This role provides support and maintenance of the expense tool programs for Corporate Team Members and delivers excellent experiences for Stores and Team Members with their credit card and expense needs.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Process Corporate Card applications for Team Members and Stores.
* Download PCard Bank Statements and ensure proper approvals are obtained for payments.
* Maintain, troubleshoot, and resolve inquiries for expense tools and systems
* Ensure adherence of Corporate Card and Expense Policies and identify and communicate non-compliance.
* Audit expense reports for Policy compliance and correspond as needed.
* Maintain reporting and communications to ensure timely submission and approvals of expenses.
* Track and process payments for expense related funds that are due company and maintain information relative to expense related funds that are due to Team Member.
* Run reports to ensure PCard Transactions are accurately reported in accounting and report any errors.
* Ensure all cardholder requests and expense questions are handled accurately and in a professional and timely manner.
* Analyze and monitor PCard transactions for anomalies, non-compliance of policies and potential fraud.
* Provide support to the Finance Team, Asset Protection and key business partners regarding PCard usage and reporting.
* Assist in documentation, monitoring and testing of internal controls for Finance.
* Identify areas for improvement of current processes.
* Participate in special project work as required, such as systems implementation and testing, etc.
* Maintain high integrity and ethics when handling Corporate Credit Card information and situations.
* Ability to understand, interpret and abide by Company Policy

**Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with the ability to organize, review, and work with financial and transactional data.
* Understanding of accounting principles, expense processing, and reconciliation practices.
* Experience supporting corporate purchasing or expense card (PCard) programs, including assisting with cardholder inquiries and administration.
* Ability to learn and use expense management systems, follow established procedures, and help ensure expense policy compliance.
* Ability and willingness to train team members enterprise wide on card procedures and expense submission processes through email, screen sharing and video calls.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to review data, identify discrepancies, and escalate issues as appropriate.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a customer-service mindset and the ability to interact professionally with team members.
* Organized and dependable self-starter who can manage multiple tasks, prioritize work, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work collaboratively across teams, adapt to changing priorities, and maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive financial information.

**Certifications, Experience, And Education**

* Certifications: N/A
* Experience: 2-4 years related experience and/or training
* Education: High school diploma, Bachelor’s degree preferred

**Location & Work Availability:**

* This position is Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 days remote), based at our AIIC office.

Advance Auto Parts, Inc. is a leading automotive aftermarket parts provider that serves both professional installer and do-it-yourself customers. As of January 3, 2026, Advance operated 4,305 stores primarily within the United States, with additional locations in Canada, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. The Company also served 809 independently owned Carquest branded stores across these locations in addition to Mexico and various Caribbean islands. title: Kandou Template
description:
**About Kandou AI**
Kandou AI is a fast-growing semiconductor company developing advanced connectivity and memory fabric solutions for AI infrastructure. India is an important part of our global engineering organization, with growing teams in Hyderabad, Bangalore and Pune.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Administration & Procurement Manager to support our expanding India operations.
  
  
**The Role**
Based in Hyderabad, you will manage key procurement and administrative processes for Kandou India, working closely with our Finance team in Switzerland, India Operations, employees, vendors, banks, Kandou’s external accounting and compliance provider and other external service providers.
  
  
This is a hands-on role requiring strong ownership of the procure-to-pay process, vendor coordination, payment and import documentation, and day-to-day administration. The role has a strong international dimension, with regular interaction with global teams and overseas suppliers, including management of cross-border payments and the related banking and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage procurement activities across Kandou India, including sourcing, quotations, vendor selection, negotiations, purchase orders and delivery follow-up.
* Manage vendor onboarding, contracts and supplier relationships, ensuring appropriate commercial terms and documentation.
* Coordinate the procure-to-pay process, including PO and invoice matching, approvals, payment documentation and resolution of outstanding items.
* Manage the administrative requirements related to payments to foreign vendors, working with banks and external service providers to ensure complete and timely documentation for cross-border transactions.
* Support import and logistics administration, including bills of entry, airway bills, E-Way Bills and other customs or banking documentation.
* Work closely with the India Operations Manager on equipment shipments, customs clearance and inter-office movements.
* Working closely with Kandou’s external accounting and compliance provider to ensure accurate and timely ERP transactions/journal entries and supporting Kandou Finance with month-end activities, reconciliations and maintenance of complete, audit-ready documentation.
* Support office administration, facilities and employee onboarding requirements in Hyderabad.
* Maintain clear reporting on procurement, contracts, payments and key open items, and drive process improvements as the business grows.

**What we are looking for**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in procurement, administration, finance operations or supply chain.
* Experience working in an international or multinational environment, with regular interaction across countries, cultures and time zones.
* Good understanding of end-to-end procurement and procure-to-pay processes.
* Experience with vendor sourcing, commercial negotiation, purchase orders and contract administration.
* Practical experience managing payments to overseas vendors, including banking documentation, foreign remittances, regulatory requirements and resolution of payment-related exceptions.
* Comfortable working with and holding accountable an outsourced accounting/compliance provider – reviewing their output, resolving issues, chasing turnaround times, and escalating issues rather than waiting passively for resolution.
* Working knowledge of India payment, GST, E-Way Bill and import/export documentation requirements.
* Experience working with ERP systems; Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is an advantage.
* Strong Excel, organizational and analytical skills.
* Strong communication skills and professional fluency in English.
* Proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow issues through to resolution.

**Preferred**

* Experience in semiconductor, electronics, engineering or technology companies.
* Experience with imported technical or laboratory equipment.
* Familiarity with STPI requirements.
* Hindi or Telugu language skills.

title: General Ledger (R2R) - Senior Process Analyst
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.
  
  
**About Broadridge:**
Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. (NYSE: BR) is a global Fintech leader providing technology, communications, data, and analytics solutions to the financial services industry. Broadridge helps banks, broker-dealers, asset managers, and other financial institutions operate more efficiently and deliver better experiences to their clients.
  
  
At Broadridge, we foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning, where employees are empowered to take ownership, develop their careers, and make a meaningful impact.
  
  
**Purpose of the Job:**
The
**General Ledger – Record to Report (R2R)**
professional will be responsible for supporting key accounting and financial close activities, ensuring accurate and timely recording of financial transactions in accordance with accounting policies and applicable standards.
  
  
The role will support month-end and year-end close activities, account reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and financial reporting while working closely with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  
  
This position offers an opportunity to build strong expertise in
**General Ledger accounting, R2R processes, financial controls, and financial reporting**
within a global organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform day-to-day General Ledger and Record-to-Report activities.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes within defined timelines.
* Prepare, review, and post journal entries in accordance with accounting policies.
* Perform Balance Sheet account reconciliations and investigate and resolve reconciling items.
* Prepare and account for accruals, prepayments, provisions, and reclassifications.
* Perform P&L and Balance Sheet analysis and identify unusual or incorrect balances.
* Support intercompany accounting and reconciliations as required.
* Ensure accounting transactions are recorded accurately and within the appropriate accounting period.
* Prepare supporting schedules and documentation for financial reporting and audit requirements.
* Investigate accounting discrepancies and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.
* Ensure compliance with established accounting policies, internal controls, and process guidelines.
* Support internal and external audit requirements by providing appropriate documentation and explanations.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, standardization, and automation within the R2R process.
* Maintain accurate process documentation and ensure adherence to defined SLAs and quality standards.
* Support ad-hoc accounting and reporting activities as required.

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in General Ledger, Record to Report, or Financial Accounting.
* Hands-on experience in month-end/quarter-end close activities.
* Strong understanding of journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, prepayments, and provisions.
* Good understanding of Balance Sheet and P&L accounting.
* Experience working with ERP/accounting systems; Oracle experience is an advantage.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and global stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in a Global Shared Services / Finance Operations / Captive / MNC environment.
* Exposure to US GAAP or other international accounting standards.
* Experience with BlackLine or similar reconciliation/accounting tools.
* Advanced knowledge of MS Excel.
* Exposure to process improvement, automation, or transition activities.

**Why Join Broadridge?**
**Global Exposure**
Work with a global Fintech organization and gain exposure to international accounting processes and stakeholders.
  
  
**Career Growth**
Build strong expertise in General Ledger, R2R, financial reporting, and controllership, creating opportunities for long-term career growth in Finance.
  
  
**Innovation & Automation**
Be part of a culture that encourages process improvement, automation, and the adoption of new technologies.
  
  
**Collaborative Culture**
Work with diverse teams and global stakeholders in an environment that values collaboration, inclusion, and continuous learning.
  
  
**Meaningful Impact**
Contribute to accurate and efficient financial reporting that supports business decision-making and Broadridge's global operations.
  
  
Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
We are looking for candidates who have
**hands-on R2R/General Ledger experience**
, strong accounting fundamentals, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple close activities within tight deadlines. Candidates who demonstrate
**ownership, learning agility, analytical thinking, and a continuous improvement mindset**
will be a strong fit for the role.
  
  
We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.
  
  
**Use of AI in Hiring**
As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

to join our growing Finance
  
  
team in India. In this role, you will play a critical part in managing end-to-end billing and
  
  
collections processes for our largest customers. You will be responsible for creating accurate
  
  
invoices using customer-specific templates and ensuring seamless submission through

teams is preferred.

title: Vice President – Fund Accounting (Global Opportunities, Value Opportunities and Emerging Markets Opportunities)

****Our Company****

The Vice President will play a key leadership role in building and developing the Global Opportunities, Value Opportunities and Emerging Markets Opportunities fund accounting team in Hyderabad. The role will combine technical fund accounting oversight with people leadership, capacity planning and the staged transition of work into the team.
  
  
The Vice President will initially support the review of selected co-investment funds and overflow assignments from other Oaktree offices. As the team develops, the role will support the assessment and phased transition of suitable, relatively straightforward preparation work from third-party service providers to the in-house team. The Vice President will work closely with the strategies’ fund accounting leadership, Hyderabad leadership, fund accounting teams in other offices, internal partners and external service providers to deliver accurate, timely and well-controlled reporting.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Team Leadership and Development: Build, lead and develop a high-performing team of fund accountants across varying levels, including input into hiring, onboarding, training, performance expectations and ongoing feedback.
* Resource and Capacity Planning: Assess resourcing requirements, allocate work across the team, monitor capacity and recommend changes needed to support current and anticipated workloads.
* Review Support: Partner with fund accounting teams in other Oaktree offices to onboard reviews for selected co-investment funds and overflow assignments, with clear ownership, timelines, escalation protocols and quality standards.
* Transition Management: Support a controlled, phased transition of appropriate fund preparation activities from third-party service providers to Hyderabad, beginning with the most straightforward funds and expanding as team capability and capacity develop.
* Fund Accounting Oversight: Oversee the review of monthly and quarterly close activities, including cash and investment reconciliations, portfolio activity, pricing and valuation support, expense accruals and management fee calculations.
* Review partner and investor allocations, incentive calculations, capital calls, distributions and other capital activity in accordance with governing documents.
* Financial Reporting: Review quarterly and annual financial statements and related reporting prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP, together with supporting schedules and audit deliverables.
* Review fund and client-specific performance calculations and consolidated information across the strategy, as applicable.
* Investment and Transaction Support: Understand the accounting and operational implications of distressed and opportunistic credit investments, including restructurings and other complex or event-driven transactions, and coordinate the appropriate treatment with relevant stakeholders.
* Cash and Liquidity Management: Oversee cash planning and liquidity monitoring for assigned funds, including commitments, drawdowns, distributions and the timely resolution of cash or position breaks.
* Service Provider Oversight: Review the quality and timeliness of work performed by external fund administrators, support issue resolution and service-provider discussions, and help assess activities that may be suitable for future transition in-house.
* Controls and Governance: Maintain effective financial reporting controls, review evidence and process documentation, and ensure procedures remain current as responsibilities move between teams or providers.
* Relationship Management: Coordinate with the investment team, client services, legal, tax, treasury, valuation, data management, auditors and other internal and external stakeholders to resolve issues and meet fund requirements.
* Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve workflows, strengthen controls and increase operational scale. Collaborate with Technology and Reporting and Performance teams on automation and reporting solutions, including Power BI or similar tools where appropriate.
* Respond to ad hoc requests from Opportunistic Credit leadership, the investment team, client services and other stakeholders, and perform other duties as required.

****Qualifications****

* At least 14 years of relevant accounting or audit experience within public accounting, investment management, fund administration or a combination of these environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams, managing capacity and allocating work across competing priorities.
* Strong knowledge of alternative investment fund accounting, including closed-end funds, co-investment vehicles and complex credit investments.
* Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and investment company accounting, including NAV processes, reconciliations, capital activity, allocations, management fees, incentive calculations and financial reporting.
* Experience reviewing work performed by external fund administrators and supporting service transitions or the development of an in-house operating model.
* Ability to understand and resolve complex accounting and operational issues associated with distressed, opportunistic and event-driven investments.
* Proven ability to lead process improvements, document standard operating procedures and implement effective controls and review standards.
* Strong project-management skills and the ability to plan and execute transitions in a measured, well-controlled manner.
* Experience with Geneva and Geneva World Investor is preferred.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of Word, Teams and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI or similar reporting and visualization tools is a plus.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, decision-making and communication skills, with strong attention to detail.

**Personal Attributes**

* Relationship Building: Works effectively with diverse teams and builds confidence with colleagues, senior stakeholders and third-party service providers.
* Communication: Communicates clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, and adapts messages to the needs of different audiences.
* Independence and Collaboration: Operates effectively with limited supervision while working collaboratively across offices, functions and service providers.
* Flexibility and Organization: Prioritizes high volumes of work, adapts to changing demands and timelines, and maintains quality in a fast-paced environment.
* Driving Results: Takes ownership, follows issues through to resolution and balances immediate delivery needs with longer-term team and process development.

**Education**
Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance required. ACA or CPA is a plus.

title: Senior Business Execution Consultant
description:
**About This Role**
Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Business Execution Consultant.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead support functions or operations for multiple business groups and contribute to large scale strategic initiatives
* Ensure efficiency, quality, cost effectiveness of solutions, and pipeline management relating to assigned operations
* Research moderately complex business, operational, and strategic initiatives that require analytical skills, basic knowledge of organizational strategy and Business Execution, and understanding of international business
* Work independently to make recommendations for support function by providing support and leadership
* Assist in the planning and execution of a variety of programs and initiatives that may include risk mitigation, efficiency, and customer experience
* Collaborate and consult with team leaders in developing project plans, policies and procedures
* Provide leadership in management of relationships and implementation of programs, services, and initiatives with cross functional business partners

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Possess strong knowledge of banking products and services across key lines of business, including Consumer Lending, Commercial Banking, Wealth & Investment Banking, Trade Finance, and Capital Markets.
* Manage third-party due diligence activities across the relationship lifecycle, including planning and intake, onboarding, risk assessment, contracting, ongoing monitoring, change events, renewal, and termination.

**Job Expectations**

* Assess and document the business rationale for engaging a third party, including the nature, scope, criticality, data access, technology dependency, regulatory considerations, and inherent risks associated with the proposed service.
* Apply in-depth knowledge of third-party risk management principles to identify, assess, document, escalate, and support the mitigation of risks related to cybersecurity, information security, data privacy, operational resilience, business continuity, regulatory compliance, financial viability, subcontractor use, concentration, and reputational exposure.
* Evaluate different service types, delivery models, engagement structures, and third-party dependencies to determine applicable due diligence requirements, risk domains, control expectations, and level of ongoing oversight.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather complete and accurate information regarding the service, data flows, system access, locations, subcontractors, critical processes, and intended use of the third party.
* Review submitted documentation and stakeholder responses for completeness, consistency, and accuracy; identify information gaps; obtain clarifications; and ensure due diligence records are maintained in the designated system with a clear audit trail.
* Coordinate with Lines of Business, Risk Partners, Legal, Compliance, Technology, Information Security, Sourcing, and other subject matter experts to resolve questions, address control gaps, and support timely completion of risk evaluations.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for new and existing third-party relationships by interpreting policy requirements, identifying material risks, advising stakeholders on required actions, and supporting risk-based decisions.
* Translate complex risk, policy, and control requirements into clear, practical, and actionable guidance for business stakeholders, enabling them to understand their responsibilities and meet established requirements.
* Exercise independent judgment and effective challenge when business responses, proposed controls, risk acceptance decisions, or supporting evidence do not adequately address identified exposure or policy expectations.
* Provide timely interim updates, escalation communications, final assessment outcomes, and recommended next steps to relevant stakeholders, ensuring transparency regarding open issues, dependencies, and potential delays.
* Monitor remediation plans, control gaps, exceptions, and outstanding actions through closure; escalate overdue or material items in accordance with governance and risk-management requirements.
* Identify areas of operational strength and opportunities to improve business execution, workflow discipline, documentation quality, stakeholder experience, cycle time, control effectiveness, and adherence to service-level expectations.
* Research, develop, and recommend process improvements, action plans, standard procedures, controls, reporting mechanisms, and strategic approaches that improve the effectiveness and scalability of the third-party risk management program.
* Track performance against established metrics and policy requirements, analyze trends and recurring issues, and present clear recommendations to management for strengthening risk governance and business performance.
* Maintain current knowledge of enterprise third-party risk management policies, standards, procedures, regulatory expectations, and industry practices, and apply that knowledge consistently across assigned engagements.
* Assess third-party technology, cloud, software-as-a-service, and artificial intelligence use cases in coordination with relevant specialists, considering factors such as data handling, access controls, model governance, human oversight, transparency, resilience, subcontractor dependencies, and compliance with technology and vendor-management requirements.
* Support an accountable, collaborative, and risk-aware culture by managing multiple priorities, meeting committed timelines, maintaining high-quality documentation, and communicating professionally with stakeholders at all levels.

**Posting End Date**
3 Nov 2026
  
  

* Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

**We Value Equal Opportunity**
Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.
  
  
Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.
  
  
Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

* Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

title: Fund Servicing Associate
description:
**Job Description**
Join JPMorganChase as a Fund Servicing Associate II and be at the forefront of enhancing our operational services in fund accounting and administration. This role offers a unique opportunity for career growth and skill development, as you collaborate with a dynamic team and contribute to impactful solutions. Experience the benefits of being part of a leading financial institution that values innovation and continuous improvement.
  
  
As a Fund Servicing Associate ll within JPMorganChase, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our fund servicing operations. Leveraging your broad knowledge of fund accounting and administration, you will provide advice and support to ensure progress within established procedures and policies. Your work will have a significant impact on our department, requiring you to apply your advanced analytical and problem-solving skills to develop solutions for varied and complex issues. Your advanced emotional intelligence will be key in building trusting relationships and influencing better outcomes for our team and clients. Your role will also involve planning and organizing your own work, and potentially that of a team, while continuously seeking opportunities for improvement and innovation in our operating platform.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead daily exception monitoring and triage at cutoffs; set prioritization and escalation standards; ensure timely escalation of material issues.
* Oversee and perform alert investigations using instrument data, rule logic, and prospectus terms to confirm validity; handle/review high-severity or complex cases.
* Drive false alert remediation with Data Management and Rule/Technology teams; validate fixes in test and production; own false-positive reduction themes and outcomes.
* Own compliance run management end-to-end (schedules, dependencies, reruns) to meet SLAs; implement run health monitoring and contingency processes.
* Lead data feed/import issue resolution with providers and internal stakeholders; interpret flat files/feed logs; document outcomes and preventive actions to avoid recurrence.
* Manage stakeholder engagement across Operations, Technology, Investment teams, and third-party vendors; run governance routines and escalate effectively to achieve timely resolution.
* Produce and present MI/reporting (alert volumes, false positive rates, turnaround times, run timeliness, SLA adherence) and translate insights into capacity, control, and process improvements.
* Maintain strong audit and documentation discipline (evidence, audit trails, decision logs, procedures); ensure processes remain current, effective, and audit-ready.
* Provide people management: coach and develop team members, manage performance, ensure coverage planning, cross-training, and a strong risk & controls culture.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* 12+ years of direct people management experience, including coaching, performance management, and driving delivery under SLAs.
* Strong experience in Fund Servicing, Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Investment Operations, Reference Data Operations, or Investment Compliance Operations.
* Hands-on experience with breaks/alerts, daily cutoffs, prioritization, escalation, and defensible decision-making.
* Ability to interrogate datasets to validate rule triggers and exception drivers; strong comfort with spreadsheets and data analysis tools.
* Strong RCA capability; experience partnering with Tech/Data teams to raise defects, validate fixes (UAT), and deliver durable remediation (not just short-term closure).
* Experience producing and presenting operational MI/KPIs (volumes, ageing/TAT, false positives, run timeliness, SLA adherence) to drive action and improvements.
* Strong documentation discipline—evidence capture, audit trails, procedure maintenance, and control effectiveness.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Understanding of investment instruments, portfolio structures, market data concepts, fund restrictions, and prospectus-driven controls.
* Familiarity with issue tracking tools and structured exception management workflows.
* Familiarity with rule-based compliance engines, rule logic interpretation, scheduling/runs, dependencies, and rerun management.
* Experience troubleshooting data imports/feeds, interpreting flat files and feed logs, working with data providers/vendors, and implementing preventive controls.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Trade & Processing Specialist
description:
**Job Type**
Full Time
  
  
**Job Reference #**
344710BR
  
  
**City**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We’re looking for a Trade & Processing Specialist (EE) to help us:
  
  

* process and monitor end-to-end trade lifecycle activities, including booking, confirmation, and settlement
* investigate and resolve trade breaks, exceptions, and reconciliation discrepancies to support timely settlement
* maintain accurate reference and static data to support reliable processing and data integrity
* partner with front office, operations, and technology teams to address issues and improve trade processing outcomes
* perform root-cause analysis and drive sustainable fixes that improve process efficiency and operational stability
* follow operational controls, procedures, and risk standards to deliver high-quality service and support compliance

**The team**
You’ll join an operations team focused on delivering accurate, timely trade processing across the trade lifecycle. Our mission is to keep trades moving from booking through confirmation and settlement while supporting data integrity and minimizing operational risk. You’ll partner closely with front office, operations colleagues, and technology teams to investigate breaks, complete reconciliations, and implement sustainable improvements. description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.
  
  
In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.
  
  
Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are hiring a
**Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations – Finance and Costing Manager**
to join our Customer Success team. This role is crucial in ensuring the efficiency, accuracy, and compliance of financial operations and costing practices in D365 F&O. You will collaborate with clients, functional teams, technical teams and developers to provide expert support, drive solutions, and improve financial process outcomes. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, budgeting, tax, cost management and cost accounting functions within D365 F&O, helping clients streamline their operations and achieve operational excellence.
  
  
**Important - This role requires working in US hours to support clients effectively.**
***Working hours: 3rd Shift (5:00 PM - 2:00 AM IST)***
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide expert support and consulting for D365 F&O Finance modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Budgeting, Tax, Cost Management and Cost Accounting.
* Provide priority support for high severity cases identifying options to get past the initial issue and deliver the necessary long-term solution. Collaborate with internal teams and clients as needed for deliver root cause analysis for these cases.
* Monitor and respond to incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
* Evaluate reported issues to identify where they stem from and work with the necessary team to resolve. This includes but is not limited to customer specific code, Crowe Metals Accelerator (CMA) and Microsoft functionalities.
* Prepare/maintain support documentation, configuration guides and process documentation.
* Support implementation of enhancements through the full software development life cycle, hotfixes and service updates.
* Support period-end/year-end business activities.
* Design and configure financial processes including intercompany, consolidation, month-end close, and financial reporting.
* Guide clients on best practices for configuration/processes and internal controls within D365 F&O.
* Continuous self-learning of new features/functionality/technologies as well as guiding younger team members on their cases/career.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Charted Accountant.
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with D365 F&O
* Strong understanding of D365 F&O functionalities related to financial management and costing.
* Microsoft certifications in D365 Finance (preferred).
* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, meticulous attention to detail and collaborative teamwork abilities.
* Clear, confident English communication – comfortable engaging directly with U.S. counterparts during the alternate shift.
* Ability to manage multiple client expectations and work in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with localization and compliance requirements (e.g., tax configurations, regulatory reports)
* Exposure to Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
* Exposure to project accounting and multi-entity finance implementations
* CPA/CMA or MBA in Finance a strong plus.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
  
  
Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

* Lead large teams providing financial services across multiple delivery models
* Manage large, complex accounts or portfolios and promote adoption of Deloitte standards and procedures amongst the team
* Supervise the accurate and timely preparation of engagement and/or client financials and management reporting (pricing analysis, budget preparation, time and expense tracking, budget reconciliation and variance analysis, client billing and receivable collection, financial performance forecasting)

* Conduct quality reviews of and provide feedback on the technical work products of junior resources.
* Identify, address, and resolve engagement, contract management and compliance issues.

* Experience in a professional services firm

* Minimum of 14+ years of experience in financial analysis, budgeting, or engagement accounting
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in management and supervision (responsibility for defining work activities, assigning work responsibilities of others, setting, and achieving work objectives)
* Minimum of 8 years of experience with the entire Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced level PowerPoint and advance to expert Excel Skills (Excel certification will be required post-hire)
* Experience working and collaborating with international teams
* Experience summarizing results and producing management reports
* Experience supporting staff career development through participation in formal and informal employee performance review process
* Experience producing and delivering appropriate communications to C-level Executives
* Experience conducting interviews and making hiring decisions/recommendations
* Proven ability to identify and resolve issues independently and to escalate when appropriate
* Demonstrated ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
* Proven ability to work effectively, both independently and as a member of a team
* Demonstrated attention to detail and adherence to engagement deadlines
* Proven problem solving and trouble shooting skills with ability to exercise sound judgment

* Proven ability to meet recurring deadlines with accuracy

* Expertise in revenue, lease, inventory, intercompany, and fixed asset accounting

title: RTR Assistant Manager
description:

Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
**About Global Business Services**
Behind our iconic power brands that touch millions of lives daily – from Dettol and Lysol to Durex and Nurofen – lies a dynamic and vital engine: Reckitt's Global Business Services (GBS).
  
  
Fuelled by a culture of positive energy and co-creativity - while learning together - OneReckitt GBS is at the forefront of our business, driving efficiency, standardisation, and innovation across our global operations. We're a fast-paced, purposeful team, constantly seeking to optimise our processes, leverage cutting-edge technology, and deliver exceptional value to every corner of Reckitt. We’re not a traditional back-office function; we’re a strategic powerhouse where diverse individuals with bright minds come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better global business that directly helps achieve Reckitt’s mission.
  
  
**About The Role**
This role is an exciting opportunity to contribute to Reckitt’s financial integrity by supporting high‑quality financial accounting and operations for multiple countries in a global business environment. You’ll be part of a collaborative team that values precision, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will leverage digital tools to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, and enhance audit readiness. If you enjoy working with detail, solving problems, and improving processes, this role provides a supportive environment where your contribution truly matters—while helping Reckitt pursue a cleaner, healthier world.
  
  
The role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, hands‑on experience in manufacturing finance processes, and the ability to manage complex, multi‑country activities with accuracy and timeliness. You will partner closely with cross‑functional teams, local finance, business controllers, tax teams, and shared services to ensure compliance, efficiency, and standardization of accounting processes.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Manage Financial Accounting activities including revenue, lease, inventory accounting, journal entries, and GL reconciliations.
* Oversee Cash & Bank operations, bank reconciliations, cash flow, and NWC reporting.
* Handle Intercompany Accounting, reconciliations, recharge processes, and dispute resolution.
* Govern Fixed Assets including Capex approvals, asset lifecycle management, impairments, and AUC accounting.
* Lead Month-End Close & Consolidation, financial reporting, adjustments, and statutory reconciliations.
* Support Tax & Statutory Reporting, ensuring compliance with Local GAAP/IFRS and audit requirements.
* Manage Manufacturing Accounting activities including costing, variance analysis, PPV, and project accounting.
* Support Management Accounting through allocations, reporting, and exception management.
* Drive Financial Controls, Compliance, Governance, and Continuous Improvement across RTR operations.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Qualified CA / CMA / CPA / CWA or MBA (Finance)
* 10+ years of relevant experience
* Experience in shared services and multi‑country finance support
* Strong knowledge of commercial & manufacturing accounting, tax, intercompany, and month‑end close
* Hands‑on ERP experience (SAP, Oracle), BlackLine, and reconciliation tools
* Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and documentation skills
* Proven ability to meet recurring deadlines with accuracy
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills

The skills for success
  
  

* Strong accounting acumen with deep understanding of RTR governance
* Comprehensive end‑to‑end RTR knowledge: financial accounting, month‑end close, reconciliations, compliance
* Robust knowledge of IFRS and Local GAAP
* Expertise in revenue, lease, inventory, intercompany, and fixed asset accounting
* Proficient in SAP (FI/CO, MM, AA) and JD Edwards (GA, FA, Inventory & Manufacturing)
* Practical experience with BlackLine and workflow tools
* Strong understanding of capitalization policies, AUC/project accounting, and asset lifecycle governance
* Advanced analytical and root‑cause problem‑solving skills
* High attention to internal controls and audit readiness
* Experience in process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement
* Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and dependable in fast‑paced environments
* Strong stakeholder management across global teams
* Able to operate effectively in a global, matrixed organization

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.
