title: Job Posting Title Associate, Channel Operations – Contracts & Pricing Execution
description:
**Associate, Channel Operations – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)**
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As the Associate, Channel Operations – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN), you will support execution of U.S. Channel operations within the Contracts & Pricing Execution function. This role will support contract update processing, CDP maintenance, GCPS processing, scorecard generation, payment validation, DOH analysis, reconciliation activities, reporting, controls, documentation, and operational improvement initiatives supporting Channel Payments and Channel Analytics processes.
  
  
The role will partner with Channel Managers, AIN team members, ATO Channel SMEs, National Account Managers, Finance, Commercial Operations, Pricing, Trade Operations, Analytics teams, Information Systems, and other U.S.-based stakeholders to support accurate, timely, and compliant Channel execution. The Associate will be expected to learn Channel processes through structured KT, shadowing, reverse shadowing, and supervised execution prior to taking on broader independent responsibilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
*Channel Operations & Execution*

* Support day-to-day execution of Channel operations including CDP updates, GCPS maintenance, payment package preparation, scorecard generation, tracker maintenance, reporting support, and documentation management.
* Execute assigned standard-state Channel activities in accordance with SOPs, desktop procedures, validation checklists, quality standards, and established timelines.
* Maintain accurate trackers for contract updates, CDP changes, scorecard status, waiver activity, payment readiness, reconciliations, open items, and evidence retention.
* Escalate risks, missing information, data anomalies, access issues, late amendments, waiver concerns, or processing exceptions to the Channel Manager and retained ATO owners.

*CDP & GCPS Support*

* Support Conga review activities, contract amendment tracking, Monthly and Quarterly CDP Update preparation, and maintenance of supporting documentation.
* Perform standard CDP maintenance activities and support GCPS setup and configuration updates for approved contract, pricing, fee, rebate, strategy, and program changes.
* Assist with CDP-to-GCPS validation, peer review support, discrepancy documentation, and issue resolution tracking.
* Maintain supporting files including master files, strategy trackers, product updates, waiver trackers, and contract-related documentation.

*Scorecards, Validation & Payment Support*

* Generate and maintain scorecards using approved master files, DOH inputs, net sales data, and contractual parameters.
* Perform first-pass validation of scorecards, payment calculations, performance reports, reconciliations, and supporting reporting outputs.
* Support payment package preparation, payment tracker updates, variance research, documentation preparation, and approval package readiness.
* Investigate standard discrepancies and coordinate supporting data collection for manager review.

*Analytics, Reconciliation & Reporting*

* Support net sales reconciliation activities across SAP, GCPS, IntegriChain, and related reporting sources.
* Perform recurring DOH calculations, direct sales validation, 852/867 review support, variance analysis, and compliance reporting activities.
* Assist with trend reporting, scorecard reporting, performance reporting, payment package support, and routine operational dashboards.
* Maintain audit-ready supporting workpapers and reconciliation documentation.

*Product Launch & Master Data Support*

* Support routine product launch tracking activities, MMDS documentation updates, master data coordination, and approved pricing update activities.
* Assist with price list maintenance, documentation readiness, product setup tracking, and launch-related reporting.
* Maintain launch documentation, approvals, and supporting records in accordance with SOP requirements.

*Compliance, Controls & Audit Readiness*

* Execute work in accordance with Channel SOPs, SOX controls, documentation requirements, and compliance expectations.
* Maintain audit-ready evidence supporting validations, reconciliations, payment activities, approvals, and operational controls.
* Support internal audits, SOX reviews, KT activities, documentation updates, and process compliance reviews.
* Escalate data integrity, compliance, operational, or financial risks promptly and support remediation efforts.

**What We Expect Of You**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented operations professional with strong analytical, documentation, reconciliation, and process execution capabilities. This individual should demonstrate ownership, accuracy, continuous learning, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset while supporting a highly controlled Channel operations environment.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, Analytics, or related discipline.
* 2 to 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, finance operations, Channel operations, managed markets, revenue management, analytics, contracting operations, or related business operations.
* Strong Excel, reporting, documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, follow SOPs, and work effectively in a controlled operational environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to Channel Payments, distributor agreements, fee and rebate administration, Gross-to-Net operations, contract operations, or pharmaceutical commercial operations.
* Experience with Model N GCPS, SAP, Conga, IntegriChain, SharePoint, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, Power Automate, or similar business systems.
* Understanding of DOH calculations, scorecards, reconciliations, payment validation, contract amendments, compliance reporting, and operational controls.
* Experience supporting SOP development, issue tracking, audit support, testing, process documentation, automation, or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong communication, collaboration, attention-to-detail, and stakeholder management skills in a global operating model.

**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a motivated Junior SAP Group Reporting professional to support group consolidation and financial reporting activities within SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting. The role provides hands‑on exposure to legal consolidation, IFRS reporting, SAP configuration, and month‑end close processes under the guidance of senior consultants and managers.
  
  
This position is ideal for professionals early in their SAP consolidation career who want to develop strong functional and technical expertise in SAP Group Reporting.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Group Reporting & Consolidation Support**

* Support monthly, quarterly, half‑yearly, and annual group consolidation processes.
* Assist in preparation and review of consolidated financial results in compliance with IFRS and local GAAP.
* Support consolidation of actuals, budgets, and forecasts for group and subsidiary entities.
* Assist in handling consolidation scope changes, including new entities, divestitures, or restructures.
* Support purchase method and equity method consolidations under supervision.

**SAP Group Reporting Configuration & Operations**

* Assist in configuration and maintenance of SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting objects such as:

+ Financial Statement (FS) items and hierarchies
+ Consolidation units and consolidation groups
+ Attributes, breakdown categories, sub‑items and sub‑item categories

* Support balance carryforward and currency translation setups.
* Assist in inter‑unit eliminations, reclassifications, and manual journal postings.
* Run and monitor Data Monitor and Consolidation Monitor activities.
* Support mapping of G/L accounts to financial statement items.

**Integration & Systems Support**

* Assist senior consultants in integrating SAP Group Reporting with SAP FI/CO on S/4HANA.
* Support system testing, data validation, and reconciliation during month‑end and year‑end close.
* Participate in support or implementation projects involving SAP BPC, SEM‑BCS, EC‑CS, FI‑LC, or ECC.

**Analysis & Reporting**

* Perform basic analysis of reported figures and support variance analysis.
* Prepare supporting schedules and documentation for audit and internal reporting.
* Help identify data issues or inconsistencies and support resolution with reporting units.

**Learning, Documentation & Team Support**

* Document functional specifications, process flows, and configuration settings.
* Support knowledge transfer activities and participate in user training sessions.
* Work closely with senior consultants and managers to gain functional and technical knowledge.
* Assist in continuous improvement initiatives within the Group Reporting framework.

**Core Skills**
**Skills and Attributes for Success**

* Basic to intermediate understanding of group consolidation concepts.
* Foundational knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP accounting principles.
* Exposure to SAP consolidation tools such as SAP BPC, SEM‑BCS, EC‑CS, FI‑LC, or SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting.
* Willingness to learn SAP Group Reporting configuration and consolidation processes.

**Technical Skills**

* Basic hands‑on experience or strong theoretical knowledge of SAP FI/CO.
* Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA navigation and reporting concepts.
* Experience supporting at least one consolidation or reporting cycle is preferred.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strong attention to detail and analytical mindset.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Proactive learner with a problem‑solving attitude.

**Qualifications**

* MBA (Finance), M.Com, or Chartered Accountant (CA – Inter / Qualified)
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in financial consolidation, reporting, or SAP Finance projects.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting (on‑premise or cloud).
* Experience assisting in migration or transition from legacy consolidation tools to Group Reporting.
* Prior experience in audit, group finance, or controllership roles.

title: Lead Product Analyst - Operations
description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
We’re looking for a Lead Data Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our operational teams to help drive data-driven decisions that would support our fast-growing product through scaling and optimising the team.
  
  
As a Lead Data Analyst, you'll be driving our analytics efforts in our operations teams, who do everything from support our customers when they need help, to screening for criminal activity, to verifying customer identities at scale.
  
  
Most importantly, you’ll collaborate closely with your operational leads, as well as workforce management, quality, training, and knowledge management, to bring your insights into real change for our customers and help drive our mission!
  
  
**Here’s How You’ll Be Contributing**

* Analytical Capacity Planning and Forecasting: Focus on building and refining analytical models for strategic capacity planning. Take ownership of forecasting efforts to align with business growth and operational demands.
* Data Pipeline Ownership: Take ownership of data pipelines to maintain and improve data flow, ensuring reliability and accuracy.
* Predictive Modeling and Cause and Effect Analysis: Develop and implement robust models to predict outcomes and perform cause and effect analysis to identify key drivers, optimise processes, and enhance decision-making and strategic planning.
* Strategic Support and Analysis: Provide critical insights to assess the operational health of the KYC function, conduct in-depth cost analysis, and offer detailed analysis of operational metrics (including quality) to understand impacts on customer experiences.
* Performance Tracking and Initiative Optimisation: Monitor and track the performance of key strategic initiatives, capitalising on optimisation opportunities to enhance operational outcomes.
* KPI Implementation and Target Setting: Lead the development and implementation of the operations KPI tree and the target-setting framework, integrating these within reporting pipelines and strategic operations.
* Stakeholder Collaboration and Process Standardisation: Collaborate closely with various stakeholders to standardise processes across forecasting, scheduling, and real-time operations, promoting continuous improvement and strategic alignment.

This is an IC3 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**What you'll bring:**

* You have 6 - 8 years of experience in analytics with a demonstrated ability to approach complex, interconnected problems with a systems mindset.
* You have a strong quantitative and statistical background, comfortable with probability, hypothesis testing, regression, time series analysis, and thinking in terms of models and trade-offs.
* You have experience with operational analytics: efficiency analysis, cost modelling, performance measurement, or process optimisation.
* You think about data as infrastructure. You build with reusability and quality in mind, considering how data will be consumed by dashboards, other teams, and automated systems.
* You have experience with complex data models in SQL (our warehouse is Snowflake) and advanced analysis using Python/R.
* You can tell a story with data and proactively guide strategy based on insights. Experience with visualisation tools like Looker, Superset, or Tableau.
* You have a bias to action and are an excellent communicator, able to own projects end-to-end, form your own opinions, and influence stakeholders across teams.

**Some Extra Skills That Are Great (but Not Essential)**

* Experience with optimisation problems such as queuing theory, scheduling, or resource allocation.
* Familiarity with forecasting techniques (ARIMA, Holt-Winters, or similar time series methods).
* Experience building data foundations that support ML/AI — feature engineering, labelled datasets, or structured event data.
* Prior experience in operations, servicing, or compliance domains.
* Familiarity with workforce management, quality assurance, or knowledge management analytics.
* Experience with dbt, Airflow, or Git.

Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Finance and Accounts Manager
description:
Grow Your Staff is looking for a
**General Manager - Accounts**

for a leading Hyderabad-based automotive and construction equipment dealership group representing globally recognized brands across multiple business verticals.
***This is a full-time, on-site position.***

The role offers an excellent opportunity to lead the Finance & Accounts function and work closely with the CFO, Managing Director, and senior leadership team to strengthen financial governance, drive profitability, optimize working capital, and ensure financial discipline across multiple branches and business divisions.

**Experience required**

: 15+ years

**Time**

: 9:00 AM-6:00 PM (Monday-Saturday) 

**CTC**

: 15 LPA-20 LPA 

**Location**

: Hyderabad (On-site)

**Type of employment:**

Full-time

**Responsibilities:**

Financial Management & Reporting

* Oversee end-to-end accounting operations across all branches and business divisions.
* Ensure timely closure of monthly, quarterly, and annual accounts.
* Prepare and review profit and loss statements, Balance Sheets, cash flow statements, and financial reports.
* Analyse branch-wise and business vertical-wise profitability, revenue, expenses, and financial performance.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to the CFO, Managing Director, and senior leadership team to support business decisions.

Budgeting & Cost Control

* Develop annual budgets and financial forecasts in coordination with business heads.
* Monitor actual financial performance against budgets and investigate significant variances.
* Identify cost optimisation opportunities and implement effective expense-control measures.
* Monitor overheads, operating expenses, and branch-level financial performance.
* Recommend measures to improve profitability and operational efficiency.

Working Capital & Cash Flow Management

* Monitor cash flows, fund utilisation, bank balances, and working capital requirements.
* Oversee accounts receivable, customer outstanding, collection efficiency, and dealer financing.
* Monitor inventory valuation, stock reconciliation, and ageing of vehicles, equipment, and spare parts.
* Ensure timely vendor payments while maintaining adequate liquidity.
* Coordinate with banks and financial institutions for banking facilities, credit limits, and other financial requirements.

Taxation & Statutory Compliance

* Ensure compliance with applicable GST, Income Tax, TDS, and other relevant statutory requirements.
* Oversee GST returns, tax reconciliations, TDS returns, and statutory filings.
* Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors, tax consultants, and government authorities.
* Ensure timely completion of audits and closure of audit observations.
* Monitor changes in taxation laws and implement necessary compliance measures.

Internal Controls & Risk Management

* Establish and strengthen internal financial controls across branches and business units.
* Ensure proper authorization for payments, discounts, credit notes, journal entries, and financial transactions.
* Monitor adherence to company financial policies, approval processes, and delegation of authority.
* Identify financial risks, irregularities, control weaknesses, and potential revenue leakages.
* Ensure accurate accounting of vehicle and equipment sales, spare parts, service revenue, warranties, incentives, and OEM claims.

Business Finance & Performance Analysis

* Analyse financial performance across branches, business units, and product divisions.
* Track profitability across vehicle sales, construction equipment, after-sales service, and spare parts operations.
* Review gross margins, contribution margins, operating costs, and return on investment.
* Prepare and present MIS reports with actionable insights to improve business performance.
* Support management in business expansion, investment decisions, and financial feasibility assessments.

Team Leadership & Process Improvement

* Lead, mentor, and develop the Finance & Accounts team across multiple locations.
* Define team responsibilities, reporting structures, performance targets, and accountability.
* Standardize accounting processes, reporting formats, and financial controls across branches.
* Improve operational efficiency through ERP utilization, automation, and process digitization.
* Promote financial discipline, transparency, confidentiality, and accountability across the organization.

﻿

**Qualifications:**

* CA / CMA preferred. Candidates with an MBA in Finance, M.Com, or B.Com may be considered based on relevant experience and demonstrated expertise.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably within automotive dealerships, commercial vehicles, construction equipment, or other large multi-location businesses.
* Proven experience managing multi-branch accounting operations and leading finance teams.
* Strong knowledge of financial accounting, financial reporting, GST, Income Tax, TDS, and statutory compliance.
* Demonstrated expertise in working capital management, budgeting, cost control, cash flow management, and profitability analysis.
* Experience in internal financial controls, audit management, and risk mitigation.
* Proficiency in ERP/accounting systems and advanced MS Excel.
* Strong analytical, leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work closely with senior management.
* High ethical standards, integrity, attention to detail, and the ability to handle confidential financial information professionally.

title: Revenue Accountant
description:
**Job Description: Revenue Accountant - Full Time**

**Location: Hyderabad, India**

**Schedule – Monday through Friday - 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST**

**Position Overview**

A Revenue Accountant is responsible for managing and ensuring accurate client billing, revenue tracking, collections, and accounts payable activities. This role plays a key part in maintaining the financial health of the organization by overseeing the end-to-end revenue cycle.

**What You’ll Do**

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

**Intake:**

* Create new client account records in the firm’s system
* Review and verify data on account records to ensure key fields are populated (e.g. company group, relationship, website, client operations, industry/sub-industry, entity type, address, etc.
* Research and update contact records to display current company, title and contact information

**Billing:**

* Compile, analyze and process attorney fees and expenses to clients
* Review and edit pre-bills in response to attorney requests
* Research and verify narratives, rates, clients and matters, and client billing requirements and make appropriate corrections
* Transfer charges between clients/matters to ensure that charges are billed to the appropriate party
* Process write-downs in accordance with firm policies
* Attach and verify supporting documentation to correspond with expense charges and per client requirements.
* Research, resolve and respond to internal and external inquiries regarding billing issues
* Generate reports as requested
* Interact and communicate with attorneys, secretaries and administrative personnel, providing accurate information and timely responses
* Maintain billing software.

**eBilling**

* Submit monthly electronic invoices to firm clients, ensuring all client and firm guidelines are followed during submission
* Track the status of electronic invoices from submission to payment
* Resolve rejections until submission is successful and keep documentation of issues/resolution
* Resolve residual balances by 1) appeal, working with billing attorneys or timekeepers directly for details to submit for repayment, or 2) write off, through the appropriate assigned personnel
* Liaise between firm’s billing/collections team, billing attorneys, secretarial staff and clients regarding ebilling, as directed

title: Finance & Business Operations Associate
description:
**Applix | U.S. & India Operations**

**About the Role**

Applix is looking for a resourceful, detail-oriented
**Finance & Business Operations Associate**
to support our day-to-day financial, administrative, and business operations across the United States and India.

This is a hands-on, cross-functional role spanning accounting support, invoicing, collections, payroll, HR administration, vendor management, and general business operations.

We're looking for someone with a solid foundation in accounting or finance who enjoys solving problems beyond the numbers. Someone who can independently manage responsibilities, navigate unfamiliar situations, and keep things moving in a fast-paced, growing company.

You'll work closely with leadership and coordinate with employees, customers, vendors, accountants, attorneys, and other external partners.

**What You'll Do**

**Finance & Accounting Operations**

* Manage customer invoicing, accounts receivable, collections, and vendor payments.
* Track purchase orders, timesheets, billing milestones, and outstanding payments.
* Maintain financial records, expenses, and reconciliations using QuickBooks and other business tools.
* Coordinate payroll, reimbursements, contractor payments, and compensation tracking.
* Monitor cash flow, project costs, and key financial metrics, providing clear updates to leadership.
* Work with external accountants and tax advisors on bookkeeping, financial reporting, audits, and statutory compliance.

**Business Operations & Administration**

* Coordinate day-to-day business operations across our U.S. and India entities.
* Manage vendor onboarding, contracts, procurement, subscriptions, and renewals.
* Maintain business registrations, insurance, corporate records, and compliance documentation.
* Coordinate with banks, accountants, legal counsel, and other service providers.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and improve internal processes.

**HR & People Operations**

* Coordinate employee and contractor onboarding, offboarding, and documentation.
* Support benefits administration, payroll changes, employee records, and leave tracking.
* Track employment agreements, compensation terms, and HR-related deadlines.
* Coordinate immigration and work authorization matters with external attorneys.

**Coordination & Execution**

* Track open items, deadlines, approvals, and commitments through completion.
* Proactively follow up with customers, employees, vendors, and external partners.
* Investigate discrepancies, resolve issues, and escalate matters appropriately.
* Support leadership on evolving operational priorities and special projects.

**What We're Looking For**

* **2–5 years of experience**
  in finance, accounting, business operations, or a related role.
* A solid understanding of accounting fundamentals, AP/AR, invoicing, reconciliations, and financial administration.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills; familiarity with QuickBooks or similar software.
* Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal English communication.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and follow through consistently.
* Comfortable working across finance, HR, administration, and operations rather than within a narrowly defined function.
* High attention to detail, sound judgment, and discretion with confidential information.
* **Resourceful, adaptable, and quick to learn**
  , with a strong bias toward action.

**Preferred**

* Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field.
* Experience supporting U.S. and India business operations.
* Exposure to payroll, benefits, vendor management, or HR administration.
* Familiarity with QuickBooks, Gusto, Ramp, or similar platforms.
* Experience working in a startup, consulting, technology, or professional services environment.

**Who Will Thrive Here**

You're someone who takes ownership rather than simply completing assigned tasks.

If an invoice is overdue, you follow up. If a payment doesn't reconcile, you investigate. If an employee needs help with documentation, you coordinate it. If a process is inefficient, you find a better way.

You're comfortable switching between financial details and broader operational responsibilities. You move quickly without sacrificing accuracy, communicate proactively, and know when to ask questions or escalate.

**We're looking for someone who combines financial discipline with operational agility, someone who can keep the numbers organized and the business moving.**

title: Fixed Asset Accountant – Senior Process Analyst
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.
  
  
**About Broadridge:**
***Broadridge Financial Solutions**
is a global fintech leader providing technology, communications, and data-driven solutions to the financial services industry. We help businesses simplify complex operations, enhance efficiency, and deliver better experiences for their clients.*
*With a strong global presence and a culture built around innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, Broadridge offers employees the opportunity to work on meaningful, large-scale business processes while building expertise in a dynamic and technology-driven environment.*
*At Broadridge, our values are reflected through
**CREATE – Client Focus, Respect, Excellence, Accountability, Teamwork, and Efficiency**
, which guide how we work and collaborate every day.*
**About the Role:**
*We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Fixed Asset Accountant with 2–5 years of relevant experience in fixed asset accounting, project accounting, and general ledger operations. The role involves managing the end-to-end fixed asset lifecycle, project capitalization, prepaid expenses, accruals, account reconciliations, and month-end close activities. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Financials, exposure to BlackLine, and proficiency in Excel and Power BI to support accurate financial reporting, internal controls, and continuous process improvement.*
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Fixed Asset Accounting: Manage the end-to-end fixed asset lifecycle, including additions, capitalization, transfers, adjustments, retirements, disposals, and asset reconciliations. Execute monthly depreciation runs, validate calculations, and ensure accurate asset accounting and timely closure.
* Project Accounting and Capitalization: Manage project setup, cost tracking, project budgets, and capital expenditure monitoring in Oracle Projects. Review capitalizable costs, monitor Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) balances, and ensure timely capitalization and transfer of eligible project costs to Fixed Assets.
* Prepaid and Accrual Accounting: Manage prepaid expense schedules, monthly amortization, accrual calculations, reversals, and adjustments. Perform account reconciliations, investigate variances, and ensure accurate expense recognition and period-end cut-off.
* Oracle Fusion Financials: Demonstrate hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Fixed Assets, General Ledger, and Projects modules. Execute depreciation runs, Create Accounting, subledger-to-GL transfer, and related month-end close activities while resolving accounting and interface errors.
* BlackLine and Reconciliations : Prepare, review, and certify balance sheet reconciliations using BlackLine, ensuring accuracy and completion within agreed SLAs. Investigate reconciling items, resolve aged balances, and maintain supporting documentation in compliance with internal controls.
* Power BI and Financial Reporting : Use Power BI and Excel to analyze financial data and prepare reports on asset balances, depreciation, project expenditure, and budgets. Develop dashboards and reports to identify variances, monitor performance, and improve management visibility.
* Month-End Close, Controls, and Compliance : Complete month-end and year-end close activities, journal entries, reconciliations, and financial reporting within agreed timelines. Ensure compliance with accounting policies, SOX controls, audit requirements, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) while identifying process improvement opportunities.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline. An MBA in Finance or a relevant professional accounting qualification is an advantage.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in fixed asset accounting, general ledger accounting, project accounting, or Record-to-Report (R2R) operations.
* Working knowledge of fixed asset accounting, depreciation, asset capitalization, transfers, disposals, and reconciliations.
* Exposure to project accounting, capital expenditure tracking, CWIP monitoring, and capitalization processes.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Financials, particularly Fixed Assets and General Ledger; exposure to Oracle Projects is preferred.
* Familiarity with BlackLine for balance sheet reconciliations and account certification is an advantage.
* Proficiency in MS Excel; exposure to Power BI, dashboards, and financial data analysis is desirable.
* Understanding of month-end close, journal entries, prepaid expenses, accruals, SOX controls, and audit requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to meet deadlines, maintain accurate financial records, and identify opportunities for process improvement.

title: Sr Accountant
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Accountant on the Global Intercompany Team to be part of a team that is critical to the company's month-end close process and SOX compliance. In this exciting role, you will support the intercompany accounting operations for assigned regions and work cross-functionally with Finance Engineering and other teams to enhance Uber's internal systems and processes.
  
  
We are looking for this individual to act as a cross-functional business partner in the on-shoring and structuring of new legal entities and to support strategic initiatives such as M&A integrations, including the establishment and ongoing support of intercompany operations resulting from those integrations, as well as IP restructurings and tax initiatives.
  
  
This role requires an individual with strong knowledge of intercompany accounting and multi-entity structures, as well as a curious and analytical mindset. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys digging into complex topics, asks the right questions, and is resourceful in finding answers rather than waiting for direction. The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating ambiguity, investigating issues independently, and proactively identifying solutions and opportunities for improvement.
  
  
The ideal candidate will also embrace AI as part of their day-to-day work, continuously exploring how AI and emerging technologies can automate repetitive activities, improve analysis, and create more efficient and scalable accounting processes.
  
  
If a fast-moving, constantly evolving environment excites you, this could be an excellent opportunity for you!
  
  
**What The Candidate Will Do**

* Own and support key intercompany accounting operations for assigned regions, serving as a primary point of contact for intercompany matters and ensuring accurate and timely execution of related accounting activities.
* Actively participate in the monthly close process, including preparation of reports, flux analysis, and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Prepare and review intercompany journal entries in accordance with transfer pricing regulations to ensure a timely monthly, quarterly, and year-end close.
* Perform FX analysis and clearing for various intercompany transactions, settlements, payments, and collections on behalf.
* Be responsible for global monthly intercompany balances across 250+ entities, including the netting process, tripartite settlements for intercompany loans, and follow-up on related queries.
* Investigate and resolve elimination issues and review automated intercompany entries coming from various systems to ensure a smooth consolidation process.
* Set up complex transfer pricing calculations in iCAN (Intercompany Accounting and Netting, our in-house tool).
* Support M&A integrations from an intercompany accounting perspective and help establish and support the resulting intercompany operations, including new entities, intercompany relationships, accounting flows, and related activities.

title: Royalty Contract Services Specialist
description:

Electronic Arts Inc. is a leading global interactive entertainment software company. EA develops, publishes, and distributes interactive software worldwide for video game systems, personal computers, wireless devices, and the Internet.
  
  
EA India’s office in Hyderabad supports game development activities for mobile gaming, console, online, and free-to-play casual game portal pogo.com. GEAR’s direct internal business partners are Studio Finance, Corporate Finance, Financial Planning & Analysis, Business Development and Legal. The group manages over 700 contracts. * Understanding of GL accounting, journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end activities preferred.
* Ability to interpret contracts and translate contractual terms into payment/accounting requirements.
* Experience with Oracle R12/ERP systems and strong MS Excel skills.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and provide cross-functional coverage.

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

title: Financial and Life Advisor
description:
**Company Description**
Self-employed Financial and Life Advisors operate independently, providing personalized guidance to individuals and families on managing finances and planning for life goals. Working outside traditional corporate structures, they build direct relationships with clients, tailoring strategies to unique needs and circumstances. Advisors often collaborate with a network of professionals, such as tax specialists or insurance consultants, to offer comprehensive support. This environment can be dynamic and entrepreneurial, offering room for creativity, autonomy, and continuous learning. Interns joining a self-employed advisor gain exposure to real-world client challenges and practical advisory work.

**Role Description**
As a Financial and Life Advisor Intern, you will support the advisor in delivering guidance on personal finance, budgeting, savings, investments, and long-term life planning. Day-to-day tasks may include gathering and organizing client information, assisting in preparing financial plans, and helping analyze options for insurance, investments, and debt management. You will contribute to client communications, such as scheduling meetings, preparing summaries, and drafting follow-up notes, while learning how to build trust and maintain confidentiality. The role also involves basic research on financial products, regulatory updates, and best practices in life planning to support informed recommendations. This is an internship position based in Hyderabad, with a hybrid work model that combines in-person collaboration with flexibility for some work from home.

**Qualifications**

* Ability to learn foundational concepts in personal finance, budgeting, savings, and investments, and apply them to practical client scenarios.

description:
**Company Description**
**ABOUT IQ-EQ**
Is a global investor services group with deep expertise in private markets. We support investment managers, asset owners and global businesses with the administration, compliance, governance, data and reporting that their structures depend on.
  
  
Across 25 jurisdictions, our 6,500+ professionals combine technical strength, connected technology and human understanding – the IQ and the EQ – to free clients from operational complexity and give them the peace of mind to focus on their core business activities.
  
  
Our IQ is our technical, regulatory and operational expertise, underpinned by data, technology and coordinated global delivery. Our EQ is our human partnership: understanding the business behind the numbers, the culture behind the structures and the individuals behind the screens.
  
  
With more than US$950 billion of assets under administration, our global client base includes 13 of the world’s top 15 private equity firms\* and 19 of the top 25 private debt firms\*\*.
  
  
One relationship connects our clients to the right expertise as needs evolve, helping them move forward with clarity and confidence, wherever they operate..
  
  
To find out more about IQ-EQ visit iqeq.com
  
  
**Job Description**
**This Role**
The Revenue Analyst (APAC) supports the regional finance function by delivering accurate, timely, and insightful revenue reporting and analysis across multiple jurisdictions. The role is critical in ensuring consistency in revenue tracking, billing alignment, and revenue recognition across diverse service lines and systems.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* You’ll produce and analyse APAC revenue reporting by delivering monthly and quarterly insights, including variance analysis, pipeline performance, revenue mix, and client-level profitability to support senior leadership and board reporting.
* You’ll establish and govern a single source of truth for revenue by maintaining a central tracker, aligning CRM, billing, and finance systems, and ensuring consistent revenue capture, classification, and accountability across teams.
* You’ll ensure billing accuracy and proper revenue recognition by partnering with finance operations, monitoring unbilled revenue and pipeline conversion, and identifying risks such as revenue leakage, delays, or contract misalignment.
* You’ll act as a key APAC business partner by providing stakeholders with actionable revenue insights, supporting pricing and fee validation, and aligning with country finance leads to ensure data consistency across regions.
* You’ll drive forecasting, analysis, and process improvement by enhancing revenue forecasting accuracy, analysing pipeline conversion trends, implementing controls, improving data integrity, and supporting automation to reduce manual effort and strengthen reporting transparency.

**What We Offer**

* Comprehensive remuneration: Competitive financial packages based upon market rates for your role, proportionate to your qualifications, level of experiences and skills profile
* Pension Scheme: Generous employer contribution with the ability to increase employee contributions
* Wellbeing: Additional social benefits such as medical insurance & life assurance, discounted gym memberships and the opportunity to engage with our local community via sports activities, charity programmes & environmental initiatives
* Flexible working: We recognise the value of working flexibly and enable our employees to enjoy an excellent work-life blend
* Support and development: We will ensure you have the right training, tools and development plan to grow and improve your skills every day.

**Qualifications**
**About You**

* You hold a relevant degree and experience with a Bachelor’s in Finance, Accounting, or related field, alongside 6–10 years in revenue analysis, FP&A, or commercial finance, ideally within multi-entity, multi-country (APAC) and professional or financial services environments.
* You demonstrate strong technical capability through advanced Excel skills (data modelling, reconciliation, large datasets), experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), and a solid understanding of revenue recognition principles.
* You apply a strong analytical and detail-oriented mindset with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights while maintaining high standards of accuracy and data integrity.
* You operate with a governance and process-focused approach by improving controls, reducing discrepancies, and driving structured, standardised revenue tracking and reporting practices.
* You deliver measurable business impact by improving reporting accuracy and timeliness, enhancing forecast accuracy, increasing pipeline visibility, driving adoption of a single revenue framework, and reducing manual effort through process improvements.

**Additional Information**
**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**
As a forward-looking business, sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability
  
  
depends on us building and maintaining meaningful, long-term relationships with all our stakeholders -
  
  
including our employees, clients, and local communities - while also reducing our impact on our natural
  
  
environment.
  
  
There is always more we can, and should do, to improve - whether in relation to our people, our clients, our
  
  
planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a
  
  
changing and challenging global landscape. We're committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse
  
  
culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.
  
  
Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to
  
  
invest in growing our employees' careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in
  
  
achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our
  
  
5,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, speaking 41 languages across 25 countries - to each achieve their
  
  
potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support female managers launching their first fund, in an
  
  
environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.
  
  
We're committed to growing long-term relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their
  
  
objectives. We understand that our clients' sustainability and success leads to our sustainability and success.
  
  
We're emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

Strong knowledge of international payroll, employment tax, and social security legislation. Solid understanding of cross-border workers, tax treaties, and international employment legislation. Advanced analytical skills with the ability to dive deep into detail while understanding the broader picture. Fluent in English, both written and verbal.Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant discipline such as Finance, Tax, or Accounting. US tax knowledge or experience is highly preferable. Previous Payroll Compliance management experience across multiple geographies. Experience within a control or audit environment. Exposure to AI tools, automation platforms, or process simplification initiatives within payroll or finance operations. Additional language skills. Project management experience.A day in the lifeYou start by reviewing compliance dashboards and validating payroll data inputs across countries in the region. From there, you may join a working session with the Payroll Compliance Manager to assess an emerging risk area, then shift to building out a new metric in Excel or your compliance tooling. You regularly connect with Tax, Accounting, Human Resources, and Global Mobility partners to align on statutory deadlines, and you carve out time to document processes and train payroll team members on updated compliance requirements.About The TeamThe Payroll Compliance team sits within Amazon's broader finance organization with a clear mission: pay employees accurately and on time with the highest controllership and compliance standards. We partner with payroll operations, Tax, Human Resources, Global Mobility, and external advisors to monitor and resolve compliance risks across multiple countries. You will join a collaborative team that values knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and professional growth as we scale our tools and processes to support Amazon's expanding presence.Basic Qualifications 5+ years of finance, tax or a related analytical field experiencePreferred Qualifications 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experienceOur inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Senior Analyst/Manager- Valuation
description:
**Company Overview**
Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
  
  
Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Analyst/Manager to join our Valuation team. In this role, you will build, calibrate, and maintain pricing models across complex asset classes — including credit default swaps (CDS), interest rate swaps (IRS), fixed income bonds, and inflation swaps and independently verify the fair value of client portfolios against market and model benchmarks. This is a high-visibility, individual-contributor role with direct exposure to trading desks, risk managers, and fund controllers at our client organizations, and with room to grow into a review/mentoring capacity
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, build, and maintain independent pricing models for CDS, IRS, government and corporate bonds, and inflation swaps (zero-coupon and year-on-year), incorporating appropriate curve construction, discounting, and day-count conventions.
* Perform daily, weekly, and month-end Independent Price Verification (IPV) by comparing internal/front-office marks against independent market data sources (e.g., Bloomberg BVAL, IHS Markit, ICE Data Services, Refinitiv) and internally derived model prices.
* Investigate and resolve pricing breaks and tolerance exceptions; document root causes, assumptions, and remediation in line with the firm's valuation policy. Provide explanation of PNL attributable to different components of pricing.
* Calibrate and stress-test yield curves, credit curves (hazard-rate stripping), and inflation curves used across the pricing library; validate model outputs against theoretical and market benchmarks.
* Prepare valuation reserve and fair-value hierarchy (ASC 820 / IFRS 13) analysis and support quarterly valuation committee packs for client funds.
* Partner with trading, risk, product control, and technology teams to enhance and automate the valuation model library, improving accuracy, coverage, and turnaround time.
* Support internal and external audit, regulatory, and client due-diligence requests by providing clear, well-documented explanations of pricing methodology.
* Contribute to process improvement and automation initiatives, including migrating manual valuation workflows to Python/SQL-based tooling.
* Rates & Credit Derivatives: Interest rate swaps, basis swaps, swaptions, credit default swaps (single-name and index), total return swaps.
* Inflation Products: Zero-coupon and year-on-year inflation swaps, inflation-linked bonds.
* Fixed Income: Government and corporate bonds, floating rate notes, convertible bonds, and other cash instruments.

**What You'll Need**

* 3–6 years of experience in valuation, independent price verification, product control, or quantitative risk — at an investment bank, hedge fund, asset manager, fund administrator, or independent valuation vendor.
* Strong working knowledge and application of derivative pricing and fixed income mathematics: discounting/OIS curves, curve bootstrapping, hazard-rate models for credit, and inflation curve construction.
* Hands-on experience building or maintaining pricing models for at least two of: CDS, IRS, bonds, or inflation swaps.
* Proficiency in Excel/VBA; working knowledge of Python and/or SQL for model development and automation.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative finance field.
* Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex valuation concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* CFA, FRM is big plus
* Familiarity with third-party pricing and analytics platforms such as Bloomberg (BVAL), IHS Markit.
* Prior experience with fair value hierarchy classification (ASC 820 / IFRS 13) and valuation governance frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with FinCad is a strong advantage
* Experience working directly with buy-side clients (hedge funds, asset managers) or within a fund administration / valuation control environment.

description:
**About Us**
We’re Reckitt, home to the world’s best loved and trusted hygiene and health brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
  
  
Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
**About Global Business Services**
Behind our iconic power brands that touch millions of lives daily – from Dettol and Lysol to Durex and Nurofen – lies a dynamic and vital engine: Reckitt's Global Business Services (GBS).
  
  
Fuelled by a culture of positive energy and co-creativity - while learning together - OneReckitt GBS is at the forefront of our business, driving efficiency, standardisation, and innovation across our global operations. We're a fast-paced, purposeful team, constantly seeking to optimise our processes, leverage cutting-edge technology, and deliver exceptional value to every corner of Reckitt. We’re not a traditional back-office function; we’re a strategic powerhouse where diverse individuals with bright minds come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better global business that directly helps achieve Reckitt’s mission
  
  
**About The Role**
As the RTR Senior Manager, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing the end-to-end Record-to-Report (RTR) operations. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and efficiency of core financial processes, including journal entries, reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and period-end close activities.
  
  
Your day-to-day responsibilities will include managing operational delivery across RTR activities, monitoring service levels, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You will lead efforts to resolve escalations, support audit and compliance requirements, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance process standardisation and automation.
  
  
In partnership with Finance, Controllership, and delivery partners, you will identify opportunities to improve data integrity, reduce manual interventions, and strengthen internal controls. Your leadership will be key to delivering timely and accurate financial reporting, maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements, and supporting the broader goals of operational excellence and transformation.
  
  
This role is critical to advancing our OneReckitt GBS ambition by ensuring high-quality service delivery, fostering collaboration, and driving innovation across the RTR landscape.
  
  
Your Responsibilities
  
  

* Drive RTR process excellence by partnering with RTR and Tax GPOs to enhance and standardize global processes.

* Champion automation, digital transformation, and process optimization to improve efficiency and accuracy.

* Monitor service performance, resolve escalations, and address data quality issues.
* Collaborate with Finance, Controllership, Tax, Treasury, and delivery teams to strengthen controls and reporting compliance.
* Support audit readiness and manage responses to internal and external audits.
* Lead, develop, and coach RTR teams, fostering accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Drive adoption of standard processes, tools, and new ways of working.
* Lead or support RTR transformation initiatives focused on standardization, automation, and system optimization.
* Apply effective change management to successfully implement process and system enhancements.

The Experience We're Looking For
  
  

* 12+ years of experience post CA in Record-to-Report (RTR), Finance Operations, or Shared Services, with a strong focus on service delivery and operational excellence.
* Deep expertise in RTR processes, including journal entries, reconciliations, intercompany accounting, fixed assets, and period-end close.
* Proven ability to lead global teams, manage escalations, and drive high-performance service delivery.
* Strong experience in strengthening controls, improving data quality, and enhancing reporting accuracy.
* Hands-on experience with ERP systems and automation tools such as SAP and BlackLine.
* Effective stakeholder management across Finance, Controllership, Tax, and service delivery teams.
* Solid understanding of audit, compliance, and internal control requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and continuous improvement capabilities.
* Experience working within global standardization and transformation programs.
* Skilled in change management, process improvement, and system implementations.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in dynamic environments.
* Proven track record of coaching, developing, and mentoring teams while promoting a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

The Skills For Success
  
  

* Accounting / Controllership knowledge
* Record-to-Report Operations
* Leadership & Interpersonal Skills
* Financial Controls & Compliance
* Data Accuracy & Governance
* ERP systems & Reporting Tools
* Issue Resolution
* Cross-Tower Collaboration
* Process Standardisation, Automation and Optimisation
* Attention to Detail and Timeliness
* Continuous Improvement

What We Offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality

Advance Auto Parts is seeking a highly experienced Senior Manager to lead a team of approximately 25 accounting professionals within the Advance India Innovation Center (AIIC), including three direct reports at the Assistant Manager and Manager levels. **Key Responsibilities**
**Leadership & Operational Oversight**

* Lead, develop, and oversee a team of approximately 25 accounting professionals, including Assistant Managers, Managers, Analysts, and Senior Analysts across General Accounting, Capital/Fixed Assets Accounting, and Cash Accounting.
* Provide clear direction, coaching, talent development, and performance management to build accountability, engagement, and readiness for expanded responsibilities.
* Serve as a senior AIIC liaison to U.S. functional leaders, ensuring priorities, initiatives, deliverables, and projects are understood, executed accurately, and completed on time.
* Navigate relationships effectively across India and U.S. teams, building trust, alignment, and disciplined communication in a matrixed operating environment.
* Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, collaboration, and strong business partnership across the team.

**Process Transformation, AI & Automation**

* Identify, prioritize, and lead AI, automation, and workflow improvement initiatives that reduce manual effort, eliminate non-value-added activities, and create sustainable process efficiencies.
* Partner with functional leaders and technology teams to embed automation into recurring accounting processes, including close, reconciliations, reporting, and analysis.
* Improve close, reconciliation, and reporting cycle times while maintaining accuracy, control discipline, and clear visibility to risks and issues.
* Elevate the team’s contribution from transactional execution to value-added analysis, insights, and proactive support for business decision-making.

**Functional Oversight**

* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities for assigned General Accounting, Capital/Fixed Assets Accounting, and Cash Accounting processes to ensure timely, accurate results.
* Provide functional oversight of journal entries, account reconciliations, variance analysis, and related reporting, ensuring issues are researched, escalated, and resolved appropriately.
* Ensure proper accounting, governance, and controls over fixed assets, capital projects, additions, disposals, and related depreciation processes.
* Oversee cash accounting, bank and cash reconciliations, and related issue resolution, partnering closely with Treasury and U.S. leaders as needed.
* Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, applicable India statutory requirements, company accounting policies, and internal control expectations.

**Controls, Compliance & Audit**

* Support U.S. and India audit requirements by ensuring PBC requests, analyses, and supporting documentation are accurate, complete, and delivered by assigned deadlines.
* Maintain and strengthen SOX and internal control processes by promoting disciplined execution, documentation quality, and timely remediation of control issues.
* Proactively identify operational, accounting, and control risks and communicate clearly with U.S. and India stakeholders to drive timely resolution.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* CA, CA Inter, CPA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* 12+ years of progressive accounting experience, with meaningful exposure to General Accounting, Capital/Fixed Assets Accounting, Cash Accounting, shared services, or controllership operations.
* Proven experience leading managers and large teams in a matrixed, global environment, with the ability to motivate, develop, and hold teams accountable.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and implement AI, automation, and process improvement opportunities that improve efficiency, quality, and scalability.
* Strong business partnering skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and communicate effectively across India and U.S. leadership teams.
* Strong ERP, reporting, and analytical skills; Oracle experience preferred.
* Executive presence, sound judgment, strong communication skills, and a leadership style grounded in collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

title: Estimator - Senior Analyst
description:
**About DESRI**
DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, Houston and Hyderabad (India).
  
  
**About The Role**
In this role, you will work as an embedded member of DESRI’s Preconstruction Estimating function, supporting the U.S.-based Lead Estimator across quantity takeoffs, model setup, bill of materials development, and first-cut cost estimates. You will build a deep understanding of DESRI’s estimating methodology and progressively take on a more active role, moving from groundwork tasks toward taking initial passes at estimates.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Operate as an embedded member of the Estimating team, working under the direction of the U.S.-based Lead Estimator across assigned projects.
* Perform quantity takeoffs and set up the estimating model framework using project design documents, site data, and DESRI templates, providing the Lead Estimator a structured, populated starting point.
* Develop Bills of Materials (BOM) from Hyderabad engineering design output that feed directly into the estimating model, reducing duplicative effort and improving input accuracy.
* Build first-cut Balance of System (BOS) cost estimates using established unit cost databases and project-specific inputs directed by the Lead Estimator, as inputs to the Lead Estimator’s process rather than standalone deliverables.
* Maintain running logs of estimate iterations across project stages, documenting key assumption changes between versions for Lead Estimator reference.
* Compile subcontractor and vendor pricing research, market pricing data, and cost benchmarks to support estimate inputs.
* Build bid pricing levelization models that normalize EPC bids against a common scope baseline, flagging scope inclusions and exclusions that drive pricing variance.
* Support the broader Preconstruction team’s DC/AC analysis and ad-hoc optimization exercises, serving as a connection point with the Hyderabad engineering team on overbuild and equipment selection workflows.
* Progressively take initial passes at estimates as familiarity with DESRI’s templates and methodology develops, expanding into a more active role in the estimating process over time.
* Pull reference data, precedent project information, and market comparables to support general research and technical benchmarking for the Estimating Lead.
* Identify and flag opportunities for automation, standardisation, or process improvement within the estimating workflow, in coordination with the Lead Estimator.
* Help enable the Lead Estimator to focus on quality control, methodology, and final estimate ownership, rather than the labor-intensive groundwork of getting an estimate off the ground.

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering, or a Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or related field.
* Around 2–5 years of experience in cost estimating, quantity surveying, or quantity takeoffs, ideally within infrastructure, energy, or EPC/construction environments. Renewable energy experience is preferred but not required.
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with comfort building and maintaining detailed cost models and take-off quantities.
* Demonstrated curiosity around technology, automation, and process improvement, ideally with evidence of having built or implemented something that lasted.
* Working knowledge of estimating software and unit cost databases, and strong Excel skills; exposure to Power BI or similar tools is an advantage.
* Strong organisational and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly document assumptions and estimate logic for U.S.-based stakeholders.
* Comfort operating across multiple projects and estimate workstreams simultaneously, in an environment where scope is not always fully defined.
* A proactive and detail-oriented approach, with the judgment to flag scope gaps, pricing outliers, and inconsistencies for Lead Estimator review.

description:
**Company**
Qualcomm India Private Limited
  
  
**Job Area**
Operations Group, Operations Group > Project Analyst
  
  
**General Summary**
The CHS (Central Hardware System) Operations team is looking for a Staff Project Analyst, based in India, with a drive to self-succeed and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. This person will lead operations and resource planning across the chipset programs we engage on out of the region, providing program and operations support to hardware engineering and design teams while working closely with global cross-geo teams across US time zones. They will lead the development and management of processes, procedures, and tools that increase productivity and improve existing flows, and recommend alternate system management tools to satisfy core business objectives
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of relevant work experience.

OR
  
  
Associate's degree and 4+ years of relevant work experience.
  
  
OR
  
  
High School Diploma or equivalent and 6+ years of relevant work experience.
  
  

* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead operations, resource, and capacity planning across the region's chipset programs — spanning CAD, Mechanical, and PCB design activities — in partnership with hardware platform program managers.
* Own and continuously enhance CHS Operations systems, SharePoint lists, and Power Automate flows that support program execution; drive enhancement requests from intake through release.
* Own end-to-end hardware R&D program management — project-manage from design through tape-out, fab, builds, bring-up, testing, and release.
* Own external design-services partner bookkeeping and planning (Mechanical, PCB layout, and PCB library): work with Contracts and Finance on purchase orders, accounting, and capacity loading, and automate these functions where possible.
* Lead financial roll-ups across products and quarters by partnering with cross-functional teams; deliver clear, audit-ready summaries for executive review and official submission.
* Drive the fiscal year budget intake and consolidation process; build and operate budget dashboards that give leadership a real-time view of plan vs. actuals and forecast risk.
* Design, build, and maintain executive dashboards using Power BI (and Tableau where applicable) that turn operational data into decisions; define KPIs, data models, and refresh cadence.
* Provide operations leadership and consultation to functional teams across the program; serve as the connective tissue between program management, engineering, finance, and supplier-facing teams.
* Lead resource planning, capacity modeling, and gap analysis across active and pipeline projects; surface staffing and bandwidth risks early.
* Drive product reviews across core program meetings — own agendas, capture decisions and action items, and hold owners accountable to closure with documented evidence.
* Own end-to-end management of program milestones, change requests, and risks.
* Coordinate material ordering for Mechanical teardowns and prototype builds, and support substrate prototype ordering.
* Establish and roll out new program management processes, methods, and tools (tracking systems, schedules, databases, documentation management) — and retire those that no longer deliver value.
* Lead project planning activities including integrated schedules, work breakdown structures, dependency maps, and critical-path analysis.
* Architect Power Automate workflows on top of new and existing SharePoint lists to eliminate manual operational toil and improve data quality.
* Mentor junior project analysts and program coordinators; codify reusable templates, playbooks, and operating standards.

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 8+ years of progressive experience supporting project management and execution in a technology, semiconductor, or hardware operations environment, including demonstrated ownership of cross-functional programs and direct influence on senior-leader decisions.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel (complex formulas, pivots, Power Query), SharePoint Online (lists and document libraries), Power Automate, Power BI, PowerPoint, and Visio.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to organize and articulate complex information for both engineering and executive audiences.
* Strong presentation skills, sharp analytical judgment, and rigorous attention to detail.
* Working understanding of the semiconductor product lifecycle, from concept through high-volume manufacturing.
* Demonstrated ability to operate across multiple time zones and cultures with global teams and external suppliers, including regular collaboration with US-based teams.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Experience with SQL, Python, or other scripting languages to automate data pipelines and reporting.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI-assisted analytics, or other modern automation platforms applied to operations workflows.
* Jira at program scale, including dashboards, queries, and workflow customization.
* Familiarity with Agile and hybrid program management practices.
* Experience standing up new operational processes from scratch and scaling them across a global organization.
* Prior experience presenting to Director, VP, or SVP-level audiences.

Bookkeeping and records

description:
**About DESRI**
DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Pursuing Chartered Accountancy course, having cleared CA-Inter/IPCC in first or second attempt, and having completed a minimum of one year of articleship
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to take initiative with limited direction and guidance
* Duration of the role is nine to twelve months

**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will prepare, review, and file U.S. GAAP-based financial statements for the company's renewable energy projects, investment funds, and corporate entities (collectively, the “Entities”), while maintaining books and records in accordance with U.S. GAAP and ensuring adherence to close timelines and control procedures.
