title: Software Development Engineer, Finance Technology
description: DescriptionWe are responsible for billions of dollars of payments each month to millions of Amazon vendors across the globe. We delight our vendors by paying them when they want and how they want, accurately and on time.We build software applications that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually, rivaling the complexity and scope of dedicated payments fintech companies. Our systems decide how and when a payment happens, carry it out across the world's payment networks, and account for it — all under real regulatory, tax, and audit obligations, in every geography Amazon operates in.You will have the opportunity to work in a high-paced environment leveraging the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) within our core principles of engineering, to deliver faster and ship features incrementally.Ownership is the center of this role, and ownership here means the whole lifecycle rather than just the code. You will take features from working backwards from the customer through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and documentation — and you stay accountable for how they behave in production long after they ship.Own features and components of our payment systems end-to-end. The business problem and the technology direction will be understood; how to actually build it will not be, and that part is yours.Design the solution and make the tradeoffs. You will code independently, and you will have senior and principal engineers to pull in when a tradeoff is genuinely hard or when a design needs to line up with where the architecture is heading.Work directly with product managers and business stakeholders — finance, tax, and accounts payable operations — to understand what they need and why, so that you build the right thing. You will hear the requirement first-hand rather than through a written hand-off, and you will be expected to push back when the ask and the outcome do not line up.Ship incrementally. Large payment changes land safely through staged rollout and measurement, not through a single release.Reduce operational load. Our best work turns a recurring manual intervention into a code fix or a self-healing mechanism, not another runbook step.Leave the system better explained than you found it. What you build should be maintainable and extensible by an engineer who has never seen it, which means clear documentation and design choices that hold up without you in the room.Raise the bar around you: code review as a teaching mechanism, mentoring engineers earlier in their careers, and getting new teammates productive on how our software is built, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.Building with agentic AIWe are not experimenting with AI on the side — it is how we work. You will use AI agents across the development lifecycle: exploring unfamiliar systems, drafting and reviewing designs, generating and testing code, triaging production issues, and automating the operational work that used to consume a week of on-call. We expect engineers to be strong directors of these agents and rigorous verifiers of their output. The judgment stays with you: you are accountable for what ships, whether you typed it or an agent did. Agentic capabilities are increasingly part of the systems themselves — automating decisions and investigations that previously required a human in the loop — and you will have room to build them.Why this teamPayments is one of the few places in software where the business logic is genuinely hard, the scale is enormous, and a mistake has an immediate real-world consequence — a vendor who does not get paid when they expected. The
**Senior Manager, Sales & Operations Finance – FP&A**
will be based in
**Hyderabad, India**
. In this position, you will report to the Director, Cost Accounting. We are seeking an experienced finance professional to partner closely with Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Operations to drive high-quality forecasting, improve pipeline visibility, and provide commercial financial insights. The role requires a proactive individual who can challenge assumptions, identify business risks, and translate operational developments into financial impact to support informed decision-making. The ideal candidate is a business-oriented finance professional who acts as a trusted advisor rather than a traditional controller. They are comfortable engaging with Sales leaders, asking challenging questions, validating assumptions, identifying risks early, and providing actionable financial insights that improve forecast accuracy and business performance.
  
  
Watch “Culture is our Passion” to learn more about us
  
  
**We Are Looking For Someone Who Demonstrates**

* Passionate drive to innovate and create
* Integrity to the core
* Enthusiastic customer focus
* Consistent interactive teamwork
* Desire for continuous improvement and top performance.

**Here Is a Glimpse Of What You Will Do**

* Review and assess the quality and health of the sales pipeline and order backlog.
* Challenge sales forecasts and assumptions using financial and operational analysis.
* Partner with Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Project teams to develop accurate order intake and order booking forecasts.
* Identify potential commercial and execution risks that may impact revenue, margins, cash flow, and profitability.
* Quantify business risks and opportunities, translating them into financial implications for management.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and recommend actions to improve predictability of business performance.
* Support monthly forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning activities.
* Develop financial models and scenario analyses for management decision-making.
* Prepare management reports, dashboards, and presentations highlighting key business drivers and risks.
* Drive cross-functional discussions to improve forecast quality and operational performance.
* Ensure correctness of data in Salesforce, NS and other relevant tools

**Here Is Some Of What You Will Need (required)**

* Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Economics, or related field.
* Professional qualification (CA, CMA, CPA, ACCA, MBA Finance, or equivalent) preferred.
* (12-15) years of experience in Commercial Finance, Sales Finance, FP&A, Business Controlling, or Sales Operations Finance.
* Experience working with sales organizations in manufacturing, industrial, engineering, energy, EPC, or technology sectors is highly desirable.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen.
* Deep understanding of sales pipeline management, order intake, and revenue forecasting.
* Flexible to work in US time zone

**Here Are a Few Of Our Preferred Experiences**

* Ability to challenge business assumptions constructively using data and financial analysis.
* Strong stakeholder management with the ability to influence senior business leaders.
* Experience translating operational risks into financial outcomes.
* Advanced analytical and financial modelling skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong proficiency in Excel, Power BI, SAP, Oracle, or other ERP/BI tools.
* Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and fast-paced environment.

At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.
  
  
**We are Nextpower**

title: Sr Associate Transactional Finance
description:
**Job Description**
Amgen’s Research and Development (R&D) Business Operations organization addresses complex business challenges with outstanding people, tools, and processes. The team delivers on key initiatives and capabilities to support R&D and key Amgen partner organizations. The senior associate in Transactional Finance is responsible for supporting end to end financial transactions and ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of supplier contracting processes within the Global Business Transactions Center (GBTC). We are looking for talent who have capabilities in resource and expense management, which include but are not limited to, accounting of resources and expenses, data analytical skills to provide insights and enable decision making as well as a strong financial and system acumen. This role requires a solid understanding of Ariba, Anaplan and SAP software and its functionalities, as well as a solid background in general contracting and/or supplier management processes. The senior associate will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sourcing, accounts payable, and finance, to ensure smooth and seamless financial operations. We are a team that delivers for our partners!
  
  
Required Competencies and Skills:
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Execute financial transactions including purchase order processing, invoice verification, payment processing, and expense management activities using Anaplan, Ariba, and SAP.
* Partner with business functions to plan and manage resources, budgets, and expenses.
* Maintain budget trackers, line-item records, and monthly actuals reporting.
* Reconcile financial transactions against planned activities and identify discrepancies for leadership review.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, internal controls, and regulatory requirements.
* Manage master data, vendor information, cost centers, WBS elements, scopes, quotes, and supporting documentation within Ariba and SAP.
* Partner with Responsible Amgen Employees (RAEs) and suppliers to maintain accurate financial and procurement records.
* Review supplier documentation for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to required formats.
* Coordinate supplier onboarding, SIF updates, Ariba enablement, and vendor account maintenance activities.
* Monitor and maintain the status of purchase orders, invoices, ePayments, approvals, tickets, and supplier actions.
* Follow up on routine transactional issues through resolution and provide timely status updates to stakeholders.
* Collect, analyze, and interpret financial data using Smartsheet, OPTS, Tableau, Ariba, and SAP reports.
* Prepare recurring and ad hoc financial reports, dashboards, and analytics to support business decision-making.
* Identify trends, insights, cost-saving opportunities, and process improvement recommendations.
* Support invoice submissions, payment follow-ups, PO maintenance, PO closeouts, accrual documentation, amortization tracking, transfers, and quarterly LE reporting activities.
* Produce reports on budget status, PO and invoice aging, payment status, commitments, and documentation completeness.
* Collaborate with sourcing, accounts payable, finance, and other cross-functional teams to streamline financial processes and resolve transactional issues.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders and external suppliers.
* Support audit activities by maintaining accurate, complete, and audit-ready documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance process efficiency, accuracy, and operational effectiveness.
* Provide guidance and support to users on Ariba and SAP processes, functionalities, and best practices.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, user guides, and training materials as required.
* Review proposed arrangements through Amgen’s healthcare compliance system of record (C3).
* Provide C3 system support and address healthcare compliance-related questions from Amgen staff.
* Perform activities in accordance with Amgen’s Healthcare Compliance Policy and Standard Operating Procedures.

Knowledge:
  
  

* Excellent computer and MS Office skills
* Working knowledge of MyBuy/Ariba, SAP, Anaplan or the approved finance tracker, supplier onboarding requirements and basic financial coding.
* Good writing skills; detail-oriented
* Communicates effectively within and outside department
* Solid understanding of purchasing and supply chain procedures.
* Solid understanding of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and healthcare regulations.
* Solid understanding of standard contracting legal principles.

Problem Solving:
  
  

* Ability to process transactions from end to end, engaging business partners where appropriate.
* Identify routine issues, including missing information, non-compliant supplier documentation, incorrect coding, invoice/payment discrepancies and process delays and escalate business issues needing resolution.
* Review invoice/expenses and triage or escalate any issues.
* Communicate and escalate contractual and/or payment challenges to leadership team.
* Engage with functions to assist with planning and managing resources and expenses.
* Handling financials for assigned expense collections including tracking and reporting.
* Participating in and contributing to initiatives related to resource and expense management.
* Exercises good judgment.
* Interact with business partners to ensure compliance processes and standards are understood and followed.
* Maintain key relationships by communicating and collaborating with cross-functional partners such as Law, Regulatory and other Worldwide Compliance and Business Ethics groups, and the International Healthcare Compliance group.
* Time management and problem-solving skills.
* Manage payment inquiries that are received from HCPs (Healthcare Professional), RAEs (Responsible Amgen Employee), Service Providers etc. Outcome may include further reviews, research and/or triage.
* Other duties as assigned.

As a creative problem solver with a get it done approach, responsibilities include:
  
  

* Handling financials for assigned expense collections including tracking and reporting.
* Participating in and contributing to initiatives related to resource and expense management.
* Administrative tasks such as maintaining external and internal facing SharePoint sites and intake request tools.
* Perform data entry (i.e. for Study Planning), administrative coordination, compliance checks, and document management for business related activities.
* Provide support as required for Planisware and financial systems, such as Ariba/MyBuy.
* Provide support to resolve issues and ensure compliance with departmental playbook.
* Generation of Purchase Orders and Change Orders within internal system.
* Support for budget confirmation and PO-tracking.
* Resolution of invoice issues and escalations as required.
* Communicate clearly with RAEs, Finance, GSS, Procurement and suppliers to gather information, confirm next steps and ensure requests do not stall.
* Assists with urgent/high profile requests and projects as needed, onboarding and training of new hires.
* Initiation of CDAs, MTAs and other requested agreements.
* Controlled substance requisition approvals.
* Attends meetings as required and support the resolution of procure-to-pay technical issues.
* Supplier onboarding and vendor account updates
* Appropriate document management for business related activities to enable requisition creation to invoice payment.
* Appropriate business administration coordination per playbook
* Data entry into study planning systems per playbook, including study number generation and support of ad hoc inquires.

**Require Qualifications:**
Master's OR Bachelor’s degree and 5 - 9 years years of related resource management, paralegal, contracting and/or financial accounting experience.
  
  
**Preferred Requirements**

* Familiarity with research and clinical development in biopharmaceutical industry as well as medical and scientific terminology.
* Finance, resource, and budget management experience including cost analysis and reporting.
* Experience with analytics software (Microsoft Access, Spotfire, Tableau, Smartsheet), document management applications, portfolio planning tools, supply chain and financial systems (Planisware, Veeva, SAP, Ariba).
* Intermediate Microsoft Office user (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Experience working with virtual teams and using collaborative tools and platforms.
* Exceptional interpersonal, organizational, critical thinking and verbal/written communication skills
* Ability to work in a highly cross matrixed environment
* Strong planning and project management skills with the demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with multiple high priority projects and minimal supervision.

**Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

s Oracle Fusion AMS

title: Senior BP&A Analyst - Enablement
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company’s patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
  
  
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Senior Analyst will support the company’s long-term forecasting process across the product portfolio, with primary responsibility for building, maintaining, and enhancing product-level financial models. This role will support strategic finance and M&A-related work, including forecasted income statement modeling, transaction structure analysis, discounted cash flow analysis, and other ad hoc business cases. The ideal candidate will bring strong modeling skills, high attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities across recurring forecasting needs and project-based analyses.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and maintain long-term forecast models across products in the portfolio.
* Support the forecasting process by updating assumptions, validating inputs, and ensuring model integrity and consistency.
* Build and enhance models for PLM stage gate business cases and other strategic initiatives.
* Provide ad hoc modeling support for FPM requests, including organic opportunities, scenario analysis, and other business needs.
* Support M&A and strategic finance analyses, including forecasted income statement modeling, transaction structure evaluation, discounted cash flow analysis, and related business case development.
* Prepare clear, accurate, and well-structured analyses, presentations, and supporting materials for internal stakeholders and leadership.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and translate business issues into analytical output
* Review data quality, reconcile key drivers, and help ensure the accuracy and consistency of deliverables.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
* Strong experience in financial modeling, forecasting, and analytical problem-solving.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to build, maintain, and troubleshoot complex models and communicate outputs clearly.
* Experience with scenario analysis, business case development, and forecast-based modeling.
* Familiarity with valuation concepts such as discounted cash flow analysis and transaction-related financial analysis.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and ability to produce accurate work under tight deadlines.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work with stakeholders across functions and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, troubleshoot issues, and work both independently and collaboratively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in business valuation, strategic finance, commercial finance, or product forecasting.
* Experience supporting portfolio planning, pharma business cases, or lifecycle management analyses.
* Exposure to M&A, transaction structure analysis, or broader corporate finance projects.
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical or healthcare forecasting is a plus.
* Experience working with global teams or supporting stakeholders across geographies.

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Planning & Reporting CoE Senior Officer
description:
**About Us**
We’re Reckitt, home to the world’s best loved and trusted hygiene and health brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
  
  
Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
**About The Finance Planning & Reporting CoE**
Driving efficiency and standardization across our renowned consumer brands that enhance everyday lives—from nourishing meals to trusted household essentials—is the pivotal force of the Finance Planning & Reporting Center of Excellence (CoE). Fuelled by a culture of collaboration and innovation, the CoE is integral to our organization, championing financial excellence and strategic insight across our global landscape. We are a dynamic, agile team, relentlessly focused on enhancing our financial processes, harnessing advanced analytics, and delivering unparalleled value to every facet of our business.
  
  
We transcend traditional finance roles; we are a strategic partner where diverse talents converge to tackle intricate financial challenges, foster sustainable growth, and empower our mission to create a healthier, more sustainable world for all. By ensuring a clear line of sight between strategic goals and day-to-day financial activities, we enable efficient performance management and better business results through the collaboration of our people, processes, and systems.
  
  
Our CoE transforms finance from a traditional back-office function into a strategic powerhouse that drives business value, as talented individuals come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better business.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Officer in the Finance CoE, you will report into a Finance Manager and be part of a team of analysts supporting a portfolio of markets. In this role, you will play a key part in executing financial planning and reporting activities across these markets. You will support the creation of standardized reports, development of initial forecasts/budgets, and analysis of financial performance to enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
This position offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure to multiple markets while contributing to the centralization and improvement of Reckitt’s FP&A processes. If you are passionate about finance, data analysis, and continuous improvement, this role will allow you to grow and make a real impact on our global business.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Produce and consolidate financial reports for monthly and quarterly results, ensuring key performance metrics (sales, profitability, costs, etc.) are accurately reported and delivered on time to global and regional stakeholders.
* Conduct variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) and clearly explain drivers behind the numbers, highlighting trends and insights that inform business decisions.
* Support the planning and forecasting cycles, including annual budgets and periodic forecasts: coordinate data collection from different markets, validate submissions, and align assumptions with global guidelines to create a cohesive financial outlook.
* Manage and enhance financial dashboards and reports (e.g. in Power BI or similar tools) to provide users with intuitive, up-to-date views of financial performance. Ensure that dashboards capture the right KPIs and that data is consistent across all reporting outputs.
* Participate in finance transformation initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline and improve existing FP&A processes. You’ll contribute to standardizing report templates, automating manual tasks, and sharing best practices that elevate our CoE’s efficiency and impact.
* Collaborate closely with market finance teams and other CoE members to ensure data integrity and one-source-of-truth in our financial systems. You will act as a liaison, helping local teams understand CoE processes and troubleshooting data or reporting issues to maintain accuracy.
* Assist with ad-hoc analysis and projects as needed, such as deep-dives into specific expenses or trends, scenario modeling for strategic projects, or financial deck preparation for senior leadership meetings. Your ability to turn data into actionable insights will be key in these projects.
* Adapt and excel in a dynamic environment – our CoE is continually evolving. You’ll be expected to handle last-minute changes or requests, work under tight deadlines especially during key reporting periods, and maintain a high standard of quality. In doing so, you’ll demonstrate agility, teamwork, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* 2-3years of experience in finance, analytics, or a related field, ideally within the CPG sector.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with reporting tools (e.g., Power BI).
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

The skills for success
  
  

* Financial Analysis & Reporting
* Strategic Planning
* Business Partnering
* Process Improvement
* Data Visualization Skills
* Project Management
* Team Leadership
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Change Management
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Senior Finance Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Record to Report (R2R) Specialist to join our finance team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for end-to-end accounting processes including payments, reconciliations, month-end close, and financial reporting, while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and strong stakeholder communication.
  
  
This role demands hands-on experience in Oracle ERP and other accounting tools, combined with strong analytical skills and the ability to manage client interactions effectively.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage month-end and quarter-end closing activities, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting.
* Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, and adjustments in Oracle.
* Perform bank, intercompany, and balance sheet reconciliations with complete documentation and follow-up on open items.
* Oversee vendor and intercompany payments, ensuring adherence to approval workflows and payment timelines.
* Support treasury and cash flow management through accurate transaction posting and fund reconciliation.
* Lead or participate in client calls to discuss open items, deliverables, and monthly reporting.
* Collaborate with internal teams (AP, AR, FP&A) for seamless month-end close.
* Provide required reports and supporting documents for audits and management reviews.
* Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance accuracy and efficiency in R2R operations.

**Required Skills**

* Strong understanding of accounting principles (GAAP/IFRS) and the Record to Report cycle.
* Proficiency in Oracle ERP (mandatory); exposure to SAP, Blackline, or Hyperion is a plus.
* Advanced MS Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliations).
* Excellent communication and client-handling skills for calls, reporting, and stakeholder updates.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, or Accounting (B.Com / B.Sc Finance).
* Preferred: CA (Inter), CMA, CPA, or MBA in Finance.
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in R2R / General Ledger / Reconciliation / Month-End Close roles.
* Prior experience in a shared service environment or client-facing role preferred.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Position Title: GROUP REPORTING - Senior**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Managing end to end Group reporting implementation projects and team for generating and review of monthly, quarterly, half-yearly- and year-end consolidation figures.
* Experience with a large and complex IFRS consolidation process and assist in producing the consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS and GAAP standards.

**Your Key Responsibilities**
Reporting module:
  
  

* Managing end to end Group reporting implementation projects and team for generating and review of monthly, quarterly, half-yearly- and year-end consolidation figures.
* Experience with a large and complex IFRS consolidation process and assist in producing the consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS and GAAP standards.
* Consolidation of business unit performance reporting and production of periodic management reporting on Actuals, budgets and forecasts.
* Create and improve financial reporting which are used for validating and analysing reported figures and make process improvement suggestions where applicable.
* Analyse reported figures and discuss/follow-up with the respective regional financial manager or controller Full.
* Consult on technical (IFRS) questions coming from reporting units.
* Customization and mapping of financial statement item with G/L.
* Assist on Integration of Group reporting with the S/4 Hana applications and providing the needed suggestion and expertise on scope and limitations.
* Integration experience of SAP Group Reporting with SAP FICO on S/4 HANA.
* Set up of Attributes, Breakdown Categories, Sub item & sub item categories.
* Set up of hierarchies for FS item, consolidation units/groups and other dimensions.
* Configuration of Balance carry forwards and Currency translation methods.
* Experience in configuring inter-unit eliminations/reclassification and Manual eliminations.
* Purchase / Equity Methods of Consolidation.
* Able to set up Data monitor and Consolidation monitor.
* Experience in “activity-based” consolidation of investments.

title: Business Portfolio Partner - Biosimilars
description:
Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
**Good Health Can’t Wait**
.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

**Job Description**

**Job summary**
  
We are looking for an individual in the portfolio analytics role that would support product ideation and selection process. The role involves detailed quantitative and qualitative evaluation of pipeline attributes such as disease area, epidemiology, competitive intelligence, asset valuation. The role also involves custom database development and utilization of visualization tools for senior leadership interaction to drive decision making.
  
  
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

1. Product and Market Analytics

Conduct qualitative and quantitative market analysis for biologics across geographies to assess therapy, pricing, patient populations, unmet needs, and competitive dynamics. Leverage internal and external data sources (e.g., IQVIA, GlobalData, ASP, DRG, IPD) to generate insights on price erosion, biosimilar penetration, and competition impact. Support the analytics through design and maintenance of customized databases to enable senior leadership level visualization.

2. Financial Modeling & Valuation

Develop and maintain financial models incorporating key assumptions such as market share, price erosion, competition, and biosimilar uptake. Build long‑term forecasts using both bottom‑up (patient‑based) and top‑down approaches, accounting for regulatory, market, and geopolitical factors. Evaluate product viability through NPV, IRR, and scenario analysis to support make‑vs‑buy and investment decisions. Work with frontend markets to develop consolidated business case for the products.

3. Integrated Product Strategy

Define the objectives of a program to towards definition of the Product Requirement Document, a product development road map through considerations technical aspects of product development and life cycle management such as - CMC, Clinical etc.

4. Stakeholder Management

Collaborate closely with Business Development, Finance, Strategy, Product Management, R&D, IP, and Market teams to integrate inputs and enable informed decision‑making.

**Qualifications**

**Educational qualification:**
Masters in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Biotech, or similar fields, with an MBA with specialization in any of Finance, Operations, Strategy, Analytics
  
  
  
  
**Minimum work experience**
: 4 to 7 years of experience in portfolio management, product management or business development
  
  
  
  
**Skills & attributes:
  
  
  
  
Technical Skills**
  
• Hands-on work experience in designing and developing financial models, including expertise in financial modelling related to licensing, cost analysis, and evaluation of financial accounts.
  
  
• Strong proficiency in MS Office Suite, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  
  
• General understanding of Portfolio Management principles.
  
  
• Solid understanding of drug product development processes, including the various stages involved in bringing a pharmaceutical product to market.
  
  
• Knowledge of healthcare databases, routine financial reporting, and a strong ability to handle analytical data within the healthcare context.
  
  
• Expertise in financial analysis, including the use of visualization tools for data interpretation.
  
  
• Understanding of the global regulatory framework in the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries.
  
  
• Knowledge and experience in conducting program and stage gate reviews, with a focus on evaluating business cases.
  
  
• Fundamental knowledge of Quality principles, Formulation Development, Manufacturing processes, and Supply Chain management within the pharmaceutical industry.
  
  
  
  
**Behavioural skills**
  
• Demonstrates proficiency in negotiations and sensitivity to cross-cultural dynamics.
  
  
• Maintains objectivity and effectively works in ambiguous situations.
  
  
• Possesses a strong blend of strategic thinking and execution skills, aligning cross-functional teams for successful outcomes.
  
  
• Exhibits self-initiative and resilience, proactively addressing challenges.
  
  
• Communicates effectively and engages with senior leaders, showcasing strong communication skills.

**Additional Information**

**About the Department
  
  
Biologics**
  
Currently operates in the Global Biosimilars business - a segment that is poised for attractive and sustained growth over the next 10–15-year time horizon.
  
  
With a robust portfolio of biosimilar products across key therapeutic areas, covering ~US$80+ Bn in innovator sales – future business pipeline covers a variety of product classes and therapy areas, and new modalities. Fully integrated organization with over two decades of experience in developing, manufacturing and commercializing multiple biosimilar products.
  
  
With a Product Development engine that has end-to-end capabilities – in-house clone development, upstream and downstream process development, bioanalytical development and proprietary formulation.
  
  
Supported by a Clinical and Regulatory team with experience in executing complex biosimilar programs with innovative global trial designs.
  
  
We have a proven experience in commercial-scale manufacturing across a variety of technology platforms with global quality standards and a highly competitive cost structure
  
  
Rich experience of commercializing high-quality biosimilars in multiple markets with over 900,000 patients having benefited from our products till date.
  
  
  
  
**Benefits Offered**
  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
  
  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
  
  
  
  
**Our Work Culture**
  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
  
  
For more details, please visit our career website at
**https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/**

title: Senior Associate, Strategy and Growth

**About SucSEED**
SucSEED is the Investment Manager of SEBI-regulated SucSEED Indovation Fund, an AIF Category-I Venture Capital Fund. We partner with ambitious founders and build long-term institutional platforms in India’s early-stage ecosystem. We have also set up a Fund Management Entity in GIFT City Gujarat to launch our Fund-III in USD denomination.
  
  
We nurture entrepreneurial talent through capital — and venture talent through ownership and responsibility.
  
  
**About The Role**
The full-time fellowship program is for a year and is aimed at giving the fellows a full taste of what happens in a VC fund. For deserving candidates, the program provides a full-time offer from SucSEED or its associated firms.
  
  
Working within the Healthtech, Medtech, Lifesciences and Wellness sectors requires evaluating opportunities across the entire ecosystem- providers, payers, patients, regulators, and technology enablers. Fellows will develop a sector-wide perspective, analyzing companies at various stages of maturity through both clinical and commercial lenses. The role requires evaluating clinical validation, regulatory pathways, reimbursement dynamics, hospital adoption cycles, and scientific defensibility- making this fellowship uniquely analytical and impact-driven.
  
  
In this Fellowship, you will be expected to learn & understand the progress in the sector, build & maintain valuation-related analysis, prepare write-ups, present investment ideas to the Sectoral Committee, Investment Mgmt Team, Partners & Investment Committees, in order to take an informed call on early-stage deals. Once invested, grow the PortCo and create value for Investors through a healthy Exit.
  
  
**Role Mandate & Key Responsibilities**

* Buy-side Sectoral Research leading to Pre-Deal discovery
* Responsible for conducting primary & Secondary market research around Technology Innovation in various Sectors of SucSEED's Investment thesis to identify opportunities for growth & innovation and convert into Annual Buy-side Sectoral Research.
* Evaluate scalable healthtech, medtech opportunities with faster time-to-market and revenue realization, in the areas of diagnostic technologies, remote monitoring, digital care models, preventive medicine, etc.
* Map the healthcare value chain to identify whitespace tech-driven opportunities and unmet clinical needs.
* Track Healthcare regulatory developments (CDSCO, FDA, CE, etc.) and assess their impact on investment viability.
* Benchmark business models, pricing structures, and reimbursement dynamics across geographies.
* Assess capital intensity, time-to-market, and risk-adjusted return profiles of healthcare segments.
* Attend various events in the sector and analyse Industry trends/ data to identify patterns & Partners to work with
* Build Community
* Create a Community of various stakeholders (Incubators, Accelerators, Funds, Regulators, Institutions, Investors, Corporations, etc) to create value in that sector and use them effectively to conduct Sectoral Research
* Create a platform for Startup founders to pitch their solutions & discover deals more proactively.
* Discover more Sectoral Curators from this community to help shape the Fund's roadmap.
* Deal Discovery
* Work with various Incubators & Sourcing Partners such as CCMB, IIHMR, IITM, IIITH, IIMB and other Accelerators to discover innovations matching our investment themes (inbound & outbound)
* Filter, Screen & interact with founders to appreciate their solutions.
* Collaborate with Sectoral Curators to help shape Fund roadmaps & discover deals accordingly.
* Investment Mgmt & Deal Execution
* Conduct Investment analysis based on product features, market size & business projections to build a case to invest.
* Work with the Investment committee to identify investment interest and ensure the Investment Memo covers all the salient points to get approval from the committees & LPs, delivered on time, as per the scope.

As part of a newly established global Commercial Project and Revenue organization, this position will play a key role in building scalable processes, developing team capabilities, driving operational excellence, and supporting SAP S/4HANA transformation and global process harmonization initiatives.

* Ensure accurate, timely, and compliant processing of sales orders and WBS structures in alignment with customer contracts, business requirements, and service level expectations.

* Build strong partnerships across Commercial, Finance, Program Management, Operations, Digital, and ERP teams.

**What We Are Looking For**

title: Accounting Manager
description:
**Accounting Manager**

**Designation:**
Accounting Manager

**Experience:**
8 - 10+ Years

**Industry:**
IT Services / IT Staffing

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented
**Accounting Manager**
to manage end-to-end accounting operations for an IT Services company. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in general accounting, financial reporting, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, taxation, statutory compliance, and month-end and year-end closing activities.

The role requires hands-on accounting knowledge, strong analytical skills, and the ability to ensure accurate financial records, timely reporting, compliance with applicable regulations, and effective financial controls.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Accounting Operations**

* Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including journal entries, ledger maintenance, and general bookkeeping.
* Oversee general ledger scrutiny and ensure accurate recording of all financial transactions.
* Manage month-end and year-end closing activities.
* Prepare and review trial balances, profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and other financial statements.
* Maintain proper accounting records, supporting documents, and audit trails.
* Ensure accounting practices comply with applicable Indian Accounting Standards and statutory requirements.
* Experience in a Shared Services environment is preferred, with the ability to manage centralized accounting operations, standardize financial processes, and ensure accuracy, efficiency, and compliance across multiple business units or entities.

**2. Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable**

* Manage vendor invoices, payment processing, expense booking, and vendor reconciliations.
* Oversee customer invoicing, billing accuracy, outstanding receivables, and collections follow-ups.
* Monitor debtor and creditor ageing reports and resolve discrepancies.
* Reconcile customer and vendor accounts regularly.
* Track employee reimbursements, advances, and other business expenses.
* Ensure timely processing of payments and accurate recording of receipts.

**3. Bank and General Ledger Reconciliation**

* Perform and review bank reconciliations on a regular basis.
* Reconcile general ledger accounts, vendor accounts, customer accounts, and intercompany balances, where applicable.
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies, unidentified transactions, and unreconciled balances.
* Ensure all financial transactions are properly supported and recorded in the accounting system.

**4. Billing and Revenue Accounting – IT Services**

* Manage client billing, invoice preparation, and revenue-related accounting entries.
* Verify billing inputs against approved contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), timesheets, and project records, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate with delivery, HR, recruitment, and operations teams to validate billing and payroll-related inputs.
* Track unbilled revenue, outstanding invoices, and customer payment status.
* Ensure appropriate revenue recognition in accordance with applicable accounting principles and contractual terms.

**5. Taxation and Statutory Compliance**

* Handle and monitor GST compliance, including GST returns, input tax credit reconciliation, and related documentation.
* Manage TDS calculations, deductions, payments, returns, and reconciliations.
* Support income tax compliance and preparation of relevant financial information.
* Maintain records for applicable Professional Tax, Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and other statutory obligations in coordination with the respective teams.
* Ensure timely filing of applicable returns and payment of statutory dues.
* Coordinate with tax consultants and statutory authorities, wherever required.

**6. Payroll Accounting and Expense Management**

* Review payroll inputs and ensure accurate accounting of salary expenses, deductions, reimbursements, and employee-related liabilities.
* Reconcile payroll reports with accounting records.
* Coordinate with HR and Finance teams for payroll accounting, employee advances, and final settlement entries.
* Monitor operating expenses and ensure proper expense classification and supporting documentation.
* Maintain records of fixed assets, depreciation, and other applicable accounting adjustments.

**7. Financial Reporting and MIS**

* Prepare monthly financial statements and management reports.
* Generate monthly Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, Trial Balances, and cash and bank summaries.
* Prepare accounts receivable and payable ageing reports.
* Assist in budgeting, expense monitoring, and variance analysis.
* Provide accurate financial data and accounting insights to management for decision-making.
* Maintain entity-wise financial records and reporting, wherever applicable.

**8. Audit and Internal Controls**

* Coordinate with internal and external auditors during financial and statutory audits.
* Prepare schedules, ledgers, reconciliations, and supporting documents required for audits.
* Ensure compliance with accounting policies, financial procedures, and approval workflows.
* Identify accounting discrepancies and recommend corrective actions.
* Strengthen internal controls and maintain proper documentation for all financial transactions.

**9. Accounting Systems and Team Coordination**

* Work with accounting software such as Tally, Zoho Books, or other ERP/accounting systems.
* Maintain accurate accounting data and ensure timely updates in the financial system.
* Identify opportunities to streamline accounting processes and improve reporting efficiency.
* Coordinate with HR, Operations, Delivery, Sales, and Management teams on finance-related matters.
* Guide and review the work of accounts team members, wherever applicable.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* CA Inter, CMA Inter, MBA Finance, or equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
* 8–10+ years of relevant experience in accounting and finance operations, preferably in IT Services, IT Staffing, or a service-based organization.
* Strong knowledge of general accounting, journal entries, ledger scrutiny, and financial statement preparation.
* Practical experience in GST, TDS, income tax, and applicable statutory compliance.
* Hands-on experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliation, and month-end closing.
* Knowledge of revenue accounting, client billing, and timesheet-based billing processes in IT Services.
* Proficiency in Tally, Zoho Books, or other accounting/ERP systems.
* Advanced MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and financial data analysis.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical ability, problem-solving skills, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple accounting activities and meet strict reporting and compliance deadlines.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Experience working in an IT Services, IT Staffing, consulting, or other service-oriented organization.
* Strong hands-on accounting and reconciliation skills.
* Ability to independently manage routine accounting operations and monthly financial closing.
* Experience coordinating with auditors, tax consultants, banks, vendors, and customers.
* Strong ownership, accuracy, confidentiality, and commitment to financial discipline.

title: IT&DATA Sr. Product Analyst Finance Accounting
description:
This is a senior functional product role requiring proven hands-on SAP Finance implementation and deployment experience. The role is not a configuration position. Must Have - Minimum 5 years of hands-on SAP Finance experience gained through implementation, integration or deployment projects, not only theoretical knowledge or support coordination. - Strong SAP FI/CO functional and configuration background, with the ability to understand how a solution is configured, assess proposed changes and identify functional or integration risks. - Strong understanding of Finance and Accounting processes, including Record to Report, financial closing, postings, controls and master-data dependencies. - Proven ability to review, challenge and validate functional designs, configuration choices, test evidence and deployment deliverables produced by internal or external delivery teams. - Experience translating complex business requirements into functional solutions and explaining solution constraints, impacts and trade-offs to Finance stakeholders. - Experience identifying end-to-end dependencies across SAP Finance and integrated modules or applications. - Ability to work autonomously, make recommendations, escalate material risks and act as a credible bridge between business stakeholders, Product Owners, project teams, AMS and external partners. - Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, structured problem solving and clear written and verbal communication.
  
  
Core responsibilities - Partner with the squad Product Owner to understand and prioritise business needs for Finance Consolidation, statutory and management reporting, and Central Finance evolution. - Translate complex reporting and accounting requirements into clear functional expectations, user stories, acceptance criteria and validation guardrails. - Challenge and validate CFIN and SAP FI/CO functional designs, data structures, mappings, replication or integration choices and test evidence produced by project, delivery or AMS teams. - Assess how proposed changes affect the global Themis model, organisational structures, General Ledger, controlling objects, Finance Master Data and downstream reporting. Provide senior functional guidance on Record to Report, financial closing, accounting, consolidation and reporting dependencies. Delivery / operational responsibilities - Validate that delivered solutions meet business requirements, design principles, control expectations, data-quality needs and agreed acceptance criteria before release. - Lead end-to-end impact assessments across CFIN, Themis, SAP S/4HANA environments, source systems, master data and reporting or analytics solutions. - Review defects, incidents and enhancement proposals, identify root causes and recommend scalable solutions that protect the global model. - Support implementation and deployment work through design review, test strategy, reconciliation, cutover readiness, knowledge transfer and post-go-live stabilisation. - Maintain decision records and functional documentation so critical CFIN and Finance reporting knowledge remains inside the organisation Stakeholder & collaboration responsibilities - Act as the bridge between Finance stakeholders and chapter functional/technical teams, ensuring that accounting and reporting requirements are translated into sustainable SAP solutions. - Facilitate design and validation discussions with Finance, Product Teams, programme teams, architecture, data and external delivery partners. - Challenge external experts constructively, make risks and trade-offs visible and support the Product Owner and Senior Product Owner with evidence-based recommendations. - Coach Product Analysts and contribute to stronger internal SAP Finance and CFIN validation capability.
  
  
Total experience: 7+ years in SAP Finance delivery, functional consulting, Finance transformation or product roles. Relevant experience: Minimum 5 years of hands-on SAP FI/CO experience in implementation, integration or deployment projects, including direct involvement in configuration, functional design, testing and go-live activities. Previous Central Finance or SAP S/4HANA experience is an advantage. Education: Bachelor degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Business, Engineering or a related discipline. Certifications (if any): SAP FI/CO, SAP S/4HANA Finance, SAP Central Finance, business analysis, product management or Agile certification is an advantage, but not mandatory.

* Manage cross-functional project teams through full project lifecycles, from charter and scope definition to delivery and handovers using structured PM frameworks
* Perform root cause analysis on complex operational issues, developing corrective actions that align with business objectives and financial targets
* Champion a Kaizen mindset across teams, embedding a culture of incremental improvement, accountability, and quality at every process level

**Forensic Accounting Consultant**

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in accounting and financial analysis, excellent problem-solving skills, and an interest in investigating complex financial matters. You will work collaboratively with experienced professionals to analyze financial records, identify irregularities, develop insights, and deliver high-quality solutions to clients across industries.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Analyze financial statements, accounting records, and other financial documentation to identify discrepancies, irregularities, and potential indicators of fraud.
* Support forensic investigations involving suspected financial misconduct, fraud, contractual disputes, and other complex business matters.
* Perform financial analysis to assess economic damages, lost profits, revenue losses, and other financial impacts associated with business disputes.
* Assist in preparing detailed investigative reports, financial schedules, presentations, and supporting documentation for clients, legal counsel, and litigation proceedings.
* Conduct research, data analysis, and financial modeling to support forensic investigations and litigation engagements.
* Utilize Excel and other analytical tools to evaluate large datasets, identify trends, and uncover unusual financial transactions.

title: Planning & Reporting CoE Senior Analyst
description:
**About Us**
We’re Reckitt, home to the world’s best loved and trusted hygiene and health brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
  
  
Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
**About The Finance Planning & Reporting CoE**
Driving efficiency and standardization across our renowned consumer brands that enhance everyday lives—from nourishing meals to trusted household essentials—is the pivotal force of the Finance Planning & Reporting Center of Excellence (CoE). Fuelled by a culture of collaboration and innovation, the CoE is integral to our organization, championing financial excellence and strategic insight across our global landscape. We are a dynamic, agile team, relentlessly focused on enhancing our financial processes, harnessing advanced analytics, and delivering unparalleled value to every facet of our business.
  
  
We transcend traditional finance roles; we are a strategic partner where diverse talents converge to tackle intricate financial challenges, foster sustainable growth, and empower our mission to create a healthier, more sustainable world for all. By ensuring a clear line of sight between strategic goals and day-to-day financial activities, we enable efficient performance management and better business results through the collaboration of our people, processes, and systems.
  
  
Our CoE transforms finance from a traditional back-office function into a strategic powerhouse that drives business value, as talented individuals come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better business.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Senior Analyst in the Finance CoE, you will report into a Finance Manager and be part of a team of analysts supporting a portfolio of markets. In this role, you will play a key part in executing financial planning and reporting activities across these markets. You will support the creation of standardized reports, development of initial forecasts/budgets, and analysis of financial performance to enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
This position offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure to multiple markets while contributing to the centralization and improvement of Reckitt’s FP&A processes. If you are passionate about finance, data analysis, and continuous improvement, this role will allow you to grow and make a real impact on our global business.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Produce and consolidate financial reports for monthly and quarterly results, ensuring key performance metrics (sales, profitability, costs, etc.) are accurately reported and delivered on time to global and regional stakeholders.
* Conduct variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) and clearly explain drivers behind the numbers, highlighting trends and insights that inform business decisions.
* Support the planning and forecasting cycles, including annual budgets and periodic forecasts: coordinate data collection from different markets, validate submissions, and align assumptions with global guidelines to create a cohesive financial outlook.
* Manage and enhance financial dashboards and reports (e.g. in Power BI or similar tools) to provide users with intuitive, up-to-date views of financial performance. Ensure that dashboards capture the right KPIs and that data is consistent across all reporting outputs.
* Participate in finance transformation initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline and improve existing FP&A processes. You’ll contribute to standardizing report templates, automating manual tasks, and sharing best practices that elevate our CoE’s efficiency and impact.
* Collaborate closely with market finance teams and other CoE members to ensure data integrity and one-source-of-truth in our financial systems. You will act as a liaison, helping local teams understand CoE processes and troubleshooting data or reporting issues to maintain accuracy.
* Assist with ad-hoc analysis and projects as needed, such as deep-dives into specific expenses or trends, scenario modeling for strategic projects, or financial deck preparation for senior leadership meetings. Your ability to turn data into actionable insights will be key in these projects.
* Adapt and excel in a dynamic environment – our CoE is continually evolving. You’ll be expected to handle last-minute changes or requests, work under tight deadlines especially during key reporting periods, and maintain a high standard of quality. In doing so, you’ll demonstrate agility, teamwork, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* 4+ years of experience in finance, analytics, or a related field, ideally within the CPG sector.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with reporting tools (e.g., Power BI).
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

The skills for success
  
  

* Financial Analysis & Reporting
* Strategic Planning
* Business Partnering
* Process Improvement
* Data Visualization Skills
* Project Management
* Team Leadership
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Change Management
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.
