description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Staff, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Staff member to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Staff member within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines
*.*
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Seniors, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Estimate actuarial liability for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Updating the report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 and Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 1+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx etc, will be a plus
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting.
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Accounts Payable Manager - Finance
description:
**About Signant Health**
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Accounts Payable Manager will oversee and participate in all aspects of the accounts payable function across multiple legal entities, including processing vendor bills with accurate general ledger coding, approving employee expense reports, managing timely vendor payments, processing pass-through project expenses in accordance with customer contracts, and performing intercompany payable processing, while supervising the day-to-day work of a team of accounts payable specialists.
  
  
The Accounts Payable Manager is responsible for deploying best practices to improve the quality of processes, maintaining electronic supporting records, ensuring compliance with Group accounting and purchasing processes, and delivering on vendor satisfaction and key reporting metrics.
  
  
**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function**

* Directly supervise a team of accounts payable specialists, providing daily direction on delegated vendor assignments, managing and assigning incoming vendor bills and email distributions, training on systems and procedures, and evaluating job performance
* Maintain compliance, accuracy, and speed with strategic AP direction for efficiencies, synergies, and automation, ensuring strict adherence to the delegation of authority workflow and achievement of key performance indicators applicable to Accounts Payable
* Manage international, multicurrency, and intercompany vendors, recording vendor bills in the proper legal entities in accordance with intercompany posting policies set by Controllers
* Manage general ledger coding in accordance with ERP system and Group accounting policies for prepaids, fixed assets, accruals, and inventory and accrual management
* Oversee compliance of out-of-pocket/pass-through expense management and intercompany processes, including accurate and timely bill coding, reading contracts, obtaining project manager approvals, and retaining supporting files for multiple contracting entities
* Support Finance’s Accounts Receivable invoicing process related to customer contracts, and support the maintenance of systems that affect vendor bill coding, expense approval workflows, and process improvements
* Oversee expense report processing in multiple ERP systems in accordance with Group travel compliance policies, and support maintenance of related systems affecting expense report approval workflows and employee changes
* Support the purchase order process with procurement and supply chain teams, including purchase order workflow approvals and vendor bill matched receipts within an ERP system
* Propose payments in accordance with Group treasury policies, using banking software for multiple legal entities and currencies
* Maintain an organized electronic filing system for paperless and mailed vendor bills, purchase order approval support, and payment support
* Respond to vendor inquiries and internal requests in a timely manner, work collaboratively with internal teams across multiple entities, and track outstanding issues to resolution through effective communication and transparent supporting records, providing excellent customer service
* Maintain vendor management compliance and account relationships with the quality and ERP systems, treasury processes, and annual tax reporting (prepare 1099 information for year-end submission in accordance with IRS regulations, vendor set-up forms, and sales and use tax and VAT charges)
* Achieve departmental goals by developing and implementing process improvements that increase the efficiency and accuracy of invoice processing and payment distribution, including testing system upgrades, supporting system integrations, recommending and participating in automation initiatives, testing new processes, supporting global harmonization of practices, and documenting process narratives and workflows
* Build highly collaborative relationships with Finance General Ledger teams, Supply Chain/Procurement teams, and Client Delivery Project Managers to manage invoice approvals
* Build highly collaborative relationships with Finance IT to support ERP system processes and upgrades, and the integration of other systems that affect accounts payable processing and expense reports

**Knowledge, Skills & Attributes**
**Essential:**

* Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounts payable experience
* Minimum of 3 years of supervisory experience managing accounts payable staff
* Ability to work with employees in remote locations and within a team environment as an individual contributor, build stable working relationships internally, and work extended hours as needed
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present information, respond to inquiries, and interact well with various levels of management internally and with external individuals at global locations
* Ability to read and understand contract language and engage in collaborative problem-solving that generates effective solutions consistent with the organization’s financial policies and procedures
* Effective time management skills to develop and direct realistic action plans for supervised teams, while creating a collaborative environment and ensuring internal stakeholder satisfaction
* Demonstrated judgment and outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Outlook; intermediate Excel skills, including pivot tables, H/V lookups, IF functions, and other advanced functions
* Experience working with electronic data, including accounting data within an ERP system; extracting and formatting ERP data exports; and maintaining organized paperless records, shared drives, and multiple file folders
* Confident and professionally poised, with a proven ability to work in a fast-paced team environment, meet deadlines, manage a high volume of transactions, and adapt to change with a seamless effect on the business

**Desirable:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, or a related discipline
* Accounts payable industry experience
* NetSuite ERP and/or Great Plains knowledge

**Why Signant Health?**
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
  
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. **Job Title – T&T Purchase Ledger Analyst**
**About The Role**
As a CBRE AP/AR Accountant, you will be responsible for all aspects of the accounts receivable and payable process.
  
  
This job is part of the Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable function. They are responsible for reviewing and paying invoices and cash management activities such as reconciliation and bank account reviews.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Verify payment and invoice information is correct before distribution. Receive, process, and post incoming payments.
* Generate and process commissions. Work with internal teams to verify fee structures. Confirm monthly that terms are correct and up to date.
* Create monthly reports on delinquent accounts, exceptions, contingent liabilities, and aging accounts receivables. Process employee expense reports.
* Collect and post all documentation to accounting and billing systems and verify the information is accurate.
* Work to recover debts owed including accounts that have already been written off.
* Manage positive business relationships with collection and credit reporting agencies and credit insurance providers.
* Have some knowledge of standard principles with limited practical experience in applying them.
* Lead by example and model behaviours that are consistent with CBRE RISE values.
* Impact the quality of own work.
* Work within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
* Exchange straightforward information, ask questions, and check for understanding.

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred with up to 3 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. Basic understanding of accounting fundamentals.
* Ability to use existing procedures to solve standard problems.
* Experience with analyzing information and standard practices to make judgments.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.
* Intermediate math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

**Our Values In Hiring**
At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong.
  
  
We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

The company has more than 130,000 employees (including Turner & Townsend employees) serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves a diverse range of clients with an integrated suite of services, including facilities, transaction, and project management; property management; investment management; appraisal and valuation; property leasing; strategic consulting; property sales; mortgage services and development services. Please visit our website at www.cbre.com. We routinely post important information on our website, including corporate and investor presentations and financial information. title: City Head
description:
**City PnL Head – Coliving**

**Zolo | Coliving Business**

Own the city. Drive occupancy. Build systems. Deliver predictable growth.

**Why this role exists**

In coliving, a city is not just a geography.

It is a full business unit with its own demand, occupancy, cost structure, customer experience, and operational complexity.

At city level:

* Demand fluctuates continuously
* Supply is fragmented across multiple properties
* Resident expectations evolve constantly
* Execution gaps immediately affect occupancy and retention

Without strong city-level ownership, operations quickly become reactive.

The biggest failures usually happen when:

* Occupancy is managed week-to-week instead of structurally
* Sales and operations work independently instead of as one system
* Cost leakages go unnoticed
* Accountability weakens across teams
* Escalations consume operational bandwidth daily

As scale increases, the city must operate with:

* Predictability
* Commercial discipline
* Structured execution
* Strong leadership ownership

This role exists to ensure:

* The city runs like a disciplined business unit
* Occupancy remains stable across cycles
* Demand generation stays strong and diversified
* Resident experience remains consistent across properties
* Costs are controlled structurally, not reactively
* Teams operate with ownership and accountability
* Escalations reduce through system-led fixes

If this role is strong:

* Occupancy becomes predictable
* Margins improve consistently
* Teams operate independently and efficiently
* Retention strengthens
* Growth becomes scalable

If this role is weak:

* Occupancy volatility increases
* Conversion weakens
* Costs rise without control
* Escalations dominate operations
* Customer experience becomes inconsistent

This role directly controls:
**Revenue + occupancy + retention + profitability + team performance**

**Your mandate is clear**

* Own city-level revenue, occupancy, and profitability
* Build strong demand generation engines
* Ensure consistent resident experience across properties
* Drive renewals and improve retention
* Control operational costs and eliminate leakages
* Build high-performing sales and operations teams
* Reduce escalations structurally through systems

**This is not a coordination role. This is a full city P&L ownership role.**

**About Coliving – Zolo**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.

Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Coliving works only when:

* Demand remains strong
* Occupancy stays high
* Resident experience remains consistent
* Operations are disciplined
* Costs stay under control

At scale:
**City becomes the core operating unit of the business.**

This role directly impacts:
**Revenue + occupancy + retention + operational efficiency + profitability**

**What you will be responsible for**

**1. Own City Business Performance (P&L Ownership)**

* Own city-level revenue, occupancy, and profitability
* Track daily occupancy, booking trends, and pipeline visibility
* Drive predictable performance across properties
* Improve operational and commercial efficiency continuously
* Think in business outcomes, not activities

**2. Build Demand Generation & Sales Performance**

* Build strong local demand channels:
* Colleges
* Corporates
* Brokers
* Local partnerships
* Improve lead-to-booking conversion across the funnel
* Track funnel performance actively:
* Leads
* Visits
* Bookings
* Reduce funnel leakage systematically
* Ensure strong alignment between sales and occupancy goals

**3. Drive Operations & Resident Experience Excellence**

* Ensure SOP adherence across all properties
* Maintain consistent resident experience standards
* Track complaint patterns and escalation trends
* Drive audits and operational improvements proactively
* Ensure operational discipline across teams

**4. Improve Occupancy & Retention**

* Maintain stable occupancy across seasonal cycles
* Drive renewals and reduce churn proactively
* Identify early retention risk signals
* Improve resident continuity and relationship quality
* Ensure smooth admission and move-in experience

**5. Ensure Cost Control & Commercial Discipline**

* Track property-level cost vs budget consistently
* Identify operational leakages proactively
* Ensure vendor discipline and commercial accountability
* Balance resident experience with cost efficiency
* Drive profitability without compromising core standards

**6. Build Strong Teams & Leadership Depth**

* Lead city-level sales and operations teams
* Set targets and review performance regularly
* Build second-line leadership capability
* Act decisively on underperformance
* Create a strong ownership and accountability culture

**7. Handle Escalations & Operational Risks**

* Handle critical resident, parent, or safety escalations calmly
* Ensure structured issue resolution and follow-through
* Reduce repeat escalations through root-cause fixes
* Protect resident trust and brand reputation
* Maintain operational stability during pressure situations

**What success looks like after 6–12 months**

* Occupancy becomes stable and predictable
* Conversion improves consistently across the funnel
* Renewal and retention rates strengthen
* Cost variance remains within planned thresholds
* Complaint repeat rates reduce significantly
* Teams operate with stronger ownership and accountability
* City operations become system-led instead of escalation-led

The city begins to operate like:
**A disciplined and scalable business unit**

Performance becomes:
**Structured + Predictable + Scalable**

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You think in business outcomes instead of tasks
* You can manage multiple operational levers simultaneously
* You balance execution speed with structure
* You are data-driven and action-oriented
* You are comfortable handling ownership and pressure
* You focus on building systems instead of temporary fixes

**Experience we value**

5–8+ years in:

* Operations
* Sales
* Business management roles
* Experience managing:
* Multi-property operations
* Multi-unit business environments
* City-level execution
* Exposure to:
* P&L ownership
* Demand generation
* Operations management
* Cost control

Industry matters less.
**Business ownership maturity matters more.**

**The impact you will have**

* Direct impact on city revenue and profitability
* Build scalable demand and operations systems
* Improve occupancy and retention structurally
* Develop strong leadership pipelines
* Drive long-term city-level business growth

**Why join now**

Coliving is entering its scale phase.

The businesses that win will be defined by:
**City-level execution excellence.**

This role offers:

* Full city business ownership
* High visibility and strategic impact
* Fast growth into regional leadership roles

In this role, you will perform procedures as assigned on attestation and consulting engagements and assist with any additional tasks necessary to complete the engagements. Weaver’s ECS practice is committed to guiding businesses through compliance with evolving regulations, including those governed by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, U.S. Customs and Border Protection Agency, and the California Air Resources Board, among other state and provincial authorities. Environmental programs within ECS are focused on managing human impact on the environment, reducing greenhouse gas emissions, and promoting sustainability. The team brings extensive expertise in transportation fuel regulations, covering both petroleum-based and renewable fuels.
  
  
Core competency is the demonstrated ability to carry out the primary responsibilities of the job, which are reflected in the essential duties outlined below.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
The essential duties and responsibilities for this position include the following:
  
  

* Develop an understanding of technical laws and regulations related to the ECS practice (i.e. EPA, , CARB, etc.) and the ability to research issues and provide management with coherent information on routine, non-complex matters.
* Work closely with all experienced team members to identify and resolve issues encountered in performance of assignments through effective and timely communication.
* Consistently perform and take ownership of assigned areas, small projects, and small engagements under the supervision of more experienced team members.
* Assist with consulting and attestation engagements performed within the ECS practice, work paper preparation, and/or other reports.
* Keep supervisors apprised of engagement and scheduling issues on a timely basis.
* Work with direct report manager to develop an appropriate plan of professional development and take responsibility to ensure that plan is executed.
* Has the goal to progress professionally by working toward self-determined career goals.
* Demonstrate an understanding of the client’s operations and regulatory compliance systems.
* Establish and maintain a good working relationship and demonstrate effective communication with client personnel at appropriate levels.
* Maintain appropriate professionalism in client and team interactions.
* Has effective and clear workpaper and documentation techniques.
* Demonstrate mindfulness of budget and deadline considerations and strive for adherence.
* In reference to carrying out their professional responsibilities, be familiar with and adhere to the relevant ethical requirements of the AICPA, as outlined in the Code of Professional Conduct, as well as those of state accountancy boards and professional societies for which any licenses are held.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Job Requirements**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities or pregnancy to perform the essential functions, unless it would cause an undue hardship to the firm. The employee or potential employee still has their responsibility to be able to perform the essential duties of the position, unless such responsibility is excepted under federal, state, or local law.
  
  
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or a related field is required.
* Advanced degree preferred (i.e., Master of Business Administration (MBA) with concentration in Accounting)
* Semi-qualified Chartered Accountant/ACCA/CPA

**Skills**

* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, Teams, and Outlook.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Team orientation and strong interpersonal skills.
* Sufficient technical skills to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of this position.
* 2 - 3 years of experience in US public accounting (assurance or advisory), project management, and/or business administration
* Experience with transportation fuels regulations preferred but not required.
* Exposure to RINs, EMTS and/or experience with other credit trading regulations and trading platforms is preferred but not required.

description:
**Our Company**
As a part of Brookfield’s $416B credit platform, Oaktree is a premier credit manager emphasizing an opportunistic, value-oriented, and risk-controlled approach to investing across credit, equity, and real estate.
  
  
Oaktree is committed to cultivating an environment that is collaborative, curious, inclusive and honors diversity of thought. Providing training and career development opportunities and emphasizing strong support for our local communities through philanthropic initiatives are essential to our culture.
  
  
Oaktree is wholly owned by Brookfield, a leading global investment firm with more than $1 trillion in assets under management. Brookfield owns and operates high-quality businesses and real assets that provide essential services and form the backbone of the global economy. It invests on behalf of institutions and individuals around the world across infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity, real estate, and credit.
  
  
For additional information, please visit Oaktree’s website at Oaktree Capital Management
  
  
**Summary**
The Associate, Tech Strategy & Operations is a quantitative role supporting the planning, reporting, and operating rhythm of the Technology organization. Based in India, the role sits within the Technology department and reports on a matrix basis to the Managing Director, Tech Strategy & Operations in Los Angeles, with day-to-day direction from local Technology leadership. You will build and maintain financial models, dashboards, and analyses that inform how Technology plans its budget, allocates resources, and measures performance — turning data from multiple systems into a clear, decision-ready view for senior stakeholders across regions.
  
  
Work Mode: 3/2
  
  
Shift timings: 1PM-10PM
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build, maintain, and improve financial and operational models supporting the Technology budget, forecast, and long-range plan, including headcount, vendor spend, cloud/infrastructure costs, and project-level investment cases.
* Support the annual planning and quarterly reforecast cycles: consolidate inputs from Technology leaders, reconcile to Finance submissions, and explain variances between actuals, budget, and forecast.
* Design and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports covering spend, capacity, delivery metrics, and KPIs; own the underlying data models, DAX measures, and refresh pipelines.
* Turn raw data from Finance, procurement, and delivery tooling into clean, reusable datasets and repeatable reporting — reducing manual effort through automation and better data hygiene.
* Prepare analyses and decision-support materials for the MD, Tech Strategy & Operations and other senior stakeholders, including business cases, scenario and sensitivity analyses, benchmarking, and vendor/contract cost reviews.
* Produce executive-ready summaries and presentations that translate analytical detail into a clear recommendation and a defensible set of assumptions.
* Support the operating cadence of the Technology function — monthly/quarterly business reviews, leadership reporting packs, and tracking of strategic initiatives against milestones and financial targets.
* Partner across time zones with Technology, Finance, and Tech PMO counterparts in India, Los Angeles, and other locations to gather inputs, validate data, and drive issues to resolution.
* Identify opportunities to improve planning and reporting processes and help implement the resulting changes.

**Qualifications – What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, engineering, statistics, business analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 5+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, business/technology finance, strategy and operations, consulting, or a comparable analytical role; technology-sector or IT-finance exposure preferred.
* Demonstrated financial modeling skills — able to build a clear, well-structured model from scratch (budgets, forecasts, business cases, scenario analysis) and stand behind the assumptions.
* Advanced Excel (complex formulas, lookups, pivot tables, data tables, structured workbook design).
* Hands-on Power BI experience: data modeling, DAX, report and dashboard design, Power Query, and managing datasets and scheduled refreshes.
* Strong data skills — comfortable sourcing, cleaning, and reconciling large datasets from multiple systems, with a high bar for accuracy and attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; able to present analysis and recommendations clearly and credibly to senior, non-financial stakeholders.
* Works effectively both independently and as part of a team: takes ownership of deliverables, manages competing priorities, and follows through with limited supervision.
* Comfortable operating in a matrixed, cross-border environment and collaborating with a US-based leader, including flexibility for periodic overlap with Pacific Time.
* Discretion and sound judgment in handling confidential financial and organizational information.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with SQL and querying data warehouses or lakehouse platforms.
* Familiarity with enterprise planning and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday Adaptive Planning, Anaplan).
* Exposure to cloud cost management / FinOps concepts (AWS, Azure, or GCP spend analysis and optimization).
* Experience with Python or R for data analysis and automation.
* Hands-on use of AI tools to accelerate analytical work — e.g., Microsoft Copilot in Excel or Power BI, Copilot Studio, ChatGPT/Claude, or similar — with good judgment about where AI output needs to be validated.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics features such as natural-language querying, Power BI Copilot, or automated narrative/insight generation.
* Interest in applying AI and automation to planning, reporting, and operations workflows, including building or piloting lightweight solutions.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery metrics and tools such as Jira or ServiceNow.
* Experience supporting IT vendor management, software licensing, or contract renewals.
* Prior experience in a global shared-services or global capability center model

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Markets Business Finance & Control (BF&C) is a division of Global Banking & Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for the production and independent validation of Global Markets' profit and loss and balance sheet. In this regard, BF&C will ensure, inter alia, that accounting policies are correctly and consistently applied, and that trading portfolios are appropriately valued.
  
  
The team prepares and reports P&L and balance sheet to the business and ensures the accuracy and integrity of the general ledger. We are responsible for daily service delivery and ensuring effective controls, transparent management information and becoming a center of excellence delivering process simplification and efficiencies. We work closely with front office, middle office, traders and valuation control teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
  
  
**Job Description\***
Global Markets Business Finance & Control (BF&C) seeks to provide a support service with particular focus on the relationship between trading risk positions and P&L components. We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the P&L production area covering the Global Credit Trading desks. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to produce and deliver the daily P&L to front office, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation around any issues faced and daily revenue drivers. The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Middle Office, and Finance and Trade Capture teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Primary products covered will include: Bonds, CDS, TRS, ETFs and Loans
* Production and reporting of daily P&L to Front Office & Senior Management
* Reconcile actual P&L with trader estimates and provide flash/actual variance analysis
* Working closely with the trading desks on position, P&L or other issues on an ad-hoc basis
* Front-to-Back analysis & reconciliations of front office PnL and balance sheet to firm sub-ledgers
* Assist with execution of month-end controls ensuring management vs financial P&L variances are within thresholds
* Analyze traders’ risk positions and understand and apply the Greeks (Delta, Vega Gamma) vs daily market moves
* Would be typical own set of books / cost center and Business Units
* Liaise with various business partners such as Technology, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Operations and Finance to resolve issues / queries
* Development & continuous improvement of existing processes & workflow
* Testing / UAT for systems work ranging from minor system releases to major system implementations
* Remediation of issues in an autonomous yet timely manner considering the principles of control and the need to mitigate operational risk

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA /CFA / MBA from Tier I/II institute
  
  
Certifications If Any
  
  

* CFA / FRM certified candidates would be preferred
* Advanced education and/or enhanced technical qualifications are a plus
* Ability to use Excel Power Query or Alteryx would enhance the candidate’s attractiveness significantly

**Experience Range\***
2-5 years of experience in Global Markets
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Prior BFC experience for >2 years is mandatory
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite; expert knowledge of Excel, Word, PowerPoint. Knowledge of Visual Basic, Access databases and macros will be an added advantage.
* The right individual will have strong people skills and can multi-task to manage the challenges of Finance processes yet have the awareness to escalate potential issues to their supervisor in a timely manner
* Candidate must have a proven track record of communicating effectively with personnel from various areas within an organization and at different management levels
* Must be proactive and be a highly motivated and self-starter. Reactive and/or passive individuals need not apply

**Desired Skills**

* Alteryx / Python / Tableau knowledge would be an added advantage
* Must be proactive and be a highly-motivated self-starter
* Effective communication skills with English proficiency
* Demonstrated ability to work in a high pressure environment
* Takes initiative and challenges existing processes and procedures in a proactive manner
* Strong team player
* Ability to analyze issues independently and derive solutions
* Analytical skills
* Inherent sense of principles of control through experience and sound judgment
* Reliability

**Work Timings\***
1:30 PM to 10:30 PM
  
  
**Job Location\***
Hyderabad/Gurugram/Mumbai

A fast-growing player in the Apparel & Garment Manufacturing sector, we deliver end-to-end supply chain, cost optimization, and financial governance solutions for global fashion brands. Our Finance Managers drive profitability, compliance, and operational efficiency across high-volume production units—translating complex financial data into actionable business insights.
  
  
**Role & Responsibilities**

* Prepare and manage monthly P&L, balance sheets, and cash flow statements for garment production units.
* Lead cost accounting for fabric, labor, and overhead—ensuring accurate product costing and margin reporting.
* Partner with operations to track inventory turns, WIP, and scrap metrics to reduce financial leakage.
* Automate financial reporting using Excel and ERP systems (Tally, SAP, or similar) to improve accuracy and timeliness.
* Manage statutory compliance including GST, TDS, payroll, and audit coordination with external auditors.
* Develop financial dashboards for senior leadership to support strategic decisions on sourcing, pricing, and capacity planning.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Must-Have
* Excel (Advanced Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Macros)
* Tally ERP 9
* SAP FICO
* Cost Accounting
* Inventory Management
* GST Reporting
* Financial Reporting
* Statutory Compliance
* Preferred
* Experience in Apparel/Garment Manufacturing
* Power BI or Tableau
* ERP Implementation Experience

**Benefits & Culture Highlights**

* Work in a dynamic, growth-oriented manufacturing environment with direct business impact.
* Opportunity to build scalable finance processes from the ground up.
* Flexible career progression path aligned with operational & financial leadership roles.

title: Scorecards Update and Maintenance - Senior Consultant
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
10
  
  
**The Team**
The Scorecards team delivers credit risk solutions to clients globally, including PD/LGD models, analytical support, training, and credit risk assessment. The U&M team in Hyderabad owns the operational excellence of Scorecards through controlled model maintenance, performance monitoring, and disciplined change management.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**

* The primary purpose of this position is to work within a team of credit risk and analytical development professionals. To collect and analyze credit information (both data and research) where probability of default (PD) and loss given default (LGD) scorecard models may be developed, tested for accuracy and predictive capability, and recalibrated.
* By having a full understanding of the array of existing solutions, the candidate will be responsible for the back-testing, update and maintenance efforts of the whole suite of credit risk scorecards and will provide vital technical support to clients’ requests, on an ad-hoc basis.
* Using a proactive approach, the candidate will help the team automating any repetitive tasks and reducing operational risks in the scorecards’ use or their update and maintenance.
* Secondary, the analyst may support other regional teams of S&P Global Market Intelligence in assessing the performance of other, statistical-based credit risk models and provide insights on best practices related to credit risk modelling.
* The day-to-day job requires substantial hands-on involvement in the back-testing, update, and maintenance of the scorecard solutions. Additionally, the candidate must have good credit risk knowledge, which will be instrumental in his/her project duties and in supporting team members in their technical knowledge development.
* The Analyst will need to work independently under tight deadlines to consistently produce high-quality work, including updates to technical reference guides, scorecard user-guides, back-testing reports, and interim deliverables, for which in all cases will have full accountability.

**Responsibilities**

* Good understanding of fundamentals of credit analysis and related qualitative and quantitative reasoning.
* Has strong attention to detail and is able to devise creative solutions to automate repetitive tasks or reduce risk of operational errors in the update and maintenance of Excel-based solutions.
* Writes all deliverables including technical sections, summaries, user-guides and back-testing reports
* May work in contact with quantitative analytical people and provide credit risk modelling expertise or leverage own quantitative skills in devising tests and updating scorecards.

**Required Qualifications**
**What We’re Looking For:**

* Background in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Mathematics, Econometrics, Finance, Engineering, Computer/Data Science).
* 4+ years of experience in credit risk modelling and/or model risk management, while working with Risk Management / Risk Analytics division of large bank(s), Big 4 consulting firm, credit rating agency or risk consulting firm.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with S&P Global Ratings criteria and the shadow rating approach.
* Experience in Financial sector will be advantageous
* Experience with credit risk model development and validation would be a plus
* Experience with recovery analysis, CECL, LGD, credit risk consulting, PD calibration will be a plus
* Advanced skills in Excel / VBA and experience in statistical programming languages such as Python would be preferred

title: Manager - Strategy
description:
**The Role :**

At Recykal, strategy is not a support function. It is a growth engine. As part of the Strategy team, you will work alongside business leaders to shape high impact decisions that influence growth, profitability and long term market positioning. You will be embedded within a business unit cluster, working as a strategic partner who turns ambiguity into action.

**CORE MANDATE:**

* Own annual strategic planning for the assigned business unit cluster — market sizing, competitive landscaping, and opportunity assessment.
* Translate strategic plans into actionable roadmaps with clear milestones, resource requirements, and success metrics.
* Lead strategic projects spanning product launches, pricing strategy, and market expansion.
* Act as the strategic bridge between business units and central leadership, aligning priorities across teams.
* Define leading and lagging indicators for strategic health and build dashboards that surface the right signals.
* Prepare executive presentations and board-level materials that drive decision-making at the top.

**EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

* 4–8 years in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or business development
* Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities; comfortable building models from scratch
* Experience solving complex, end-to-end strategic business problems with measurable impact
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint for modelling, analysis, and executive storytelling
* Familiarity with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a strong plus
* MBA / equivalent postgraduate degree preferred; strong academic foundation in business or economics

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**A. BU STRATEGY & ANNUAL PLANNING**

* Own annual strategic planning; conduct market sizing, competitive landscaping and opportunity assessments
* Translate strategic plans into actionable roadmaps with milestones and success metrics
* Work with BU heads to define strategic priorities for the year ahead
* Monitor strategy execution, track KPIs, and flag early-warning signals

**B. COMMERCIAL & GROWTH INITIATIVES**

* Lead strategic projects — product launches, pricing strategy, market expansion
* Build robust financial models and business cases for new opportunities
* Identify white spaces and adjacencies for growth
* Partner with Sales, Product and Operations to convert strategy into measurable outcomes

**C. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP**

* Act as the strategic bridge between business units and central leadership
* Collaborate with Finance, Product and Operations on cross-functional initiatives
* Influence decision-making without direct authority
* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels

**D. PERFORMANCE & INSIGHTS**

* Define leading and lagging indicators for strategic health; build dashboards for leadership
* Develop competitive intelligence frameworks to track market dynamics and benchmark Recykal's position

**E. EXECUTIVE COMMUNICATION & STORYTELLING**

* Prepare crisp, well-structured executive presentations and board-level materials
* Synthesize complex data into clear, decision-ready recommendations
* Communicate decisions and strategic context in a way that builds confidence and clarity

**WHY THIS ROLE?**

* Embedded strategic partner shaping high-impact decisions for a business unit cluster
* Direct exposure to BU heads, central leadership, and investors
* Own strategy end to end — from market sizing to boardroom storytelling
* Equal parts analyst and communicator — build the models and deliver the narrative

title: Senior Finance Assistant
description:
**Company Description**
SimplifiTax is a US-focused Tax and Virtual CFO firm that helps founders and small businesses stay compliant, organized, and financially in control. The company integrates bookkeeping, monthly close, tax compliance, and financial strategy into one structured process, ensuring that financial data supports decision-making throughout the year. SimplifiTax offers services such as federal and multi-state tax filing, proactive tax planning, virtual CFO support, cash runway tracking, and cleanup bookkeeping. With over 10 years of experience and more than 500 businesses served, the firm operates as a proactive partner rather than a seasonal tax preparer, emphasizing predictable timelines, clear communication, and clean documentation. SimplifiTax is dedicated to turning financial and tax complexity into clarity for growing businesses.

**Role Description**
The Senior Finance Assistant is a full-time role based in Hyderabad with a hybrid work arrangement, combining in-office and work-from-home flexibility. This role supports the finance and accounting functions by managing invoicing, assisting with bookkeeping and monthly close activities, and preparing financial reports and reconciliations. The Senior Finance Assistant will help maintain accurate records for tax filings, support cash flow tracking, and assist in implementing structured finance processes for clients. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing documentation, coordinating with internal teams to resolve discrepancies, and communicating clearly with stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate financial information. The role also involves contributing to process improvements, supporting audit and notice responses, and providing analytical support to the Virtual CFO and tax teams.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Finance and Accounting skills to support bookkeeping, monthly close, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
* Candidates should possess solid Invoicing skills, including preparing, reviewing, and tracking client invoices and payments.
* Candidates should possess advanced Analytical Skills to interpret financial data, identify variances, and support budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow analysis.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with internal teams, interact with clients professionally, and present financial information clearly.
* Relevant experience in a finance or accounting support role, preferably in a professional services, tax, or consulting environment.
* Working knowledge of accounting software, spreadsheets, and documentation management tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CA Inter) are an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail, ability to manage multiple priorities, and comfort working in a structured, deadline-driven environment.

title: Consulting Analyst

The candidate will independently lead implementation activities from discovery and blueprinting through design, configuration, data migration, integration, testing, and deployment. **1. SAP S/4HANA Finance & Controlling**

* Lead the design and implementation of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Finance and Controlling modules.
* Design and implement financial processes covering General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, bank accounting, and financial closing.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into standard SAP business processes.

**2. SAP Activate Methodology & Implementation**

* Drive the SAP Activate methodology independently across all phases, from Discover and Prepare through Explore, Realize, Deploy, and Run.
* Lead discovery sessions, requirement gathering, fit-to-standard workshops, and business process design discussions.
* Conduct workshops based on the scope items identified during the discovery phase.
* Demonstrate standard business processes to clients using the SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Starter System.
* Lead blueprinting and solution design sessions independently and prepare the required functional and technical documentation.

**3. SAP BTP & Extensibility**

* Design and implement side-by-side extensions using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
* Work on in-app extensibility within SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.
* Identify appropriate extension approaches based on business requirements and SAP clean-core principles.
* Collaborate with technical and integration teams to deploy extensions and ensure seamless integration with SAP S/4HANA.

**4. Data Migration**

* Lead finance data migration from legacy systems to SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.
* Plan and execute migration of opening balances, general ledger balances, customer and vendor balances, and other relevant financial data.
* Validate migrated data and ensure financial accuracy and reconciliation between source and target systems.

UK TAX Global Information Reporting - Tax Consultant II - Hyderabad

* Developing an understanding of withholding tax (WHT) reclaims under EU law, double tax treaties (DTTs), and domestic law, and supporting the analysis of reclaim opportunities.

* Researching relevant tax treaty and regulatory topics and contributing to client analyses and tax planning discussions, as appropriate to the role level.

* Handle moderately complex work, conduct technical research, manage assigned workstreams, communicate with clients, and support junior team members.

* Relevant experience in UK tax, withholding tax, global information reporting, or related tax operations. The required experience will vary by role level.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong accounting knowledge
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products — In particular, Excel and Word
* High level of attention to detail & well organized
* Can work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
* Work collaboratively in a team, providing assistance and support to others, when needed

description:
**About This Role**
Wells Fargo is seeking a Commercial Banking Portfolio manager.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Research complex credit investigations and diverse credit information for loans
* Identify opportunity for process improvements within scope of responsibilities or functional area
* Review and identify basic operational assignments that require research, evaluation, and selection of alternatives while exercising independent judgement to guide medium risk deliverables
* Present recommendations for resolving complex situations and exercise independent judgement while developing expertise in the function, policies, procedures, and compliance requirements
* Collaborate and consult with functional colleagues, internal partners, and stakeholders including internal as well as external customers

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of Commercial Banking Portfolio Management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* MBA (Finance /Banking), Cost and Management Accountancy, Chartered Accountancy or post- graduation in Economics.
* Good knowledge on financial statements for various industries (preferably Real Estate) with ability to ascertain trends, ratios and call out key risks when compared to benchmarks (historical and industry performance).
* Working knowledge of Discounted Cash Flow, Comparable Company, and Precedent Transaction analysis. Working experience with Moody’s Risk Analytics would be a plus.
* Should be aware of key factors which helps in assessing credit worthiness of borrower.
* Excellent communication skills, with special focus on business writing skills for credit reports.
* Ability to read, comprehend and synthesize data regarding borrower performance / market related information from multiple sources into one prescribed template.
* Intermediary to advanced excel skills would be a plus

**Desired AI Skills And Competencies**

* As part of Wells Fargo’s commitment to innovation and responsible AI adoption, all roles require foundational AI literacy. This includes:
* Understanding and Application of AI Tools: Ability to leverage AI platforms (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Tachyon, Agentspace) for routine tasks such as summarizing information, drafting content, and analyzing data, while maintaining human oversight.

title: Risk Manager-II, Controllership
description:
**Description**
Amazon's Transportation Controllership team is an operations finance team that ensures accurate payment and revenue integrity across Amazon's worldwide logistics cost. This is achieved through strengthening internal and external controls by working closely with multiple internal stakeholders such as Operations, Procurement, Technology groups, and external stakeholders such as carriers. The team audits billions in annual transportation cost payables and focuses on ensuring payment accuracy and reporting integrity.
  
  
The Controllership team recently expanded its scope to Revenue Controllership, to evaluate risks across Amazon's revenue-generating businesses, including Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS). Controllership conducts comprehensive controls assessments across key process areas including onboarding, invoice completeness, pricing, rates & margins, claims, and collections.
  
  
We are looking for a Risk Manager II who will execute transactional controls for last mile and revenue-side payments, conduct risk assessments, and drive compliance across assigned control areas. This role will support end-to-end Controllership by identifying control gaps, performing detailed testing, and working with business and technology teams to implement remediation actions. This is an individual contributor role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Execute and monitor transactional controls across assigned payment and revenue streams, ensuring compliance with established policies and procedures.
* Conduct risk assessments and controls testing for revenue-generating businesses, focusing on process areas such as pricing, rates, margins, onboarding, and invoice completeness.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and control documentation for assigned audit areas.
* Perform root-cause analysis on control failures and exceptions, and recommend remediation actions.
* Challenge assumptions of why a process or mechanism failed, ask the questions to get to the root cause of the problem and work for a solve.
* Support the development and enhancement of the revenue controls playbook by documenting findings and best practices.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Procurement, and Technology teams to understand process flows and identify control gaps.
* Prepare and present audit findings, risk reports, and status updates to senior team members and stakeholders.
* Track and report on key risk metrics, escalating issues as appropriate.

Drive process improvements within the Controllership function by leveraging data analysis and lean methodologies.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
* Experience establishing successful partnerships with internal and external teams to execute tactical initiatives or equivalent
* Experience with data and analysis tools including Microsoft Excel and SQL
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (esp. MS Excel, Word) at an advanced level

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and implementing controls or experience performing audits over financial reporting environment, or experience in accounts receivable or account payable
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Master's degree or equivalent
* Experience analyzing large datasets and translating them to actionable business insight
* Experience conducting risk assessments or controls testing in a logistics, supply chain, or transportation finance environment
* Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent

description:
**Job Purpose**
The purpose of this role includes ensuring accurate and timely submission of periodic and ad-hoc reports related to Claims to the Regulatory Authority, handling Audits (IRDA, internal audits and other audits), preparing the claims register, bring in process improvements, automation, publishing analytical reports / Claims MIS and daily dashboard.
  
  
The purpose involves Data Support and inter-department coordination with all stakeholders including sales, finance, internal claims and actuary teams.
  
  
**Job Context & Major Challenges**
**About The Health Insurance Industry –**
While the current market sees more than 15 non-life players in the private space and 5 exclusive private players in the health insurance space trying to capture a sizable market share, the nationalized service provider (6) remains a strong competitor. In addition to this the business dynamics are such that the overall market on an annual basis which is to the tune of roughly 10,000 Crs sees close to 85 % of the business renewing with the existing service provider itself. This narrows down the opportunity of the fresh business actually being seriously fought in the market to approximately 1500 odd Crs. With the SME and the start-ups being the driving force of Indian economy, the opportunity to cater to these segments is immense and is increasing manifold year on year. The challenge here therefore remains as to how we capture a larger share of the opportunity by developing specific solutions to cater each segment of the business. Also by creating an inexpensive and standardized solution to increase the reach into the pockets of channel partners across the country to harness on their captive business and explore new opportunities with them.
  
  
Market Opportunities – With the advent of medical advancements, lifestyle changes, change in Indian socio-economic scenario and Indian healthcare space, and the insurers are facing challenges to cater to the needs of this diverse clientele. Increasingly Indian customers have started considering health insurance partners as extensions of health advisers. In this scenario it becomes extremely important to understand their psyche and then provide tailored solutions with wellness benefits which would help them meet their end objectives and bring in profitable revenue source for the company.
  
  
**About The Aditya Birla Health Insurance –**
Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited (ABHICL) was incorporated in 2015 as a 51:49 joint venture between Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) and MMI Strategic Investments (Pty) Ltd. ABHICL commenced its operations in October 2016.
  
  
ABHICL has entered the competitive health insurance market with an aim to expand the category to wider customer segments, beyond the ones that health insurance companies traditionally have marketed to. As the 6th entrant in a category with well-established players, ABHICL is creating differentiation and equity for itself though the unique business proposition of “Health Insurance for All”, a one of a kind proposition in India at the moment. This is a philosophy that is being built through every single consumer touch point and into every single backend process of the company to ensure a customer’s experience of our proposition is continuous and seamless.
  
  
ABHI’s unique offering to market includes proposition includes -
  
  

* A Comprehensive Incentivized Wellness Program that will attract the young and health conscious and will motivate, guide and reward them to stay healthy
* A Chronic Care Management Program to cater to the unmet needs of a growing Indian population of those suffering from chronic lifestyle conditions like Diabetes, Asthma, High Cholesterol and Hypertension from Day 1
* ABHICL serves as an enabler and influencer of health and healthcare choices that customers make, in addition to being a payer of healthcare expenses. Thus, ABHICL would act like a much needed catalyst to grow the prevalent health insurance landscape in India through product innovations and a wider choice of consumer relevant products.
* ABHICL’s vision has always been digital. The company has been successful in adopting paper-less approach right from identifying to on-boarding to delivering seamless experience of its customers & employees.

title: Oracle Fusion Finance consultant
description:
Seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Finance Professional with 10+ years of overall experience to lead, implement, support, and optimize financial processes and modules within Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials.
  
  
**Job Description**
Lead the functional management of Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials, including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CM), Expenses, and related Treasury/Banking integrations.
  
  
Gather and analyze business requirements, conduct fit-gap analysis, and translate business needs into functional specifications and Oracle Fusion solutions.
  
  
Design and document functional solutions, extensions, integrations, and reporting requirements where standard Oracle Fusion functionality does not fully meet business needs.
  
  
Collaborate closely with technical, integration, reporting, and business teams to communicate requirements and validate delivered solutions.
  
  
Provide functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Finance configuration, integrations, extensions, workflows, and reporting to improve financial processes.
  
  
Support enterprise structures, ledgers, legal entities, business units, accounting configurations, approval workflows, and financial controls.
  
  
Work with Oracle Fusion reporting capabilities such as OTBI, BI Publisher, and Financial Reporting based on project requirements.
  
  
Ensure adherence to financial controls, compliance requirements, audit readiness, and organizational governance within Oracle Fusion environments.
  
  
Create and maintain functional design documents, configuration documents, process flows, training materials, test scripts, and knowledge-base content for business users and support teams.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  
Lead the end-to-end Oracle Fusion Finance implementation and application lifecycle, including requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Act as the primary liaison between Finance, IT, Oracle/implementation partners, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless Fusion Financials operations.
  
  
Conduct impact assessments and risk analysis for configuration changes, enhancements, integrations, quarterly updates, and business-process changes.
  
  
Provide ongoing application support, including incident resolution, root-cause analysis, problem management, and continuous process improvements.
  
  
Analyze and troubleshoot functional and transactional issues and collaborate with technical teams for integration, data, reporting, and extension-related debugging.
  
  
Support data migration, conversions, interfaces, and integrations with upstream and downstream systems.
  
  
Work with third-party platforms and financial institutions to support integration points such as bank integrations, payment systems, reconciliation processes, and treasury solutions.
  
  
Support interfaces using applicable Oracle Fusion integration mechanisms such as REST/SOAP services, FBDI, ADFdi, and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) where relevant.
  
  
Participate in financial audits, compliance assessments, and internal-control reviews relating to Oracle Fusion Finance.
  
  
Plan and support SIT, UAT, regression testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support to ensure high-quality deliverables.
  
  
Assess Oracle Fusion Cloud updates and coordinate regression testing and business validation for relevant Finance functionality.
  
  
Mentor junior functional consultants and team members, providing guidance and sharing Oracle Fusion Finance best practices.
  
  
Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for process standardization, automation, reporting improvements, and effective utilization of Oracle Fusion capabilities.
