**Position Summary:**
The
**Real Estate Accountant**
is responsible for accounting activities supporting the company’s real estate and lease portfolio, with primary responsibility for right-of-use (ROU) asset and lease liability accounting. This role manages lease and facility expense accounting, prepares and records journal entries, performs balance sheet reconciliations, supports close activities, and assists with SOX compliance and annual audit requirements. The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of accruals, prepayments, amortization, variance analysis, and lease accounting processes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Manage accounting for ROU assets and lease liabilities, including initial recognition, monthly amortization, lease payments, modifications, remeasurements, and other lease-related activity.
* Perform lease expense accounting and ensure lease-related expenses are recorded accurately and timely.
* Prepare, review, and post recurring and non-recurring journal entries, including: Utility expense accruals, Personal property tax accruals and payments, Rent expense and rent-related entries, Prepaid rent and prepaid tax amortization, ROU asset amortization, Facility expense allocations, Asset retirement obligation (ARO) accounting and related adjustments, Other real estate, occupancy, and lease-related expenses
* Manage prepayments and amortizations for rent, taxes, utilities, facilities, and other assigned expenses.
* Prepare month-end adjustments and support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities.
* Prepare and perform balance sheet reconciliations for security deposits, lease liabilities, ROU assets, prepaids, asset retirement obligations, and other assigned real estate-related accounts.
* Investigate, resolve, and document reconciling items, account variances, and discrepancies in a timely manner.
* Perform balance sheet flux analysis and provide explanations for material period-over-period changes.
* Perform profit and loss variance analysis for real estate, lease, utility, and facility-related expenses.
* Reconcile lease subledger activity and related general ledger balances, ensuring alignment between Visual Lease and Oracle Fusion.
* Maintain supporting documentation for journal entries, reconciliations, lease calculations, account analyses, and audit requests.
* Support SOX compliance by preparing control evidence, maintaining process documentation, and assisting with control testing activities.
* Assist with internal and annual external audits by providing schedules, reconciliations, documentation, and explanations for real estate-related account balances.
* Coordinate with Real Estate, Facilities, Accounts Payable, Tax, Treasury, Financial Reporting, and other internal stakeholders to obtain information needed for accurate accounting.
* Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, internal controls, reconciliation procedures, documentation, and reporting.
* Support ad hoc reporting, analysis, and special projects as assigned.

**Broadridge**
, you will have the opportunity to:
  
  

* Build expertise in global finance operations and work with complex accounting processes supporting a global organization.
* Work with leading finance technologies, including platforms such as Oracle Fusion and Visual Lease.
* Collaborate across functions and geographies, partnering with Finance, Real Estate, Facilities, Tax, Treasury, Accounts Payable, and Financial Reporting teams.
* Drive process improvements and contribute to automation, controls, and operational efficiency.
* Develop your career through exposure to diverse accounting processes, stakeholders, and global business operations.
* Be part of a culture that values innovation, inclusion, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Work in an environment where your contributions have a direct impact on the quality, accuracy, and efficiency of global financial operations.

Be part of Broadridge. Build what's next.
  
  
**Join us and grow your career while helping transform the way global businesses operate.**
We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. title: Quantitative Rates Researcher
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Quantitative Rates Researcher to support a leading investment bank’s algorithmic trading platform project.
  
  
The role involves evaluating AI-generated quantitative research and systematic trading strategies focused on fixed income and interest rate markets. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in quantitative finance, rates markets, statistical modeling, and backtesting methodologies to assess research quality, validate assumptions, and identify methodological flaws.
  
  
Prior experience with AI systems is not required. Strong domain expertise in quantitative finance and interest rate markets is the primary requirement.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Review and evaluate quantitative research outputs and systematic trading strategies focused on fixed income and interest rate markets.
* Identify research and backtesting issues, including lookahead bias, overfitting, data snooping, and unrealistic transaction cost assumptions.
* Evaluate backtesting frameworks, including rates-specific mechanics such as carry, roll-down analytics, and contract roll conventions.
* Assess the statistical rigor of signal construction, factor modeling, and alpha research.
* Review yield curve models, relative value strategies, and interest rate trading instruments.
* Validate model assumptions, implementation accuracy, and research methodologies.
* Evaluate strategies under realistic market conditions, accounting for transaction costs, liquidity constraints, and execution assumptions.
* Provide detailed written feedback with actionable recommendations to improve research quality and accuracy.
* Collaborate asynchronously with project coordinators to clarify findings and communicate technical insights.
* Contribute to improving quantitative research evaluation methodologies.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in quantitative research, quantitative analysis, or quantitative finance.
* Strong expertise in fixed income analysis and interest rate markets.
* Advanced proficiency in Python or R for quantitative research and data analysis.
* Hands-on experience with Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and SciPy.
* Strong understanding of systematic trading strategy development and backtesting.
* Experience with yield curve modeling and carry/roll-down analytics.
* Knowledge of relative value trading strategies and interest rate market instruments.
* Familiarity with SOFR and Eurodollar instruments, as well as Treasury futures.
* Strong knowledge of statistical analysis, factor modeling, and alpha research.
* Understanding of transaction costs, liquidity constraints, and realistic trading assumptions.
* Ability to identify lookahead bias, overfitting, data snooping, and other research methodology flaws.
* Excellent analytical, written communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate complex quantitative concepts clearly and work effectively with distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience as a Quantitative Researcher, Quantitative Analyst, or Consultant specializing in fixed income or interest rate markets.
* Experience developing and backtesting systematic rates strategies at a hedge fund, asset management firm, or investment bank.
* Strong practical knowledge of rates trading, yield curve dynamics, and quantitative modeling.
* Experience reviewing and validating quantitative models against established quantitative finance best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to assess research quality, implementation fidelity, model assumptions, and statistical robustness.

title: Analyst- Accounts Payable
description:
**About DESRI**
DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 11.9 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 80 renewable energy projects in 24 states. DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, Houston, Portland and Hyderabad (India).
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a detail-oriented AP professional to join our Finance Operations team in Hyderabad. You will be a key member of a lean, high-trust AP function supporting DESRI's US entities, working closely with colleagues across Hyderabad and the United States. This role requires strong ownership, US AP expertise and commitment to control and accuracy.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
You will manage the end-to-end accounts payable cycle for DESRI's US entities across the following areas:
  
  

* Vendor Setup & US Tax Compliance- Set up domestic and foreign vendors in Workday using W-9 and W-8 series forms (W-8BEN, W-8BEN-E); administer year-end 1099 filings (1099-NEC, 1099-MISC); enforce banking verification protocols via AVS portal to prevent fraud.
* Invoice Processing- Process supplier invoices in Workday with accurate GL coding, cost-centre allocation and payment terms; perform three-way matching against POs and contracts; review invoices for Sales & Use Tax accuracy; prevent duplicate payments; support ACH, wire, and cheque payment execution.
* Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination. Liaise with suppliers and asset managers to obtain missing invoices and resolve payment queries; perform periodic vendor statement reconciliations; collaborate closely with Hyderabad and US teams on accurate invoice processing.
* Reporting, Contracts & Draw Support. Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly AP reports in Workday (aging analysis, on-hold trackers); set up supplier contracts (SC) and POs; support the Asset Management and Construction Finance teams on monthly draw payments, including WTCs, retainage tracking and lien waiver documentation.
* Expense & Card Program Management- Manage monthly American Express payments and site visit reimbursements for US employees; audit expense reports for T&E policy compliance, ensuring receipts, business purpose and approvals are in place before reimbursement.
* Month-End Close & Treasury. Clean the AP aging report monthly; initiate payment requests with the treasury team; support month-end close; coordinate financial settlement runs and reconciliation with treasury and accounting teams.
* Controls, Compliance & Process Improvement- Support internal and external audit requests (sample selections, walkthroughs, evidence packs); monitor stale-dated cheques for escheatment reporting; identify and implement efficiency improvements including AP automation platforms (e.g., Auditoria).

**Qualifications-**
The ideal candidate should hold –
  
  

* Education: Degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field
* Experience: 1-3 years of hands-on Accounts Payable experience, preferably supporting US-based entities
* Skills: Working knowledge of US AP practices: 1099 reporting, W-9 / W-8 form handling, Sales and Use Tax review, Hands-on experience with Workday Financials or a comparable enterprise ERP, Strong Excel skills for aging analysis, reconciliations and reporting; keen attention to detail, Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Work Style: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment both autonomously and collaboratively with teams located across different time zones and jurisdictions.

**Preferred Qualifications (if Any)**

* Prior experience in the renewable energy sector, infrastructure/EPC or project-based finance
* Familiarity with construction AP concepts: retainage, lien waivers, milestone-based draws
* Exposure to AP automation platforms (e.g., Auditoria, Tipalti); experience supporting SOX audits or controls-intensive finance functions.

title: Associate Contracts & Pricing
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As the Associate, Medicaid – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN), you will support execution of U.S. Medicaid rebate operations within the Contracts & Pricing Execution function. This role will support invoice gathering, claim loading, validation checks, CLD processing, dispute documentation, payment package preparation, reporting, reconciliation support, SOP documentation, controls, and operational improvement activities.
  
  
The role will partner with the Medicaid Manager, AIN team members, ATO Medicaid process owners, Government Pricing, Finance, Compliance, Contracting, Information Systems, and other U.S.-based stakeholders to support accurate, timely, and compliant Medicaid operations. The Associate will be expected to learn Medicaid processes through structured KT, shadowing, reverse shadowing, and supervised execution before taking on broader independent responsibilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
*Medicaid Processing & Operational Execution*

* Support day-to-day execution of Medicaid rebate operations including invoice receipt tracking, invoice conversion, Model N upload preparation, claim processing, payment package support, and documentation maintenance.
* Execute assigned standard-state activities in accordance with SOPs, work instructions, checklists, quality standards, and established timelines.
* Maintain accurate trackers for invoice status, CLD receipt, validation outcomes, open items, dispute status, payment package readiness, and evidence retention.
* Flag risks, missing information, aged items, access issues, or process exceptions to the Medicaid Manager and ATO retained owners.

*Invoice Validation & CLD Support*

* Perform first-pass invoice validation checks for assigned Medicaid states, including unit, NDC, reimbursement, URA, invoice, and source data reasonableness checks.
* Support CLD formatting, control checks, historical utilization comparison, duplicate discount screening support, and preparation of analysis files for review.
* Document validation findings, assumptions, supporting evidence, and required follow-up actions clearly and consistently.
* Escalate complex state nuances, high-risk exceptions, unusual utilization trends, or ambiguous payment/dispute issues for manager or ATO review.

*Dispute, Adjustment & Payment Package Support*

* Prepare dispute documentation, dispute tracking updates, response support, and evidence files for disputed units and rebate amounts.
* Support preparation of ROSI, PQAS, remittance, payment package, and SharePoint archival documentation in accordance with SOP requirements.
* Assist with prior quarter adjustments, supplemental claim support, interest calculation evidence, and payment reconciliation support as assigned.
* Maintain clean audit trails, decision logs, and supporting workpapers for Medicaid invoice and payment activities.

*Systems, Documentation & Continuous Improvement*

* Use Model N / PbN, SAP, Validata, SharePoint, state portals, reporting tools, and Microsoft 365 applications to support Medicaid workflow execution.
* Assist with UAT, defect documentation, access readiness tracking, SOP updates, work instruction drafting, training material preparation, and knowledge repository maintenance.
* Participate in KT, shadowing, reverse shadowing, and supervised execution activities to build Medicaid process proficiency.
* Identify process gaps, manual effort reduction opportunities, recurring exceptions, documentation gaps, and quality improvement ideas.

*Compliance, Controls & Audit Readiness*

* Execute work in accordance with internal policies, Medicaid SOPs, controlled process requirements, documentation standards, and compliance expectations.
* Maintain accurate evidence for invoice receipt, validation, disputes, payment support, approvals, reconciliations, and archival steps.
* Escalate data integrity, compliance, financial, or operational risks promptly and support remediation activities as assigned.
* Support audit, SOX, and control review activities by providing complete workpapers and organized documentation.

**What We Expect Of You**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented Medicaid / managed markets operations professional with strong analytical, documentation, and process execution capabilities. This individual should bring ownership, accuracy, curiosity, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to support compliant and timely Medicaid rebate execution.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or related discipline.
* 2–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical / healthcare operations, managed markets, Medicaid rebates, finance operations, revenue management, claims operations, analytics, or related controlled business operations.
* Strong Excel, documentation, reporting, analytical, and follow-through skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet timelines, follow SOPs, and work effectively in a deadline-driven and highly controlled environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to Medicaid rebate operations, payer rebates, managed markets finance, claims validation, CLD processing, dispute tracking, rebate adjudication, Gross-to-Net, or pharmaceutical revenue management.
* Experience with Model N / PbN, Validata, Revitas Flex, SAP, SharePoint, Tableau, Qlik Sense, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, Power Automate, or comparable tools.
* Understanding of NDC, AMP, Best Price, URA, AWP, ROSI, PQAS, 340B duplicate discount concepts, managed care utilization, and compliance documentation is desirable.
* Experience supporting SOPs, WSIs, audit-ready workpapers, issue trackers, UAT, system implementation, automation, or process improvement activities.
* Strong collaboration, communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and ability to work with U.S.-based stakeholders in a distributed global operating model.

title: Mars Transfer Pricing Transformation Manager

description:
**Role: Senior Manager MEL, Hyderabad**

**About the Organization**

We are an international non-profit organization dedicated to equipping adolescent girls with the skills, agency, and support required to access economic opportunities and break intergenerational cycles of poverty and inequality. Through our flagship initiatives, we support young women in carving out their own paths across entrepreneurship, formal employment, and higher education. Operating across multiple countries with a diverse network of local partners, our programs impact thousands of adolescent girls globally.

**Role Summary**

As our organization expands across South Asia and Africa, we are seeking a dynamic Senior Manager – Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) to drive our overarching MEL function. In this role, you will shape our strategic approach to measuring impact, generating actionable insights, and leveraging evidence to refine program design and operations.

Working closely with internal Program and Operations teams, you will strengthen measurement frameworks, build partner and team capacities, and cultivate a strong organizational culture of continuous learning, reflection, and accountability. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking with hands-on expertise in evaluation design, data systems, analysis, and evidence application within the development or education sectors.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Monitoring, Evaluation & Research**

* Lead the design, refinement, and rollout of comprehensive monitoring frameworks, logical frameworks, and outcome/output indicators.
* Design and oversee qualitative, quantitative, and mixed-methods evaluation approaches and measurement tools.
* Drive MEL strategies for program pilots and experimentation to enable iterative learning, adaptation, and scale.
* Lead and oversee priority research initiatives focusing on women's and adolescent girls' economic agency.

**2. Data Management, Analysis & Evidence**

* Strengthen data management, quality assurance, and tech-enabled monitoring tools (including digital dashboards integrated with internal and government platforms).
* Lead quantitative and qualitative data analysis, translating complex metrics into actionable insights for leadership and program teams.
* Establish organizational standards for data quality, consistency, accessibility, and ethical usage.

**3. Team Capacity & Data Culture**

* Foster an organizational culture where data and evidence actively inform day-to-day program decisions and operations.
* Build and lead the internal MEL team structure, defining clear roles and responsibilities to achieve functional goals.
* Enhance MEL capabilities among program staff, operations teams, and implementation partners through targeted training and mentoring.

**4. Stakeholder Engagement**

* Prepare high-quality, credible impact reports and evidence summaries for executive leadership, donors, government bodies, and external partners.
* Collaborate with Communications and Fundraising units to translate MEL insights into donor proposals, impact stories, and external communications.
* Represent the organization at relevant sector forums, research conferences, and MEL networks.

**5. Government Reporting, Systems & Accountability**

* Design and maintain systems for accurate, timely, and compliant reporting aligned with government frameworks and platforms.
* Harmonize internal indicator definitions and tools with public sector reporting formats and data quality requirements.
* Coordinate across regional and field teams to validate data, resolve discrepancies, and maintain rigorous documentation.
* Develop government-facing dashboards, evidence briefs, and progress reports detailing implementation, challenges, and corrective actions.
* Utilize government administrative data to optimize targeting, delivery quality, and scale decisions.

**Qualifications & Relevant Experience**

**Required:**

* **Education:**
  Master's degree in Development Studies, Economics, Statistics, Social Research, Public Policy, Education, Data Science, or a related field.
* **Experience:**
  6–8 years of experience in MEL within the development or education sector, including leadership of MEL functions or major evaluation/research projects.
* **Technical Skills:**
  Hands-on experience with data software and platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, SurveyCTO, KoboToolbox, ODK, SPSS, Stata, or R.
* **Research & Evaluation:**
  Demonstrated experience designing and executing end-to-end evaluations using quantitative, qualitative, experimental, or quasi-experimental methodologies.
* **Data Systems:**
  Deep expertise in MIS, data visualization, digital monitoring systems, and end-to-end data pipelines.
* **Government Alignment:**
  Experience developing reporting, compliance documentation, or dashboards for government bodies or public systems.
* **Data Ethics & Governance:**
  Practical understanding of data safeguarding, informed consent, confidentiality, and responsible handling of adolescent girls' data.
* **Communication & Leadership:**
  Strong track record of distilling technical findings into decision-oriented communications for non-technical stakeholders, donors, and leadership.
* **Values Alignment:**
  Strong commitment to gender equality, youth agency, and social inclusion.

**Good to Have:**

* Prior experience working with public education systems, government MIS, or EdTech ecosystems (specifically in India).
* Advanced Excel capabilities (pivot tables, data cleaning/reconciliation, automated visualization).
* Fluency in Telugu or Kannada.
* Project management experience coordinating complex reporting cycles across multiple partners and geographies.
* Experience managing external research agencies, evaluators, or technical consultants.

**Key Benefits**

* High ownership and strategic impact in a values-driven, collaborative work culture.
* Generous leave package, including parental leave.
* Mentorship and professional growth opportunities with executive leadership.
* Opportunity to shape high-impact initiatives that define economic participation for adolescent girls.

title: Analyst/Senior Analyst - P&L Reporting
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
The D. E. Shaw group uses a combination of quantitative and qualitative tools to uncover self-governing, hard-to-find sources of return across global public and private markets. We are seeking an analyst/Senior Analyst to join our P&L Reporting team at the firm’s office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram, India which is responsible for producing firm-wide reports that provide insights and analyses into key performance indicators— including profit and loss (P&L), expenses, capital, returns, and fees— for the offices of the Chief Operating Officer (COO), Chief Financial Officer (CFO), business unit (BU) heads, and portfolio managers. The group handles ad hoc requests related to P&L and capital from portfolio managers and senior stakeholders, facilitating effective decision making through clear reporting, analyses, and recommendations. Another key responsibility is driving technology initiatives—leveraging a combination of proprietary and third-party tools to prepare and present reports, streamline workflows, improve process controls, and enhance user experience.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will take end-to-end ownership of the team’s recurring P&L reporting suite — across daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and year-end cycles — ensuring every report on P&L, expenses, capital, returns & fees is accurate, timely and complete. You will also coordinate with various teams including Front Office, Risk, Pricing, and other teams in FinOp to ensure accuracy of data while managing recurring workflows to sync, reconcile and allocate P&L, expenses and capital. Additionally, you will act as the domain expert and “human in the loop” for automated recurring workflows — running, validating and troubleshooting outputs (including those produced with GenAI) and owning the controls that keep reporting accurate. You will also respond to P&L and capital-related ad-hoc requests from portfolio managers and senior stakeholders. Finally, you will understand changes in the firm’s businesses, like new products and fund launches, and incorporate these changes into the recurring reports independently.

* The ability to be self-motivated, exhibit keen attention to detail, and have a high sense of ownership with an attitude to take initiative in driving process enhancements

* A CA / MBA degree from a reputed college with 1 to 3 years of work experience in the Financial Services industry

title: FP&A Manager
description:
Ayr designs and manufactures critical power grid equipment including power transformers, distribution transformers, special-purpose transformers, high-voltage circuit breakers, and medium-voltage switchgear. We serve markets such as renewables, data centers, utilities, oil & gas, and industrial sectors.
  
  
Website: https://ayr.energy
  
  
**Role Summary**
This is a business-first finance role. We are looking for someone who understands how the business makes money, not just how the numbers are reported. You will partner with sales, project and supply chain teams to understand what is driving orders, margins and cash. You will then turn that understanding into budgets, forecasts and recommendations that leadership can act on.
  
  
You should be curious about the business: how a bid becomes an order, how an order becomes a delivery, and how a delivery becomes cash. If you understand that cycle, you will see problems in the numbers before they show up in the P&L.
  
  
****Business Understanding We Expect****

* How the business earns and keeps its margin. This covers sourcing, pricing, freight, duties, FX, warranty and commissioning, and how each affects project profitability.
* The order-to-cash cycle. This runs from tender and bid to contract terms, milestone billing, delivery, retention and collection. You should understand where cash gets stuck and why.
* The market and customers. Utilities, discoms, IPPs and EPC contractors differ in payment behavior, contract structure and risk.
* Cross-border operations. This means the flow between AEI and AEIPL, import and export implications, and currency exposure.
* Commercial risk. This includes guarantees, LDs (liquidated damages), warranties, insurance and counterparty risk, and how they show up in financial outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**
****Budgeting and forecasting****

* Prepare the annual budget and rolling forecasts for AEI and AEIPL.
* Build driver-based models grounded in real business drivers: order book, delivery schedules, vendor lead times, pricing and cost inputs.
* Challenge assumptions with business teams and update forecasts when the ground reality changes.

****Reporting and insight****

* Prepare monthly management reports with variance analysis that explains the business reason behind each variance, not just the number.
* Analyze margins by project, product and customer, including freight, duties, FX and logistics.
* Build MIS dashboards and board and investor reporting packs. Slides should be brief and precise.

****Cash and working capital****

* Prepare 13-week cash flow forecasts and track receivables, payables and inventory.
* Monitor bank guarantee and SBLC utilization, and facility headroom.
* Link cash movement to project milestones and business events.

****Process improvement****

* Automate and standardize recurring reports and models.
* Improve data quality and reporting timelines.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* MBA (Finance), CA (Inter), CA qualified
* 2–3 years in FP&A, business finance or financial planning, with demonstrated partnering with non-finance teams.
* Experience in manufacturing, EPC, power, renewables or other project-based, order-driven businesses is strongly preferred.

**Skills**
****Business and analytical****

* Strong business and commercial acumen. You can explain what is happening in the business and why.
* Sound judgment on what matters. You can separate signal from noise and focus on the few drivers that move margin and cash.
* Ability to read contracts and commercial terms and translate them into financial impact.
* Structured problem solving and a habit of asking “why” behind the numbers.

****Technical****

* Advanced Excel: financial modelling, lookups, pivots, scenario and sensitivity analysis.
* Solid grasp of P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, and how they connect.
* Familiarity with an accounting system (Zoho Books, QuickBooks or similar).
* Working knowledge of cost and margin analysis, working capital and basic FX exposure.
* Exposure to Power BI or similar tools is a plus.

****Behavioral****

* Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain numbers in plain language to non-finance colleagues.
* Confidence to challenge assumptions and hold a view, while staying collaborative.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail and respect for deadlines.
* Comfortable working with US and India teams across time zones.

**What We Offer**

* Direct exposure to leadership and cross-border finance.
* A growing company in the energy infrastructure sector.
* A clear path to Senior FP&A / Business Finance Manager.
* Compensation as per experience and industry standards.

title: Retail Research Specialist
description:
"This role is part of Accenture Research’s global industry research team with a focus on the Retail Industry. Retail industry comprises of retailers and distributors, including supermarkets, specialty premium retailers and large mass-merchandise discounters.
  
  
The Retail Research Specialist will support senior researchers and Accenture’s Retail industry leaders on both Thought Leadership reports / industry PoVs, as well as client research projects globally.
  
  
Responsibilities will include leading small research projects and actively contributing to complex projects led by others.
  
  
We are looking for a strong researcher with a passion for the retail industry and interest in key issues impacting the industry like channels, changing consumer behavior, sourcing, fulfillment, talent and data.
  
  
Key Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Assisting and supporting the development of thought-provoking insights through market analysis and in-depth review of trends, guided by senior researchers.
* Drawing on both traditional and innovative data sources and research methodologies to explore key questions in a logical, structured manner.
* Analyzing large datasets and interpreting results using statistical techniques and data visualization tools
* Updating our proprietary in-house models and provides results to the practice when needed.
* Developing research insights and compelling business narratives alongside research leads.
* Presenting key findings in a structured and concise manner (with focus on insights).

“Hard” skills:
  
  

* Ability to use techniques such as secondary research, company analysis, market analysis, strategic analysis frameworks, interview-based research and financial analysis.
* Strong analytical skills and a proven ability to make sense out of data, with ability to analyze, visualize, and interpret
* Able to learn and embrace new sources, tools, and skills, including alternative modes of research delivery/data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Qlik etc.).
* Ability to make ethical use of AI tools for research such as ChatGPT, CoPilot and others
* Compiling reports/analysis with clear storyline and results.
* A basic understanding of the role of digital and technology in disrupting the retail industry.
* Able to write in a clear, concise, and compelling way
* Strong PowerPoint, Excel, and Word skills

“Soft” skills:
  
  

* Strong interest in the Retail industry and Technology
* Intellectual curiosity and desire to learn more and grow
* Problem solver approach to work
* Proven ability to work effectively - independently, collaboratively, and virtually - in a global, multi-cultural, multi-time zone team
* Ability to present research findings to team and Accenture executives
* Strong communications skills and good interpersonal skills
* Strong professional qualities: client focus, decisiveness, integrity, resilience to stress against stretch goals and deadlines
* Ability to work on multiple engagement and geographies at any one time.

Additional Information
  
  
Reports to: Retail Research Lead
  
  
Qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree, preferably in a science or engineering.
* A full-time masters or a post graduate degree in business, such as business (MBA), economics or equivalent.

Work Experience:
  
  

* 3+ to 6 years of business experience, preferably in a consulting environment, think tank, financial institution, or other 3rd party business research organization or demonstrated equivalent skill.

Location: 1st preference - Hyderabad, India, 2nd preference – Bengaluru, India
  
  
Preferred start date: As soon as possible "

title: Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Markets Business Finance \& Control (BF\&C) is a division of Global Banking \& Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for the production and independent validation of Global Markets' profit and loss and balance sheet. In this regard, BF\&C will ensure, inter alia, that accounting policies are correctly and consistently applied, and that trading portfolios are appropriately valued.
   

  

 The team prepares and reports P\&L and balance sheet to the business and ensures the accuracy and integrity of the general ledger. We are responsible for daily service delivery and ensuring effective controls, transparent management information and becoming a center of excellence delivering process simplification and efficiencies. We work closely with front office, middle office, traders and valuation control teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 Global Markets Business Finance \& Control (BF\&C) seeks to provide a support service with particular focus on the relationship between trading risk positions and P\&L components. We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the P\&L production area covering the Global Credit Trading desks. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to produce and deliver the daily P\&L to front office, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation around any issues faced and daily revenue drivers. The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Middle Office, and Finance and Trade Capture teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Primary products covered will include: Bonds, CDS, ETFs, TRS and Loans
* Production and reporting of daily P\&L to Front Office \& Senior Management
* Reconcile actual P\&L with trader estimates and provide flash/actual variance analysis
* Working closely with the trading desks on position, P\&L or other issues on an ad\-hoc basis
* Front\-to\-Back analysis \& reconciliations of front office PnL and balance sheet to firm sub\-ledgers
* Assist with execution of month\-end controls ensuring management vs financial P\&L variances are within thresholds
* Analyze traders’ risk positions and understand and apply the Greeks (Delta, Vega Gamma) vs daily market moves

title: Accounting Engineer (CA/Semiqualified CA)
description:
We're Hiring: Accounting Engineer — CA / SEMI qualified CA
 



 📍 Hyderabad
 



  





 The Role
 



 We're building AI agents that can run the books of a business.
 



 As an 
 **Accounting Engineer** 
 , you'll be the accounting expert those agents answer to. You'll review what they post, catch what they get wrong, define the rules they follow, and continuously improve how they handle real\-world accounting.
 



 This isn't a traditional accounting role. There's 
 **no audit, no routine data entry, and no visiting clients** 
 .
 



 Instead, you'll work at the intersection of 
 **accounting and AI** 
  — turning accounting knowledge into rules, logic, checks, and guardrails that allow AI agents to operate accurately at scale.
 



  





 What You'll Own
 



 → Review AI\-agent posted accounting entries, reconciliations, and exceptions across multiple client books
 



 → Identify and resolve accounting exceptions — from unusual invoices to mismatched payouts and reconciliation differences
 



 → Design and improve accounting logic, including CoA structures, posting rules, mappings, reconciliation logic, and GST treatment
 



 → Define what an AI agent can post independently and what it must escalate for human review
 



 → Build rules, prompts, checks, and guardrails that improve agent accuracy
 



 → Investigate recurring errors and convert every fix into a rule so the same problem doesn't repeat
 



 → Own the final accounting judgment on whether an entry, reconciliation, or treatment is correct
 



 → Work closely with engineers to translate accounting decisions into systems that agents can execute
 



 → Take ownership of a domain of the product end\-to\-end rather than processing a queue of files
 



**Zero manual data entry. We mean it.** 




  





 What We're Looking For
 



 → 
 **CA Inter / Semi\-qualified CA / Qualified CA** 
  with strong exposure to bookkeeping and GST
 



 → Strong accounting fundamentals — you understand 
 *why* 
  an entry is correct, not just how to pass it
 



 → Practical experience with bookkeeping, reconciliations, GST, and real\-world accounting scenarios
 



 → Ability to identify unexplained differences and investigate them until they make sense
 



 → Comfort with accounting tools, Excel, and technology
 



 → Curiosity about AI and an interest in understanding how accounting work can be automated
 



 → Ability to explain accounting decisions clearly and precisely enough for an engineer — or an AI agent — to follow
 



 → High ownership and attention to detail
 



**Coding isn't required.** 
  Our engineers handle the code; you bring the accounting judgment and logic.
 



  





 What Makes This Role Different
 



 A traditional accounting role asks:
 



**"Can you process these books correctly?"** 




 This role asks:
 



**"Can you teach a machine to process these books correctly — and know when it shouldn't?"** 




 You'll be working on the accounting intelligence behind an AI\-first product, helping us move from automating individual tasks to building agents that can reason through accounting workflows.
 



 If you've ever automated a repetitive accounting task in Excel and thought 
 *"there has to be a better way"* 
  — you'll probably enjoy this role.
 



  





 Who Should Apply?
 



**CA Inter / Semi\-qualified CA:** 
  You'll focus more on reviewing agent output, resolving exceptions, reconciliations, and progressively building accounting rules and automation logic.
 



**Qualified CA:** 
  You'll take greater ownership of accounting architecture, agent behaviour, posting logic, GST treatment, guardrails, accuracy evaluation, and product\-level accounting decisions.
 



 The exact scope will depend on your experience and depth.
 



  





 How to Apply
 



 📩 
 **naveena.rao@numerize.ai** 




**Subject:** 
  Accounting Engineer
 



 In your email, answer this:
 



**Tell us one accounting rule you'd trust an AI to apply without supervision, and one you never would.** 




 You can also tell us about the most tedious accounting task you've ever automated — 
 **Excel absolutely counts.** 




 Before applying, read 
 **"Who is an Accounting Engineer?"** 




 https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/who\-accounting\-engineer\-naveena\-rao\-bkbof/
 



 It explains the thinking behind this role better than any conventional JD can.
 



 If the idea excites you, you're probably our person.

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Business Finance and Control (BFC) sits within the CFO Org and is mainly responsible to ensure strong financial controls along with enabling the business. The Global Rates (GR) BFC supports the GR business, which falls under Global Markets and specifically in the Global Market FICC division. Counterparty Portfolio Management (CPM) BFC desk manages 2 individual VTDs that are engaged in trading, risk management and optimization activity across asset classes in Global Markets. VTDs include:
   

  

* XVA End\-User and XVA Flow (collectively, XVA) are responsible for pricing and hedging credit and funding risks on OTC derivatives executed with Global Markets clients (CVA and FVA)
* Risk Optimization Group (ROG) is primarily responsible for maximizing the efficiency of compressions of OTC derivatives between affiliates and CCPs


 The CPM BFC teams are responsible for assisting in Analysis \& reporting of PnL and ensuring integrity, completeness, and accuracy of PnL data. Teams work closely with CPM front office desks and support them on various other initiatives to enable the business and ensure better controls.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 Global Markets Business Finance \& Control (BF\&C) seeks to provide a support service with particular focus on the relationship between trading risk positions and P\&L components. We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the P\&L production area covering the Global Counterparty Portfolio Management desks. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to produce and deliver the daily P\&L to front office, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation around any issues faced and daily revenue drivers. The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Middle Office, and Finance and Trade Capture teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job.
   

  

 Strong Products knowledge of Fixed Income Derivatives (Rates, Credit, FX etc.), Concept of XVA (CVA, FVA, DVA, etc.), Bonds, Futures and Options and Capital Markets.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Primary products covered will include: Collateral, OTC Derivatives, Swaps, Repos \& Reverse Repos, Futures and options
* Production and reporting of daily P\&L to Front Office \& Senior Management
* Reconcile actual P\&L with trader estimates and provide flash/actual variance analysis
* Working closely with the trading desks on position, P\&L or other issues on an ad\-hoc basis
* Front\-to\-Back analysis \& reconciliations of front office P\&L and balance sheet to firm sub\-ledgers
* Assist with execution of month\-end controls ensuring management vs financial P\&L variances are within thresholds
* Analyze traders’ risk positions and understand and apply the Greeks (Delta, Vega Gamma) vs daily market moves
* Would be typical own set of books / cost center and Business Units
* Liaise with various business partners such as Technology, Market Risk, Rates Risk, Operations and Finance to resolve issues / queries
* Development \& continuous improvement of existing processes \& workflow
* Testing / UAT for systems work ranging from minor system releases to major system implementations
* Remediation of issues in an autonomous yet timely manner considering the principles of control and the need to mitigate operational risk


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA /CFA / MBA from Tier I/II institute
   

  

 Certifications If Any
   

  

* CFA / FRM certified candidates would be preferred
* Advanced education and/or enhanced technical qualifications are a plus
* Ability to use Access or VBA would enhance the candidate’s attractiveness significantly


 Certifications If Any
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 8\+ years of experience in Global Markets
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Detailed Knowledge of product control and financial markets
* Should have good understanding of financial markets, Derivatives \& structured notes\-their hedging, funding, Rates risk etc.
* Prior BFC experience for \>6 years is mandatory
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite; expert knowledge of Excel, Word, PowerPoint. Knowledge of Visual Basic, Access databases and macros will be an added advantage.
* The right individual will have strong people skills and can multi\-task to manage the challenges of Finance processes yet have the awareness to escalate potential issues to their supervisor in a timely manner
* Candidate must have a proven track record of communicating effectively with personnel from various areas within an organization and at different management levels
* Must be proactive and be a highly motivated and self\-starter. Reactive and/or passive individuals need not apply


**Desired Skills**
* Basic understanding and experience of using AI tools / Co\-pilot
* Alteryx / Python / Tableau knowledge would be an added advantage
* Must be proactive and be a highly\-motivated self\-starter
* Effective communication skills with English proficiency
* Demonstrated ability to work in a high pressure environment
* Takes initiative and challenges existing processes and procedures in a proactive manner
* Strong team player
* Ability to analyze issues independently and derive solutions
* Analytical skills
* Inherent sense of principles of control through experience and sound judgment
* Reliability

**Job Location\***

**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 This role is in the Procurement within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. Source to Pay team provides centralized supplier procurement, contracting, \& ongoing management support across all Synchrony Functions delivering those products and services needed to be successful in our daily operations.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Strategic Buyer plays a critical role in Synchrony’s procurement transformation by owning end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories within the Global Procurement Buy Desk and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) function. The role ensures purchases are routed through the optimal buying channel—including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and guided buying through Coupa Smart Intake—while driving compliant purchasing, PO lifecycle discipline, tail spend optimization, integration issue resolution, and digital enablement through Coupa, Oracle, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories and route demand through the right buying channel, including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and Coupa Smart Intake guided buying.

title: Transformation Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead
* Proactively research best practices, benchmarks, and comparable approaches to inform solution design
* Contribute to the development of business cases, options papers, and other analytical outputs that inform senior decision\-making


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**
* Engage day\-to\-day with global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business to gather information, validate analysis, and support the change process
* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience


**Technology\-Enabled Transformation**
* Support work with Global Process Owners, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to understand technology solutions and their implications for the operating model
* Contribute to the definition of functional requirements and business logic for tech\-enabled tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
* Develop an active awareness of AI and agentic AI tools and their potential to create value within transformation workstreams, in line with Alter Domus's AI governance framework
* Assist in ensuring alignment between business processes and system capabilities, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for resolution


**Workstream Support \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned workstreams, taking ownership of defined tasks and deliverables within the broader program plan
* Maintain up\-to\-date workstream documentation, including process maps, trackers, issue logs, and meeting notes
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, and insights to inform program governance and decision\-making
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business needs
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies promptly, with an initial view on potential solutions
* Demonstrate a self\-starter attitude — proactively progressing work without waiting for direction, and consistently delivering to a high standard


**Change Management \& Documentation**
* Support the design and delivery of change activities, including communications, training materials, and readiness assessments
* Help identify change resistance and contribute to strategies that build engagement and adoption across impacted teams
* Produce clear, well\-structured documentation of current\-state and future\-state processes, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and knowledge assets to enable smooth transition to new ways of working
* Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and ensure workstream outputs are thoroughly recorded and accessible for BAU teams


**Essential**
**Skills \& Experience Required:**
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, business analysis, operations, financial services, or a related analytical field; exceptional recent graduates will also be considered
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to structure problems clearly, analyse data rigorously, and draw well\-reasoned conclusions
* High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information in a structured and compelling way
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to build clean models and well\-structured presentations
* A proactive, self\-starting mindset — intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in ambiguous situations
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* High levels of personal drive, ownership, and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, infrastructure, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, AI\-assisted workflows, or data\-driven transformation)

* Sound understanding of how regulated financial services entities operate, with some exposure to fund administration, private equity, alternative investments, or wealth management
* Exposure to regulatory change programmes or compliance\-driven transformation
* Experience with service design, customer journey mapping, or lean/six sigma methodologies
* Prior exposure to process improvement, project delivery, or transformation activity in any context (professional or academic)
* Familiarity with process mapping or collaboration tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Confluence, Jira)
* Familiarity with project management or change management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, Prosci, Kotter)
* Familiarity with technology concepts such as workflow automation, system integration, APIs, and cloud\-based platforms
* Business analysis certification (e.g., BCS, IIBA/CBAP) or Agile/Scrum certification (CSM, CSPO) a plus
* Undergraduate or postgraduate degree from a leading institution, ideally in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a field with role\-relevant transferable skills


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location

title: Vice President Finance Transformation
description:
**Vice President \- Finance and Accounting Transformation** 




  





**Location:** 
 Delhi and Hyderabad, India
 



**Experience:** 
 15–23 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Mastermindnetwork is the hiring organization for this Vice President \- Finance and Accounting Transformation opportunity. The available company brief does not include additional information about its industry, operating scale, culture, products, customers, milestones, or market position, so no unsupported claims have been added. This role is defined around enterprise finance transformation ownership across Record to Report, Order to Cash, and Procure to Pay. The successful leader will connect finance process redesign, ERP implementation, technology decisions, and measurable business outcomes. The position is based in Delhi or Hyderabad and requires working from the office. Candidates should bring substantial experience leading complex transformation programs, preferably from a consulting background, with mandatory end\-to\-end implementation experience on SAP, Oracle, or another enterprise resource planning platform. FMCG or CPG project experience is mandatory for consideration. The role is intended for an operator who can combine executive stakeholder leadership with practical techno\-functional delivery depth.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Own the finance transformation agenda across R2R, O2C, and P2P, converting business priorities into scalable process, technology, and operating\-model outcomes. Lead end\-to\-end ERP implementation programs across discovery, design, build, testing, deployment, stabilization, and value realization. Act as the senior techno\-functional bridge between finance leaders, business stakeholders, technology teams, system integrators, and executive sponsors. Establish governance, architecture alignment, delivery controls, and benefits tracking across the portfolio. The role requires practical hands\-on understanding rather than advisory\-only exposure, with the ability to challenge designs, resolve complex dependencies, and make implementation decisions. FMCG or CPG project experience is mandatory, while consulting experience is preferred. Success will be measured through adoption, process standardization, controls, reporting quality, cycle\-time improvement, and sustained business value.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the integrated transformation roadmap across R2R, O2C, and P2P, aligning process, data, controls, and ERP decisions with enterprise finance outcomes and measurable value realization.
* Lead end\-to\-end SAP, Oracle, or comparable ERP implementation delivery from requirements and solution design through testing, cutover, stabilization, and post\-go\-live performance improvement.
* Govern system integrators, functional workstreams, and senior stakeholders through structured decision forums, risk controls, dependency management, and transparent executive reporting.
* Translate finance operating\-model requirements into practical techno\-functional solutions, challenging process designs and configuration choices that create standardization, control, scalability, and user adoption.
* Build transformation benefits tracking across close, collections, payables, working capital, compliance, reporting quality, and process cycle times to demonstrate sustained business impact.
* Apply FMCG or CPG project experience to address high\-volume, multi\-entity, customer, supplier, inventory, and commercial finance complexities within transformation programs.
* Lead change adoption across finance and business teams by establishing ownership, capability building, communication, and operating discipline required for new processes and systems.
* Resolve cross\-tower issues decisively, balancing business continuity, implementation timelines, risk exposure, architecture integrity, and long\-term maintainability.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Mandatory hands\-on, end\-to\-end implementation experience with SAP, Oracle, or another enterprise ERP platform, covering design, configuration oversight, testing, deployment, and stabilization.
* Strong techno\-functional command of R2R, O2C, and P2P processes, including controls, master data, integrations, reporting, close, collections, procurement, and payables outcomes.
* Proven transformation governance capability across system integrators, cross\-functional teams, executive stakeholders, delivery risks, dependencies, benefits, and adoption measures.
* Mandatory experience delivering FMCG or CPG\-related transformation projects involving complex, high\-volume, multi\-entity finance and commercial operating environments.
* Strong consulting, problem\-solving, communication, and executive influencing skills, with the ability to convert ambiguity into implementable decisions and measurable outcomes.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience managing global or multi\-country ERP transformation programs with common templates, localization requirements, shared services, and complex integration landscapes.
* Exposure to finance data, analytics, automation, controls, process mining, or adjacent technologies that improve transparency, decision quality, and operational performance.
* Experience leading post\-go\-live optimization, value realization, and continuous improvement beyond initial implementation delivery.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* 15–23 years of experience in finance transformation, ERP delivery, enterprise technology, consulting, or related leadership roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex programs and business outcomes.
* Mandatory end\-to\-end ERP implementation experience on SAP, Oracle, or a comparable platform, combining executive\-level leadership with sufficient hands\-on techno\-functional depth to guide critical design and delivery decisions.
* Mandatory FMCG or CPG project experience, including an understanding of high\-volume transactions, multi\-entity operations, commercial finance interfaces, supply\-chain dependencies, and the control environment required for scalable transformation.
* A consulting background is preferred, particularly experience advising senior finance and business leaders while also driving implementation execution, issue resolution, stakeholder alignment, and measurable value realization.
* B.Tech or another technical educational background, supported by strong understanding of finance processes across R2R, O2C, and P2P.
* An outcome\-led leadership style that creates accountability across internal teams, system integrators, business owners, and technology partners while maintaining delivery momentum and implementation quality.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Own a high\-impact enterprise finance transformation mandate spanning R2R, O2C, and P2P, with direct influence over process, technology, governance, and measurable business outcomes.
* Shape ERP\-led operating\-model change from strategy through implementation and value realization, working at the intersection of finance, technology, and business leadership.
* Bring consulting expertise and FMCG or CPG transformation experience into a senior role where practical delivery judgment and sustained adoption matter as much as strategic vision.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A Vice President\-level mandate with broad ownership of finance transformation across the core R2R, O2C, and P2P towers.
* The opportunity to lead end\-to\-end ERP implementation and measurable operating improvement from either the Delhi or Hyderabad office, with a CTC range of ₹50–75 LPA.

title: Research Analyst
description:
**About 79th East** 




 79th East Private Limited is a Hyderabad\-based investment services firm – an AMFI\-registered Mutual Fund Distributor (ARN\-364145\) and a distributor of Portfolio Management Services. Our work is research\-led: we build our own view on funds and stocks rather than passing on someone else's.
 



**The role** 




 You will build and maintain the firm's internal view of markets, funds and stocks. This research is for our own use – it shapes what we recommend and how we guide clients. It is hands\-on analytical work from day one, not a support role.
 



**Key responsibilities** 



* Mutual fund due diligence – category comparisons, factsheet and portfolio analysis, performance and risk attribution, and maintaining the recommended\-fund list.
* Single\-stock analysis – screening, financial analysis and sector work, to our house factsheet format.
* Support the equity basket products: construction, periodic review and reconciliation.
* Client portfolio analysis – overlap and look\-through studies, rebalancing notes and investment\-committee notes.
* Draft investor\-facing material – the monthly market letter, blog articles and webinar content – in plain, accurate language.
* Keep the research process documented and repeatable, with every figure traceable to its source.



**What you must bring** 



* Valid NISM Series XV (Research Analyst) certificate – mandatory.
* 2–3 years in equity or mutual fund research, or a research\-facing role at a broking house, AMC, wealth firm or research provider.
* Strong Excel and financial analysis; comfortable building and auditing a model.
* Ability to write clearly for a non\-specialist reader.
* Graduate in commerce, finance or economics.
* Hyderabad local candidates only – the role is on\-site at Ameerpet.



**Added advantage** 



* NISM Series V\-A, VIII or XXI\-A.
* CFA (any level), FRM or MBA (Finance).
* Screener, Capitaline, Ace Equity, Bloomberg or similar research tools.
* Working knowledge of AI tools such as Claude.
* Proficiency in Telugu and/or Hindi.



**Location and salary** 



* Location: Ameerpet, Hyderabad – full\-time, on\-site.
* Salary: up to Rs 5,00,000 per year (CTC), based on experience.



**How to apply** 




 Email your CV to info@79the.com with the subject "Research Analyst – Hyderabad", mentioning the validity date of your NISM Series XV certificate. If you can share one research note or model you have written, please attach it.
